tieu_de: Advise people not to kill animals during celebrations
noi_dung:
Advising people not to kill living things on occasions of celebration

People encounter good days and beautiful scenes and joy appears on their faces, but animals on those days feel pain in their hearts. Why is that? Because at that time, people were busy eating, drinking, and having fun, while animals were in a daze; Humans reunite as one family, while animals mother and child separate; People wear beautiful clothes, congratulate each other on good things, delicious dishes and precious objects are displayed as much as grass and trash, while animals are covered in blood, their intestines are broken into pieces, their hearts, liver, brains and brains are scattered on the ground mixed with sand... Therefore, it can be said that, on days of celebration, killing animals is the most cruel act of humans. For example, when you are about to kill someone but suddenly stop and reflect on yourself, even if there are delicious and strange dishes displayed in front of your eyes, you cannot help but feel sadness and pity in your heart. The Brahma Sutra mentions the precept "not being careful when good things happen", which means not knowing how to prevent the act of killing animals during celebrations.

Geese die instead of people1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Precepts to the present report (戒殺現報). (Author's note)

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, in Phu Tuong, Hangzhou, there was a person with the surname Trieu who was rich in mercy and did not kill animals. At the end of the year, someone brought a goose as a gift. His family wanted to slaughter it, but he tried his best to stop it. On the full moon night of the first lunar month, people in

's family asked to kill the geese again, but he still refused to let them. After delaying until the Doan Duong period on May 5,1 the family member asked to kill the goose again, he told him not to, thanks to which the goose escaped death.

NOTE 1

We also call it Doan Ngo Tet.

On the 17th of that same month, he fell ill, and on the first of June, he became very ill. [He dreamed] that a man in a green shirt took him to a temple, and three people came to present the indictment, and the chief received them all. Later, two acquaintances and a woman named Duong were also brought there.

Just as the Trieu family was called out for questioning, suddenly a goose ran to lie on the ground, uttered a human voice, and told the Trieu family: "Go away, I'm here to replace you." The Trieu family immediately followed the old path, saw their own body still kept unshrouded in a covered coffin, immediately entered the soul into the body and came back to life.

That day, the goose suddenly fell dead in the cage. The two people familiar with Ms. Duong that he met in his dream also died on the same day.

DISCUSSION

In life and death, even father and son cannot replace each other. Even though the Trieu family had kindness towards the goose, how could the goose die for the Trieu family?

But even so, on closer inspection, the nature of the dharma is clear and comprehensive, with the full meaning of mutual communication,

so there is nothing incompatible in the place of sincerity. The fact that the goose saved the Trieu family cannot be said to be unreasonable.

tieu_de: Celebrating the birth of a child should not be killed
noi_dung:
When giving birth to a child, do not kill it

If a rich man gives birth to a child, he treasures it like a precious gem, but when he sees an animal straying from the herd, he immediately [thinks of] catching it as a dish. Waking up late at night in the quiet of the night [examining myself], I can't help but see that such a mind is extremely cruel. I hope you often read the Ksitigarbha Sutra [you will see that reason].

The sutra teaches that: "People in this Jambudvipa world, when a child is born, must know to be careful not to kill life animals and then gather a large number of relatives to eat and drink together, as this will cause neither the mother nor the child to be peaceful and happy."

Accordingly, considering that, I want to pray for the children and grandchildren to grow up and live long lives. enjoy blessings, be safe and healthy, definitely do not kill living things.

When people give birth, there are immediately a lot of uncouth, omnivorous and drinkable people competing to ask for alcohol. Even though my mouth always says I want to congratulate you, in my heart I'm just talking about the delicious food. Stupid people cannot see their true motives, so when they hold small parties, they slaughter chickens and ducks, and at large parties, they cut pigs and stab goats, so that from this life to the next, grudges continue to be borrowed and repaid, which is extremely meaningless.

Killing goats will result in immediate retribution1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Phap Uyen Chau Lam. (Author's note)

During the Tang Dynasty, around the reign of Hien Khanh,2 in Chang'an3 there was a person who gave birth to a baby just one month old, held a huge party for friends and relatives, and planned to kill a goat. The goat repeatedly bowed to the butcher and begged, but the butcher did not care and finally killed him. Later, put the goat meat in the pot to cook. The mother brought her child to see, the pot cooking goat meat suddenly burst, boiling water poured down onto the hot fire and then shot up as if aiming straight at the heads and faces of mother and child. In just a moment, both died.

NOTE 2

The Xianqing era spanned the years from 656 to 661.

NOTE 3

This is now Xi'an.

LOI TABLE

During Buddha's time, a demon king had 500 children. The youngest child's name is Tan-old-la. Mother ghosts are very violent, often capturing people's sons and daughters to eat. The World-Honored One immediately caught the demon child Tan-gà-la and locked it inside an upside-down bowl. The mother ghost flew to search all over the world, but for seven days she still couldn't find her, so she went to ask Buddha where the baby ghost was now. Buddha asked: "Your family has 500 children, only one of them has died. Why are you so sad and miserable? When people give birth to children, why don't you love them? How can you bear to eat meat?" Mother ghost replied: "If you find Tan-la-la, from now on I swear not to kill other people's children." The Buddha immediately showed the place where the bowl was hidden inside. The mother ghost and all her children together used all their divine power to lift the bowl but could not move it at all, so they turned to the Buddha for help. Buddha taught: "Take the Three Refuges, vow to keep the Five Precepts, and your children will return." The ghost immediately obeyed Buddha's teachings. The Buddha said again: "Keep the precepts well. During the time of Buddha Kasyapa, you used to be Princess Yet-Co. Because you did not keep the precepts, you now have to suffer the retribution of falling into the realm of demons."1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Ca Bao Treasury Sutra (雜寶藏經). (Author's note) However, we did not find this excerpt in the Ca Bao Treasury Sutra, but found it in the book Shakyamuni Tathagata Ying Hoa Luc (釋迦 如來應化錄), classified in the Van Tien Treasury, Volume 75, Sutra No. 1511, including 6 volumes. The content of the quote belongs to volume 2, page 88, sheet c, starting from the 11th line with the sentence: "Ta Bao Tang Kinh Van - 雜寶藏經云" Perhaps Mr. An Si used this sentence to quote. The content of the quote has some details omitted, but they are not important.

Alas, how many [violent] people are like that mother devil, [eating the children of all species]?

tieu_de: Advise those who worship ancestors
noi_dung:
Advice to those who worship ancestors2

NOTE 2

Below is advice not to kill life objects to worship ancestors.

Worship Ancestors, however, are just wholeheartedly expressing their remembrance of the kindness and goodness of their origin, but it is still unknown whether the ancestors will come or not. Why is that? If our ancestors had cultivated merit, they would have been born in two realms of heaven and earth, enjoying blessings. If they had committed evil karma, they must have suffered in the three evil realms.

However, the cases of enjoying blessings and happiness are feared to be few, but the cases of suffering are very many. Therefore, filial children and grandchildren should every time the death anniversary comes and worship their ancestors, they should sincerely persevere in the precepts, recite Buddha's name and recite sutras, and dedicate their merits [praying for their ancestors' early liberation] to the Western Pure Land, helping their ancestors escape the suffering of reincarnation. That is true gratitude.

As for killing animals to make lavish offerings, it only increases the karma of the dead. People with true understanding [seeing these things] cannot help but feel pity.

Killing living things involves the dead1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Truc song essay (竹窗隨筆). (Author's note)

During the Early Tang Dynasty,2 there was a layperson named Kim who faithfully and persistently kept the precepts. After death, this person once possessed a young boy and told his family: "Even though I have practiced, my good karma is still not enough to be reborn in the Pure Land. Now I am in the underworld but I am very happy and can move freely."

NOTE 2

The Tang Dynasty ruled from 618, and in 690, Wu Zetian founded the Wu Zhou Dynasty. In 705, Tang Zhongzong ascended the throne to resume the Tang Dynasty, so it was called Later Tang. The period before the Wu Zhou Dynasty was called Early Tang.

After a while, the Kim family also possessed the boy and scolded his wife and children, saying: "Why did I kill the sacrificial chickens when building a grave for me? Because of that, I now go

everywhere with two people following me to supervise, no longer free."

At that time, the Kim family's daughter-in-law was pregnant, the family immediately brought it up and asked, the Kim family said: "This time I will give birth to a boy, my mother will have a healthy child. But the next time I will also give birth to a boy, both mother and child will die." Everyone was surprised and immediately wrote down those words. After all, it happened exactly like that.

COMMENT

Sacrifice cannot only use simple vegetables, [can add various kinds of fruit and cakes, but] most importantly, do not kill the sacrifice.

Every time people achieve success and get what they want, they slaughter pigs and goats to worship their ancestors in a grand manner. The person who does it is inherently complacent, seeing it as honoring the ancestors of the family, but those on the outside are always looking in and loudly praising it. But at that time, did our ancestors really touch the chopsticks and enjoy any of them?

Killing living things like that is useless, it only makes [the deceased] parents and grandparents sink deeper into karma. If the dead knew, they would not be able to help but feel pain and hold resentment in their hearts. It's not as good as poor people who only use simple fruit and vegetable soup to sincerely worship their ancestors. Isn't that better?

tieu_de: Advice to those who pray to the gods
noi_dung:
Advice to those who pray to the gods

People in the world consider reverence for doing things that are contrary to the way of heaven, and none of them is more [wrong] than [killing living things to] offer sacrifices to thank the gods. In such sacrifices, the most infuriating are those who specialize in standing in for others to offer sacrifices and seek blessings.

In general, long life or premature death are all caused by artificial means from previous lives. Once karma has come, it cannot be escaped. For example, if an official obeys an order to arrest someone, would those on duty just for a little food to respond to the person being arrested and cancel the order?

The inside of the sacrificial temples are gloomy and stuffy, everywhere is like that. Just because people have been used to it for a long time, they are all deceived by greedy villains. Those petty people saw that someone was sick and immediately went to the house to collect money to buy animals to sacrifice to evil gods. The homeowner is ignorant, not knowing that this causes the sick person to silently suffer more disasters, but thinks it is creating blessings. Isn't that extremely pitiful?

I would like to advise all people in the world, whenever there is a sick person in the house, they should be encouraged to do good and accumulate virtue to alleviate disasters, chant sutras and repentance ceremonies. If you see a critical illness, you should advise the patient to concentrate on reciting Buddha's name and pray for rebirth. This is truly immeasurable and boundless merit. Be careful not to listen to the lies of fortune tellers, it will only make the sick person suffer even more.

Sacrificing to God to meet Buddha1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Dhammapada Sutra (法句經). (Author's note) However, we did not find this excerpt in the Dhammapada Sutra, but found it in the book Shakyamuni Tathagata Ying Hoa Luc (釋迦如來應化 錄), classified in the Van Sutta Pitaka, Volume 75, Sutra No. 1511, including 6 volumes. The quoted content belongs to volume 2, page 86, sheet b, starting from the 3rd line with the sentence: "Dhammapada sutra - 法句經云" Perhaps Mr. An Si used this sentence to quote.

During the time when Buddha was still alive, there was a king named Hoa Mac, who believed in and worshiped pagans. Throughout that country, people believed in heretical doctrines and killed animals to make offerings.

Once the king's mother was sick and did not get better for a long time. The king immediately summoned brahmin teachers to ask the cause. The brahmins replied: "Because the stars are reversed and yin and yang are not in harmony, such a disease occurs."

The king immediately prepared enough of them to bring them to the place to set up the altar to worship the heavens. The Buddha knew what happened, felt great compassion, took pity on the foolish king, and immediately appeared at that place. As soon as the King saw the Buddha from afar, he quickly bowed. He came to his side and said: "My mother has been sick for a long time, now I want to sacrifice to heaven to pray for her."

Buddha taught: "If you want rice, you must plow the fields; if you want to be rich, you must practice almsgiving; if you want to live long, you must practice great kindness; if you want to gain knowledge, you must study hard. These four things all depend on work to get results. Offerings and prayers disrupt common sense, taking evil as the main thing. Killing life in order to live is too far from the meaning of survival.”

At that moment, the Buddha immediately emitted light to illuminate the whole world. The king heard the sermon and saw the Buddha's aura, immediately felt ashamed, repented of his sins, and finally stopped making offerings to heaven. The king's mother felt happy when she heard it, and her illness was naturally eliminated.

King Hoa Mac from then on believed in the Three Jewels, loved the people like her own children, and often practiced the Ten Good Karmas,1

NOTE 1

Ten good karma (Ten good karma): Including: 1. Not killing living beings, often working to forgive and release living beings. 2. Do not steal, often practice almsgiving, helping, and sharing with everyone. 3. Do not commit adultery, always remain faithful to one husband and one wife. 4. Don't lie, always speak the truth. 5. Do not speak elaborate or vulgar words, but often speak meaningful and beneficial words. 6. Do not speak harshly or cause division, but often say words that create unity and love for each other. 7. Do not say cruel or harmful words, often speak gentle and gentle words. 8. Don't be greedy, always consider that all material possessions are temporary and do not last. 9. Don't be angry, always practice compassion and patience. 10. Do not be ignorant or have wrong views, always be wise and practice according to right views.

in the country there is always good rain and wind, good harvests.

COMMENT

All sentient beings [with enough merit] born in heaven have pure bodies, bright and radiant auras, without impurities such as blood, pus, phlegm, feces, urine... The food is nectar, naturally appearing at will. The gods look down at the world of Jambudvipa filled with thorns, thorns, and stinking flesh and blood. They really don't want to see or hear it. They also wish that they would ride on clouds to enjoy [the flesh and blood sacrifice], which is truly absurd.

A chicken raised by a person, although it likes to eat centipedes, cannot therefore bring the centipede to the person and consider it a delicious dish. As for saying that the gods [although they don't eat,] only enjoy the taste of the food, then all over this world there are always people cooking meat and fish, the flavor is endless, surely the gods could have enjoyed it a long time ago, why would they have to wait for someone to make an offering? It's like saying that if you have a special intention for the gods, if you kill the offering, the gods will enjoy it, but if King Hoa Mac makes the sacrifice, it will only be for one day, so in the days after that, don't the gods have anything to enjoy?

The scriptures have a saying: “True [offered] grain has no fragrance, only [people's] shining morality has fragrance.” The I Ching says:

“A house in the east killing a buffalo is not as good as a house in the west making simple but sincere offerings.” It's just a pity that readers of the book don't understand those meanings [so they believe in killing animals to make offerings and pray for good fortune.]

If you sacrifice to a tree god, you must be born as a goat1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Sutra of Samsara. (雜寶藏經), volume 7. (Author's note) However, we did not find this story in the Tap Bao Treasury Sutra, but found it in the book Phap Uyen Chau Lam (法苑珠 林), classified in the Mahazheng Pitaka, Volume 53, Sutra No. 2122, including 100 volumes. This story belongs to volume 62, page 753, page b, starting from the 6th line with the sentence: "Huu Ka Bao Tang Kinh Van -又雜寶藏經云" Perhaps Mr. An Si used this sentence to quote. We have compared the content with the original, although there are some differences but not important.

Once upon a time, there was a very rich old man2 who one day suddenly wanted to eat meat. He pointed to a tree growing at the top of his fields and told his children: "Our family has the inheritance it has today thanks to the blessing of that tree god. You should kill a goat in the herd and bring it to the tree god."

NOTE 2

The original only said "The old man of the world - 昔有老公", but An Si Complete Book wrote: "The Buddha has the most old man - 佛世 有一 老人." (During Buddha's time, there was an old man...) We chose to translate according to the original in Phap Uyen Chau Lam.

His children listened, immediately killed a goat to sacrifice to the tree god, and built a shrine to worship the god right under that tree.

Later, when the old man died, he had to be born as a child

goat in that house. When the time came that his children wanted to make offerings to the tree god, they immediately chose that goat to kill. At that time, the goat suddenly spoke in a human voice: "That tree doesn't have any gods. In the past, because I wanted to eat meat, I told a lie and told my children to make an offering. You all ate the sacrificed meat with me, but I didn't expect that I would have to suffer the retribution first."

At that time, a Bhikkhu who had attained Arahantship had just come there to beg for alms, and immediately used his supernatural powers to help his children see. saw that the goat was their father from before. After knowing the truth, they immediately destroyed the temple worshiping the tree god. From then on, repent of your sins, cultivate merit, and give up never killing living things again.

COMMENT

The Agama Sutra teaches that: "There are five types of alms that do not bring blessings. One is to help people with weapons to kill, two are to help people with poison to harm others, and three are to help people with impure nature. can cause harm], fourth is to help women commit adultery [deprave people], fifth is to build temples to worship evil gods.”1

NOTE 1

The Complete Book of An Si cites the commentary on the Anguttara Sutra (51 volumes), volume 28. However, we find this excerpt currently in volume 27, of Mahaskaya Pitaka, Volume 2, Sutra No. 125, page 699, sheet a, from line 13 to line 15.

There are people in this world who are deluded and meet fields

The Three Jewels of blessings refuse to offer alms, but when it comes to temples worshiping evil spirits and demons, they happily contribute to their construction. That's because the true eyes have not been opened. Once an achievement is built, the name is engraved with the words "that day, that month, that year, established by that name", then complacently thinks that he has spent money to create great blessings. Alas, who did not know that from then on, for large offerings, goats were slaughtered and pigs slaughtered, for small offerings, chickens, ducks, fish, shrimp... had to groan in pain from being cut with knives and chopping boards, had to desperately struggle in hot water and oil, it was impossible to know how many hundreds of thousands of animals there were. It is true: "Heaven has not yet been achieved, hell has already taken shape." Confucius said: "Offering sacrifices to gods who are not worthy of worship is called evil worship. Offering evil sacrifices is not virtuous." How good is the teachings of the saints, truly no different from the Buddha's teachings.

Thanh Dong Nhac would like to receive ordination1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Truyen Dang Luc (傳燈錄). (Editor's note) The full name is Canh Duc Truyen Dang Luc (景德傳燈錄), classified in the Mahazheng Treasury, in Volume 51, sutra number 2076, a total of 30 volumes. The content of this quote is from volume 4, page 233, sheet b, starting from line 7.

During the Tang Dynasty, there was Zen master Nguyen Khue, whose family name was Ly, from Y Khuyet.2 He received full ordination3 on

NOTE 2

Now it is Ha Nam, Lac Duong.

NOTE 3

Full ordination, also known as Great ordination, means officially receiving the full precepts of a monk.

during the second year of Vinh Thuan era.1 Later, he met with the National Master. Hue An, having enlightenment about Zen that was confirmed by the National Master, immediately chose Bang O land in Thai mountain as a place to retreat.

NOTE 1

That is the year 683.

One ​​day, someone came to the Zen master, looking unusual, wearing an official crown, and had a large and majestic entourage following him. As soon as they met, he immediately asked: "Can you know who I am?" The Zen master replied: "I consider all sentient beings to be equal, without distinction."

The stranger said: "I am Emperor Nhac, 2 holds the power of life and death over people, can give life, can kill, how can you consider them as ordinary people?"

NOTE 2

Music Emperor: to say enough, Dong Nhac Son Thai Thien Qi Nhan Thanh Great Emperor, also known as Dong Nhac Thanh Emperor, is one of the Five Great Emperors, that is, the 5 gods in charge of 5 great mountains, including: Thai Son, Hanh Son, Tung Son, Hang Son and Hoa Son. Than Dong Nhac presides over Thai mountain, considered the most important, the top of the Five Musics.

The Zen master said: "I was not born, how can you force me to die? My body is like nothingness, can you destroy it?"

The Emperor Yue immediately bowed his head and said: "Teacher, I am a god who is intelligent and upright, much better than other gods. Please teach me the true precepts, helping me to escape samsara."

The Zen master immediately went up to the high throne, burned incense, his demeanor was dignified, called the god and asked: "Now teach me

you five years ago. First, can you keep the precepts of sexual immorality?”

The god asked: “You have a wife.”

The Zen master said: “There is no stopping you from having a wife, just don't have an evil heart with any other woman.”

The god bowed and said: “Then you can keep it.”

The Zen master asked again: "Can you keep the precept not to steal?"

The spirit said: "You are not hungry, why do you have to steal?"

The Zen master replied: "It is not what you think. This precept means that you must not bless evil people because of receiving offerings and worship, or because of not being offered offerings, bring disaster to the wicked." gentle person.”

The god bowed and said, "Then you can keep it."

The Zen master asked again: "Can you keep the precept not to kill?"

The god said: "You hold the great power of life and death, how can you not kill?"

The Zen master replied: "No. This precept means not to kill more than necessary, or to kill by mistake, or to kill out of suspicion, or to kill because of carelessness or without investigation. Consider carefully.”

The god bowed and said, “Then you can keep it.”

The Zen master asked again: "Can you keep the precept not to lie?"

The spirit said: "You are an upright god, how can you lie?"

The Zen master said: "That's not true. This precept means to be careful with your words, always following the will of heaven."

The master bowed. He bowed and said, "Then I can keep it."

The Zen master asked again: "Can you keep the precept of not drinking alcohol?"

The god bowed again and said: "I can keep it."

The Zen master taught: "Thus, I have imparted to you the five precepts, which are the most basic precepts established by the Buddha."

The Zen master and the god continued to talk for a long time. The spirit said to the Zen master again: "I have been taught and taught by you. I hope to repay your kindness. Please tell me to do something in this world, so that I can display some supernatural powers, so that those who do not have faith will have faith."

The Zen master refused, I tried my best to request. Finally, the Zen master immediately said: "The east side of the pagoda needs to block the wind, but it is empty and has no trees. The northern mountain has a lot of trees, but it is not the direction that needs protection. Can you move the trees on the northern mountain to the east side of the pagoda?" After saying that, he immediately bowed and said goodbye. The Zen master walked out the door and saw his entourage and guards like kings, auspicious clouds surrounded him, mist and smoke appeared, flags with majestic jade parasols slowly rose into the air and then disappeared.

That night, a storm arose, thunder rumbled, dark clouds rolled, and lightning struck brightly. When I looked out early in the morning, I saw that all the pine trees on the northern mountain side had indeed moved to the east, lush and dense.

In the year of the Dragon in the fourth year of Khai Nguyen,1 the Zen master told his disciples: "I have always lived on the mountain east of the pagoda, after death I can build a tower there."

NOTE 1

That is the year 716.

After giving instructions, the Zen master peacefully passed away.

COMMENT

The gods on land or in the river, all had cultivated in previous lives. It's just that because he didn't develop the Bodhi mind, once he enjoyed the blessings, he immediately became confused, [no longer able to clearly distinguish between right and wrong]. There are also monks who keep the precepts, and when reborn as noble people, they fall into eating meat and drinking alcohol, and blaspheme the Three Jewels. That's all because they only know how to practice blessings and not wisdom.

Once upon a time, when the World-Honored One had not yet attained enlightenment, he meditated solemnly under the Bodhi tree. Mara Ba-week was afraid of his attainment of enlightenment, so he brought with him eight million demons who wanted to harm him. Mara said to Buddha: "Prince Siddhartha, you quickly stand up and leave somewhere else. If you don't go, I will hold your feet and throw you out into the sea."

Buddha told Mara: "I contemplate and see that in this entire world, no one can throw me out into the sea. In your previous life, you built a temple,1 observed the Eight Precepts2 for a while. Day and night, he once offered food to a Bich Chi Buddha. Because of those blessings, he was born in the sixth level of the Desire Realm heaven, becoming the Great Demon King.3 And I was

NOTE 1

The original Chinese inscription is: "曾作一 寺主 - tat tat one self-control", which can be understood as "having been the presiding officer (or abbot) of a temple". However, comparing the original text in the Tap Bao Tang Sutra, this sentence is: "但 曾作一 寺- dan tang tac one word" (page 481, sheet b, line 21), meaning "only ever built one temple". through countless eons cultivating merits and making offerings to countless Buddhas, how can you harm me? said: "This earth is

testimony to my words."

As soon as the Buddha finished speaking, the earth shook, countless earth gods rushed up from underground, knelt down, clasped their hands and prayed to the Buddha: "World-Honored One, we would like to bear witness. The Buddha's words are completely true, not false."1

NOTE 1

This story is recorded in the Ca Bao Treasury Sutra. (Editor's Note) The Ca Bao Treasury Sutra (雜寶藏經) is classified in the Mahazheng Canon, Volume 4, Sutra No. 203, page 481, sheet b, starting starting from line 16.

So we can know that the two things of cultivating merit and cultivating wisdom must be focused on at the same time, without bias or neglecting one side. Like the Eastern Music Saint Emperor,2 can be said to not be confused about the true good causes [of previous lives]. Therefore, in the teachings of the Zen master, it is said: "Do not bring blessings to evil people because of receiving offerings and worship, or because of not receiving offerings, bring disaster to good people." It is clear that the teachings [are given to people] after receiving the precepts. People do not think carefully and unjustly kill so many sacred creatures, how sad!

NOTE 2

The god Dong Nhac.

Guan Gong protects the Dharma1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Guandi Classic Mantra (關帝經註) of Taoism (ie Taoism). (Author's note)

Quan Cong's full name was Vu, his personal name was Van Truong, and he lived in the Later Han Dynasty. After his death, he obeyed the Jade Emperor's edict to become the god in charge of matters within the scope of literary and academic examinations, along with books recording the good and evil deeds of people. Throughout the dynasties, he was always bestowed and honored with noble titles. He took refuge in the Three Jewels and vowed to help people.

Around the beginning of the Ming Dynasty, he once wrote2 at a big mandarin's house, advising people to practice good deeds. That's why it was said: "I have taken refuge with the Great Avalokiteśvara, and with the Heavenly Venerable Vi Da, take care of protecting the Dharma. Therefore, when people make offerings to me, they are not allowed to use alcohol or meat." That story spread far and wide, so in pagodas and temples there are statues of Quan Thanh De Quan. There are many epiphanies in the past.

NOTE 2

Xing Pen (降筆): also called Xing Ji (降箕), is a Taoist ritual, using a wooden table filled with broken rice or sand. The person who descends will draw words on it to show what they want to say.

COMMENT

I have read through Taoist books, and found that among them is the book "Wenchang Repentance" consisting of 3 volumes, said to have been written by Emperor Quan. In

that book mostly uses teachings from the Buddhist Sutras. Although the vastness and comprehensiveness cannot be compared to the book "Luong Hoang Sam", the admiration and belief in the Three Jewels is no less than the words of Quan Cong. That's why I feel that both of them are truly commendable. Together they are in charge of literature and examinations, and those who participate in the exam must go through their review and selection. Going out of the gates of heaven, entering the gates of the underworld, their authority is so glorious, yet one must also admire and follow the Buddha, then the vastness of the Buddha's teachings can be seen clearly without argument.

Mencius once considered Ba Di and Thai Cong as the fathers of the whole world, saying: "The fathers of the world [Ba Di, Thuc Cong] have all submitted to [Van] King] then [people in the world are] descendants, who else can they follow?”

I would like to say the same thing to the two Emperors, Wenchang and Guan Gong, as Mencius. [As brave as you are, you still follow Buddha, who else can people in the world follow?]

tieu_de: Recommended to star divination readers
noi_dung:
Advice to star divination

Use knives and sticks to kill, clearly and easily seen. Using words to kill is so discreet and unpredictable. Consider how fortune tellers who diagnose people's illnesses always say "due to being caught by this or that god...", then incite stupid people to mistakenly believe in them, kill all kinds of shrimp, fish, chickens, geese... there's nothing they can't do. Therefore, the animals that were killed could not help but resent the sick person for many generations, and also forever resent the fortune teller who predicted the illness. So, wouldn't a word from a fortune teller really cause great harm? I dare to advise all those who do fortune telling, whenever you meet someone who asks for a diagnosis, advise them to do good deeds, accumulate merit, fast and recite Buddha's name. For example, if you think that there really is a ghost or spirit to catch the sinner and you cannot help but make offerings, you can still advise people to use fragrant flowers and light vegetarian vegetables instead of meat and fish.

The fortune teller receives retribution1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Quang Nhan Luc (廣仁錄). (Author's note)

Jiangling region2 has a fortune teller named Lu. Every time he tells people fortune telling, they tell them to kill their sacrifices. One day, I went to a sick house and was about to diagnose the homeowner when I suddenly fell to the ground and died. Two days later, he came back to life. Someone asked the reason, and immediately recounted that:

NOTE 2

Belongs to Hubei province.

“I saw a devil over a foot tall,3 took me to the King of Hell. The King of Hell said that I was talking nonsense about other people's misfortunes, killing many creatures, so I was speechless. scolded and scolded. Seeing hundreds of demon prisoners,

NOTE 3

Each staff in the past had 10 meters, each meter was about 33 cm.

wept bitterly and scolded me: 'Because we mistakenly believed your words, we now have to bear the blame.' They scolded and then came together with shackles and shackles to beat me. I saw countless animals again, all roaring, glaring angrily, competing to grab me and bite me. At that time, the King of Hell wanted to send me to prison, suddenly a man wearing a green shirt said: 'This person's life on earth has not yet ended, please release him temporarily, later we will investigate.' Therefore, he was resurrected. As for the patient in this family, I already heard the name, I'm afraid he won't survive."

Indeed, just a few days later, the patient died. The fortune teller has since quit his job, and recorded this story to spread it everywhere to advise people.

DECLARATION

The tutelary god, the earth god, the river god, the king... there are many people in the world who mistakenly call them Bodhisattvas. Even killing animals as offerings is called worshiping Buddha! Alas, those small groups of ghosts and spirits who abuse the names of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas are no different from rotten wood that is considered a precious guitar! Also, in the history books, it is written: "The Western region has a god called Buddha." That is clearly the Buddha's name, but in return it is seen as a ghost or god. It is only because we do not have the right view that we fall into such a mistake.

tieu_de: Recommended for those hosting parties for guests
noi_dung:
Advice to those hosting a party for guests1

NOTE 1

Below is advice not to kill living things to entertain guests.

All people hate harm. harmful, but everyone does harmful things. Everyone in the world is afraid of falling, but everywhere the cause of falling is planted. Some people are scolded by their parents for being dogs, pigs, or animals for no reason. They become sad and unhappy, angry at their parents for insulting them. As for the names "dogs, pigs, animals" that he still hates and is afraid of being assigned to him, then he should be extremely afraid of truly depraved dogs, pigs, and animals, but I'm afraid he doesn't know how to completely stay away. Yet, just for the sake of serving the guests, they boiled fish, cooked shrimp, slaughtered chickens, killed ducks, [even though they knew] the retribution would definitely have to suffer in the three evil paths but still refused to wake up. Isn't that just hating the name but not fearing the real danger [of being an animal]?

The Mausoleum Sutra teaches that: "Because people eat goat meat, goats die and are born as humans, and people die as goats [to pay the debt of eating goats]. Eating meat is the same for other living beings, born and then dying, from generation to generation eating each other, together creating evil karma, continuing endlessly." The Buddha did not lie, so how can one doubt and not believe? Therefore, we know that if we slaughter a chicken, we will suffer the retribution of being a chicken, and if we kill a dog, we will receive the retribution of being a dog, of course. Alas, in the past, my parents scolded me for being a dog or a pig and didn't want to accept it. Now, just because of the food in other people's mouths, I [create reasons to be] a dog or a pig. Just because of a time of fun and banqueting, I [created people to have to] become dogs and pigs. Isn't that something that shouldn't be done but has already been done?

Husband kills goat turns out to kill wife1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Quang Nhan Luc (廣仁錄). (Author's note)

During the Northern Song Dynasty, Liu Daoyuan served as a district official in Bong Khe. After quitting his job, he returned to his hometown. One day he went to visit the Tan family's house and stayed one night. In the middle of the night, I dreamed of a woman crying and telling him: "I am the wife of the owner of this Qin family. I once beat to death one of my husband's concubines. The underworld condemned me to die to pay for my life, and to be forced to become a goat. I am currently locked in a barn, tomorrow morning I will be killed to treat you. Even if I die, I will not regret anything. I am sorry because I have a baby goat in my belly. If I die because of me, my crime will be even worse."

Liu Dao Nguyen waited until morning to bring it up, but the goat had already been killed. The whole Qin family heard the story and were extremely frightened. They immediately put the baby goat back into the mother's womb and brought it to the field to bury it.

FOR DECLARATION

Once upon a time, in the city of Xa-ve, there was a wealthy man named Do-de. One day, while he was away, the World-Honored One came to that house and saw a white dog lying on the bed, stealing food from the table. The dog saw Buddha coming and immediately jumped down on the bed and barked.

Buddha told him: "In the past life, you were greedy for property and refused to give alms to help others, so today you have to suffer like that."

The dog heard this and looked sad and angry, lying on the ground and refusing to eat. Mr. Do-de returned home, saw [a dog like that], got angry, and immediately went to the Buddha to [question him]. Buddha taught: "That dog was your father in the past. If you don't believe it, just go home and ask him, tell him to show you where the gold, silver and treasures are hidden." When Mr. Do-de heard that, he was both embarrassed and afraid. He followed Buddha's teachings and went home to ask the dog where his gold, silver, and treasure were hidden. The dog immediately ran quickly to get under the bed, used his paws to dig up the dirt, and sure enough, digging there, he found a lot of gold, silver and treasure. Only then did Mr. Do-de believe in the Buddha's teachings and take refuge in the Three Jewels.1

NOTE 1

This story is recorded in the Middle Agama Sutra.

Therefore, the Buddha taught that all living beings can be our parents and relatives from many previous lives. Every human birth, of course, has parents and relatives. From beginningless time until now, if we have been reborn through as many lives as there are grains of sand in the Ganges River, we must have had as many parents, relatives, and relatives in as many lifetimes as there are grains of sand in a Ganges River; If there are as many births as the sands of a hundred thousand Ganges rivers, then there must have been as many parents, relatives and relatives in a lifetime as there are sands in a hundred thousand Ganges rivers. Could it be that they could be so ignorant that they could kill them indiscriminately?

For example, when the Qin family's goat was killed, the whole family only thought it was a goat. The husband did not know that he was killing his wife to entertain guests, the child did not know that he was killing his mother to have fun with others, and the maid also did not know that he was killing his mistress to cook food. It wasn't until the situation was over that the husband realized that it was the person he had shared the bed with before, the child realized that it was the person who used to love and protect him, the maid knew that the animal with a mouth that couldn't speak and had to hold a grudge to death was the mistress who had previously taken care of the housework. But at that time, even if the bones and flesh were broken, it would be impossible to atone for the mistake and restore the life of that goat.

If only the Qin family had kept the precept of not killing, the husband would have saved his wife, the children would have saved the mother, the maid would have saved the landlady, how could it be that just because of a vaguely familiar guest, they would kill their own flesh and blood relatives!

Therefore, those who often kill animals to entertain guests must feel heartbroken and must give up doing it anymore.

If you kill too much, you will turn into a pig

During the Chanh Duc era of the Ming Dynasty,1 there was a man who had passed a bachelor's degree, whose family was extremely wealthy, and often killed life animals. Every time he entertained guests, he would kill them

NOTE 1

That is, during the reign of Ming Wu Tong. The Chanh Duc era lasted from 1506 to 1521.

three, four pigs. One night, this person dreamed that the God Tutelary God appeared and said: "You have killed countless animals, and will soon be turned into pigs."

But then he still had the same problem and refused to be warned. After about half a year, he suddenly died. After being wrapped in the coffin, suddenly they heard a noise inside. Everyone immediately opened the coffin lid to see that the corpse had turned into a pig.

COMMENT

People kill animals, mostly to entertain guests. But I don't know how to consider that those close friends, while eating and drinking with us, everyone claims to be close. But the next day we met on the road, but we just said hello to each other and left. If you are in trouble and need someone to help you, it is difficult to find one or two among thousands of people. Meanwhile, the suffering retribution in the three evil paths [due to evil karma of killing], the underworld has already been determined. Once he arrives in front of the King of Hell's palace, can he cite those guests to reduce his crime?

Judging from the way the bachelor entertained guests, he cannot help but think of himself as generous, generous, and full of affection. When the corpse turned into a pig, the bad news spread everywhere. I wonder if there would be any satisfaction at that time?

Black smoke heralds disaster1

NOTE 1

This story was told directly by a friend of mine. (Author's note)

In Con Son1 there was a man with the family name Hua, a wealthy family, with a hospitable nature, and food that always required delicious and hearty food, so he killed countless animals.

NOTE 1

The original engraving was Ngoc Phong, another name for Con Son, the hometown of Mr. Chu An Si.

Around the year of At Dau in the Thuan Tri era,2 suddenly appeared in the kitchen a cloud of black smoke as large as a wheel, flew around the yard once and then disappeared. Not long after, the northern army came to besiege the citadel, all 40 people in that family were killed.

NOTE 2

That was the year 1645, the second year of the Shunzhi era.

COMMENT

For rich people, the kitchen is the place where great injustices and resentments gather. Although it is only about three or four meters square on each side, cries for help often resound inside. Mother-child separation also happens often there; Liver and intestine dissection, heart and lung extraction also frequently occur there. Resentment that has accumulated for a long time can be seen filling that place. The ghosts cried and mourned, their sad sounds echoed throughout the night. Sometimes they appear as headless ghosts, or appear as bloody bodies, or appear with closed eyes, or eyes wide open, or appear shaking their heads and flapping their wings, or make a puffing sound like spitting blood, or groan in pain, or

lamenting miserably, everyone gritted their teeth and beat their chests, bared their fangs and claws, determined to be willing to face revenge. Therefore, the sacred heavens and earth, the ghosts and gods passing by, have clearly recorded their sins, causing the wicked to suffer countless hardships while alive, and when they die, they must fall into the three evil paths, from which no one can save them. So, isn't that kitchen a place where great injustices and resentments gather? Those who are hospitable must be very careful not to follow this path.

tieu_de: Advice to those who entertain teachers
noi_dung:
Advice to those who entertain teachers

There is no one in this world who does not love their children, but they often do not know how to love them appropriately. Consider inviting a teacher to teach your child, who originally wanted him to become famous, to be among the righteous scholars, but because he wanted to reward the teacher, he often boiled fish, cooked shrimp, killed chickens, slaughtered ducks... For example, every year he kills thousands of lives, in ten years he must kill tens of thousands of sentient beings. Accumulated for such a long time, even if my child has great blessings, I will still have to lose a lot, let alone cases where the blessings are not deep enough?

If you think that the food is not very sumptuous and you are not satisfied, you can use all the money spent on killing chickens and ducks to increase the teacher's salary, making the teacher always happy and satisfied in teaching his children. Thus

then the lack of alcohol and meat can certainly be compensated for, and our children will naturally gain more blessings and longevity every day. Then why is it necessary to kill the living things and then have to fall into the three evil paths because of that?

Because worrying about meals harms the child1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Quang Nhan Luc (廣仁錄). (Author's note)

In Thuong Thuc district2 there is a person who is very good at using a bird gun and has killed countless birds. At the age of 40, he gave birth to a handsome and handsome son, deeply loved in his heart. He immediately repented of the previous day and gave up shooting birds anymore.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

When my children grew up, they invited me to teach, and because I was worried about the teacher's meals, I returned to my old job. After more than a year, the child contracted smallpox, his whole body was covered with red pimples, his skin was burned, small iron pellets emerged from the pores of his body [like birdshot bullets] and he died.

COMMENT

Where did those small iron pellets come from? Isn't everything created by the mind?

Making goat meat brings disaster to your child

In Huy Chau, there was a man named Phuong Thuong Hien, a very rich family, with two sons, each of whom asked

his private teacher. The little child was born to his beloved concubine. He loved him very much, so he treated his teacher even more favorably. The teacher, surnamed Dien, liked to eat goat meat, so every day Thuong Hien treated him to this dish, so much so that he always kept three or four goats in the barn, choosing the fattest one to kill.

In the year of the Horse of the Kangxi era,1 that little boy suddenly developed a large ulcer on the front of his neck, cried in pain for half a month but the boil still did not burst. One day, the child suddenly cried out like a goat and died.

NOTE 1

That is the year 1666, the 5th year of the Kangxi era.

COMMENT

The Phuong family has suffered retribution, the Dien family teacher is also unavoidable!

tieu_de: Advise those who are teachers to teach at home
noi_dung:
Advice to those who teach at home

Teaching teachers of course have difficulties, but who knows that the students' families providing food for the teacher is even more difficult. Food and water are clean every morning and night, and it's expensive every day. When the teacher goes out, there are people following him, and when he enters the house, there are people serving him, attentively and attentively. Even taking care of one's parents sometimes has some shortcomings, but teachers really don't dare to complain about the meager food and soup, it's always like that.

People nowadays don't think through such things

so, as soon as they are invited to be a tutor, they immediately think that the owner of the house must naturally serve them according to proper etiquette. For example, if you see someone who is not respectful enough, you will immediately show anger on your face, but as for the student's studies, you will put them aside and not even think about it.

Dare to speak to the wise and wise people with one mind, so that the merit of teaching is greater than the remuneration received, and not allowing the remuneration to be greater than the merit of teaching. For example, if you encounter a student who is really stupid and cannot be taught successfully, you should also think about carrying out the moral theories of cause and effect, good and evil, and many times advising, encouraging, and teaching outside the classroom, so that the homeowner can at least have a successor who is cultivated with good virtue. That is truly the great merit of a teacher.

As far as providing food and drink, it has its own limitations. If the enjoyment ends, then life will also be lost. For example, if you have a thousand coins, if you use a hundred each day, it will last ten days. If more than that number is used, the time must be shorter. You should know that simple vegetable soup is enough to satisfy your heart and increase your longevity; Greedy to eat fat goats and young chickens, truly a fallen person.

For example, we can use the argument of not killing animals to advise and encourage the homeowner, making the entire homeowner's family rely on my advice

worrying about accumulating merit and virtue, it can be said that it is not in vain to receive the provision and care of others.

Cultivation of blessings increases longevity1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Cause and Effect, Eye on the Edge (因果目擊編). (Author's note)

In Fujian, there was a man named Cao Thuan Thong who accepted an invitation to teach for the Trinh family in Dinh Chau. The teacher of the Cao family strictly observed the ten rules and refused to eat all types of fresh fish and meat, for fear that the homeowner might kill him for him. If on the tray there are processed foods such as dried meat, salted fish... then he happily eats them before going home.

NOTE 2

Ten boys: vegetarian for 10 days each month.

In the year of the Monkey in the year of Thuan Tri,3 he suffered from intestinal pain, his whole body was cold for three days and nights, the whole family mourned, and the funeral was prepared. Suddenly he came back to life and told his wife and children: "I should have been killed by rebels in the early summer of Giap Than year,4, but since I taught until now, I truly loved and protected the lives of animals, and the homeowner has never killed any life for me, so my lifespan was increased by a century,5 and I did not have to die unexpectedly. In the summer of Canh year Dan,6 I advised someone to engrave and print three pages of the Vajra Sutra, the lifespan is therefore

NOTE 3

That is the year 1656, the 13th year of Thuan Tri.

NOTE 4

That is the year 1644.

NOTE 5

A century is 12 years.

NOTE 6

That is the year 1650.

an increase of three years. Therefore, up to now we have lived for two more years another year.”

Sure enough, exactly two years later he passed away.

COMMENT

I have a friend in Sung Xuyen,1 who has a benevolent nature and keeps the precepts of not killing. It's just that he can't be a vegetarian, so he [restricts it by] absolutely not eating all types of fresh meat and fish. Friends who wanted to entertain him had to use processed foods such as dried meat, salted fish... Therefore, even if he visited houses that often killed people, no one could kill any life because of him.

NOTE 1

This is now Nantong County in Jiangsu Province.

For example, everyone If you can imitate this, you will never have to suffer the consequences of killing.

Glutton leads to death2

NOTE 2

People in Van Gian all know this story.

In Tung Giang district3 there is a person named Quach Chi Nhat. At the age of 36, he impersonated an exam from a person named Ha, thus being accepted into the school. In the 14th year of Kangxi's reign,4 he accepted an invitation to teach for a certain family. The homeowner saw that the Guo family liked to eat dog meat, so he often killed dogs as meat.

NOTE 3

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

NOTE 4

That is in 1675.

treat. One day, the Quach family pointed to the yellow dog raised in the house and said to the homeowner: "Look at this dog's fat thighs, I wonder if the owner can slaughter it for me?" The homeowner happily complied.

A few days later, Quach suddenly fell into a coma and died. He found himself captured by the devil and led to the Tutelary God temple in that district, and saw that the yellow dog had already arrived there. The god in the temple shouted and asked: "That guy named Ha, why did you incite the owner to kill the dog?" The Quach family argued back: "My last name is Quach, not Ha. That last name is only temporary when going to school." The god turned to reprimand the ghost for capturing the wrong person. The Quach family was then resurrected, recounted the incident, and then boasted of his eloquence.

Not long after, the Ha family suddenly died and found himself being captured and led away by demons. The next morning he came back to life and said: "I was falsely accused of killing a dog by the Quach family. I argued with all my might, saying that I had never eaten buffalo or dog meat. The dog also admitted that it didn't sound like my voice, so I temporarily released him, waiting for the Quach family to come and confront me. But now my lifespan has ended, I'm afraid that the next time I die I won't be able to come back to life." After that, he immediately arranged the housework carefully and died.

That evening, a neighbor of the Quach family was walking on the street when he suddenly saw the Quach family being chained up by a group of ghosts and led back into the city. When he got home, he immediately ran to Quach's house to investigate and heard crying in the house.

DECLARATION

The fish and meat dishes served to the teacher, although the homeowner personally killed them, it was because of the teacher, so the teacher could not help but bear part of the blame. For example, if the teacher insisted on blaming the house owner, and the house owner blamed the teacher, would the murdered animals still have to remain silent and suffer unjustly?

tieu_de: Advice to those who seek fame and fortune
noi_dung:
BOOK TWO

ADVICES
ON CAUSE AND EFFECT
FACTS

Advice to those who seek fame and fortune1

NOTE 1

Below is advice not to kill living things to seek merit.

People in the world who diligently read books, wake up early in the morning, do not sleep late at night, day and night continue. Next, it's just for the sake of gaining fame and career. Fathers advise their children, teachers encourage their students, a whole day is not enough, it is only for the sake of fame and career. But there are people who, when they were still teenagers, passed the exam early and achieved high scores, and there are people who are talented and knowledgeable in ancient and modern literature but never pass the exam. Isn't everything about wealth and lowliness determined by heaven? Since it is determined by heaven, it is natural that those who obey the will of heaven will be helped by heaven, but those who disobey the will of heaven must be eliminated.

Only the precept of not killing, when mentioned by Confucian intellectuals, it is often considered not an urgent matter, but it is only a Buddhist teaching. Alas, it's not just the Buddhists who mercifully protect the lives of all living things, but the Confucianists love killing?

Once upon a time, Mr. Trinh Minh Dao1, when holding the position of district governor in Thuong Nguyen, saw many villagers using glue on the ends of poles to catch birds, so he immediately ordered all those poles to be cut down, and later ordered a complete ban on using poles to catch birds.2

NOTE 1

That is, Trinh Hao (1032-1085), along with his younger brother Trinh Di (1033-1107), developed the doctrine of Zhou Dun Di. The Zhou family and the Trinh family made significant contributions to the doctrine and ideology of Confucianism.

NOTE 2

See this story in the book Song History (宋史). (Author's note)

Like Lu Nguyen Minh3 [also a Confucian] who received the true teachings of the Trinh family, his family for many generations worshiped Buddha, kept the precepts of not killing and often worked to release animals. When he was the district governor,4 always had dried bamboo shoots, dried abalone mushrooms... in his house to use as food, to replace killing animals.5

NOTE 3

That is, Lu Hy Triet (吕希哲), lived during the Northern Song Dynasty.

NOTE 4

The head of a district.

NOTE 5

See in the book Apostolic Sacred Studies (聖學宗傳). (Author's note)

Those Confucians all truly realized that greed for life and fear of death [is the common psychology of all living beings,] is to obey the will of heaven, not to do the opposite. Those who can take the wish [of love for living beings] of heaven and earth as their wish, surely blessings will follow.

I didn't pass the exam because I liked eating clams1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from Long Shu Tinh Do Van (龍舒淨土文). (Author's note)

In the early years of the Song Dynasty, in Tran Giang2, there was a man named Thieu Biao. One day he dreamed that he was going to Minh Phu. The chief mandarin there asked: "Do you know the reason why you have not passed the exam yet?" Thieu Biao replied: "I don't know."

NOTE 2

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

The official immediately took Thieu Biao to a place and saw a large pan full of clams. When those clams saw Thieu Biao coming, they simultaneously called his name. Thieu Biao was so scared that he clasped his hands together and chanted "Amitābha Buddha". The oysters in the pan [after listening to the Buddha's name] all turned into gold sparrows and flew away.

From then on, Thieu Biao vowed to keep the precept of not killing living things. After [he passed the exam,] he became an official of An Phu Su.3

NOTE 3

The An Phu Su official in the Song Dynasty was the head responsible for managing both the military and civil aspects of a locality, also known as the An Phu Su Sutra, often held concurrently by Tri Chau and Tri Prefecture officials.

COMMENT

A person's academic career, although given by heaven, can be unjustly obstructed. If there is any resistance, even the devil cannot stop it. Those who want to have a wide path and a wide career, how can they not think carefully about this?

The Emperor's Dream1

NOTE 1

See in the book Midwifery Border (護生編). (Author's note)

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, there was a scholar in Shu2 named Liu Daozhen. One day, when a guest came to visit, Dao Trinh intended to kill a chicken for the guests, but suddenly he couldn't find the chicken anymore. The guests sat for a long time, Dao Trinh decided to kill a duck as a treat, but at that time the duck was nowhere to be found. Dao Trinh went to look for him and found both the chicken and the duck hiding in a dark place. The duck used his head to push the chicken out, and the chicken also used his head to push the duck out. Both sides tried their best to push each other but they were both silent without a sound.

NOTE 2

That is the Sichuan region.

Luu Dao Trinh observed that scene and suddenly realized. out [that "greed for life and fear of death" is the common psychology of all species]. After that, he immediately wrote the essay "Precepts of Killing" advising people to give up killing living things.

In the seventh month of the year of the Rooster,3 a friend of Liu Dao Trinh had a dream about going to Van Xuong Palace, meeting Emperor Quan, showing him a piece of paper, saying: "This is the article

NOTE 3

That is, is the year 1621.

The text Precepts for killing, advising people to give up killing, was written by Liu Dao Trinh. Dao Trinh will pass this year's exam."

The friend woke up and still remembered, and told the incident to Liu Dao Trinh, but Dao Trinh did not believe it. When the name on the golden board was written, it was true.

CONCLUSION

Animals and humans, although their physical appearance is different, their perception and feeling are no different. Look at when the animals are chased, they also run away in fear, let out pitiful screams, and try their best to climb the fence and climb the wall in the hope of escaping. If we compare it to us humans, when the king orders us to arrest and kill, our parents are terrified and don't know what to do, and our wives and children are pushed into death with no way out. How is that fear any different?

Look again when an animal is killed, like when cutting the blood of a chicken, the whole flock of chickens screams in terror, slaughtering a pig, the whole herd of pigs sadly stops eating. If we compare it to us humans, when faced with chaos and bandits, we see our parents being murdered, our wives and children being kidnapped and taken away, that tragic situation is no different.

And consider when an animal is cut up for slaughter, its intestines and liver are exposed but the breath is still whispering from the mouth, or the throat has been cut off but the eyes are still wide open before they can close. If compared to us humans, when we are in pain and suffering, our whole body is motionless,

only knows how to look, resigned to helplessness, what is the difference?

Therefore, when people hear stories of chickens and ducks pushing each other to avoid death, they must know how heartbroken they are and remember them forever!

Thanks to releasing animals, they can both practice do1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Quang Tu Bien (廣慈編). (Author's note)

Coi Ke district, Zhejiang province, there was a man named Dao Shi Luong. One day, he and Truong Chi Dinh passed by Dai Thien pagoda, and then bought tens of thousands of eels to release.

That year, in the fall, Thach Luong dreamed that a god appeared and said: "You should not have passed this exam, but thanks to the merit of freeing life, you will pass the exam, one department sooner."

When the golden board said the name, it was indeed correct. That's why Thach Luong immediately thought: "The release also depends on Truong Chi Dinh's support, is it possible that only I can enjoy the merit?"

A few days later, a list was brought from Nanjing, it turned out that Truong Chi Dinh also passed.

tieu_de: Advice to those wishing to have children
noi_dung:
Advice to those wishing to have children

Rich people do not have children, many people spend money to marry concubines, and there are also many people who spend money on medical treatment. Even if you wish very passionately, getting your wish is still very difficult. Why is that? Because in general, the karmic consequences have been determined in the Three Realms. If you do not do great good deeds, they cannot be changed. In the past, there were often childless people who, when they understood the truth, made valiant efforts to do good and accumulate virtue, thanks to which they were able to continuously give birth to noble children. There are countless such cases. There are people who pray for children but do not know how to follow that principle, cannot pray for children, then turn to blame heaven and blame others, and lament that there is no one to continue the family line, it is extremely delusional.

Having children thanks to knowing how to release life1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Quang Nhan Luc (廣仁錄). (Author's note)

During the Yuan Dynasty, there was a rich merchant who wanted to pray for a child. He heard that a true man in the Thai mountains could summon gods and predict miracles. He immediately came to worship and ask about praying for a child. He said: "The previous generation killed a lot of living creatures, causing the animals to not be able to maintain their descendants, so

had to suffer the retribution of not having children. Now if you can save eight hundred thousand living creatures, you can change the old sin. If you accidentally kill an insect, you must release a hundred living creatures to make up for it. If you want to change your destiny, this is an essential thing to do quickly. immediately.”

The merchant heard the advice and immediately vowed to keep the precepts not to kill, and spent money to buy animals to release animals. Not long after, she gave birth to a son. After passing the bachelor's exam, he was appointed as an official.

FORDS

The Hoang San Sutra teaches that: "The retribution of killing causes the offender to fall into three evil paths.1 [After exiting there,] if one is born as a human being, one must suffer two types of retribution: one is many diseases, the other is premature death."

NOTE 1

That means the realms: hell, hungry ghosts and animals.

This rich merchant created the karma of killing a lot, and now only suffers the retribution of being childless. It can be known that he must have already suffered the retribution of the three evil paths, now he has the additional retribution of being a childless person. Or if that is not the case, then in his previous life he must have accumulated profound merit and virtue, so today he will first suffer the fate of being a childless person, and later on he will continue to suffer in the three evil paths. Now it is possible to atone for the bad mistakes of the day

NOTE 2

Flower of retribution: retribution depends on right retribution. This type of retribution is not the final result, just like a tree has flowers before it has fruit.

in the past, turning your mind to good will of course avoid harm and increase blessings.

Repenting saves your life1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Induction of Heavenly Fate Theory (感應篇圖說). (Author's note)

Ngo Hang So was from Hangzhou. He often liked to eat buffalo meat, and his sons and daughters died one after another. Later, there was a son who contracted smallpox, and the medicine was ineffective.

One ​​night, Ngo Hang So dreamed that he was going to the underworld. Someone accused him of killing buffalo, but he tried to deny it. The chief mandarin there immediately called the whole herd of buffaloes to smell Hang So's entire body. The buffaloes smelled it and didn't say anything. Ngo Hang So then admitted that he had eaten buffalo meat but in fact had not killed the buffalo, and swore that from now on he would never eat buffalo meat again. The chief immediately called the buffalo herd and told them to leave. Finally, Hang So was released. As soon as he left the mandarin's gate, he saw a small building and someone called his name upstairs. Hang So looked up and suddenly saw something thrown down upstairs, and a voice said: "Give it back to you!" Hang So looked closely, and it turned out to be his son.

Ngo Hang So had just woken up from a dream when his son suddenly recovered from his illness.

COMMENT

Eating buffalo meat alone caused sons and daughters to die one after another, one can clearly see what the retribution would be for killing the buffalo with one's own hands.

If you don't eat buffalo meat, you can raise children1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Midwifery Luc (護生錄). (Author's note)

In the capital, there was a man named Trach Tiet, who was 50 years old and still had no children. He immediately asked someone to paint a picture of the Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara statue and worshiped it, sincerely worshiping and praying.

Not long after, his wife became pregnant. He dreamed that a woman in a white shirt was holding and giving her child, but just as his wife was about to receive it, a buffalo intervened and stopped her, thus not receiving the child. After that, his wife gave birth to a son, but he died just a month old.

Trach Tiet prayed as sincerely as before. Someone saw this and said to him: "You like to eat buffalo meat. That's really cruel. Isn't that the reason?" Trach Tiet suddenly understood, and immediately vowed that his whole family would no longer eat buffalo meat.

Not long after, he dreamed again of a woman holding a child and giving it to him, and immediately accepted it. Afterwards, his wife indeed gave birth to a son and raised him until he grew up.

COMMENT

That is [Bodhisattva Avalokiteshvara] incarnated as a woman preaching the Dharma, [as said in the Universal Gate chapter, Lotus Sutra.]

Eating turtle meat must result in death1

NOTE 1

This story was written by the master himself. Narrated by Vien Ngo Quy.

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, in Hangzhou there was a man named Phan Duc Trai, who was old and still had no children. By chance, I read a book and saw that it was written: "A person who eats turtle meat will give birth to a son." He immediately bought turtles to raise, and used small eels as food for the turtles. After growing up, he kills turtles every day and eats them.

So after more than a year, the whole body swelled and produced many toxic scabies. Each poisonous scabies has many mouths, looking like turtle mouths, painful to the bone. Not long after, he died, and in the end had no children.

COMMENT

Those with wrong views and bad words only harm people temporarily, but writing them in books will harm many future lives. That's exactly what this story is about. Therefore, when it comes to giving treatises or writing books, even a good gentleman must be very cautious, let alone other types of people?2

NOTE 2

For example, there are those who join with the short-sighted Confucians to dispel Buddhism, or circulate remedies that use killing animals, or engrave and print Buddhist scriptures or books that promote good but do not have true understanding and understanding, they themselves make blind theories, causing listeners to doubt or misunderstand... All such people do not know that they have fallen into wrong views, and even lead others into wrong views. It is truly a waste of good hearts and will only create great evil karma, and will definitely fall into evil realms. (Author's note)

tieu_de: Recommended to those who want to avoid accidents
noi_dung:
Advice to those who want to avoid accidents

People in life encounter times of chaos, fleeing to deep mountains, empty fields, and all kinds of emergencies. Looking at the war flag flying in the distance, it must be time for mother and child to separate; When you hear the sound of drums resounding, you will be shocked to death. Such scenes of wandering and separation, although they are the common destiny of the whole country, are not beyond each person's own karma.

Zen Master Tu Tho has a verse that says:

Ordinary people kill,

Should receive the karma of war.

If you kill, you must pay for your life,

Robber, your house will burn down.

Now your wife and children are separated,

Because of digging a cave, your ancestors will be destroyed.

Listen to Buddha's teachings:

Cause and effect all correspond.

Accordingly, regardless of whether you personally encounter disaster or have your house destroyed, everything is due to karma created in advance. Even small things like bleeding a finger or losing a needle, causing

to cause momentary terror, there is nothing that is not caused by a pre-existing cause.

Nowadays, it is widely advised that all people in the world, when faced with the chaos of war, should reflect and reflect on themselves: "I have not yet been tied up but I am already panicking and terrified like this. How much will the animals when they are tied up [waiting to be slaughtered] be panicked and terrified? Now that my family and relatives have not yet been separated but are already this miserable, then the animals will be miserable when they are separated, mother and child are separated. How much harm will it be? My arms and legs have not been cut off yet but I am already in such pain and suffering. How much pain and suffering will the animals feel when they are cut off and cut into pieces?"

After reflecting like that, you will sincerely recite Buddha's name for all the karma of killing in the past, pray for the animals you kill to be saved, and resolve to stop killing in the future.

If you consider and develop your mind like that, you will definitely be born in a peaceful era in the next life, not having to endure chaos. For example, even if you are born in a time of chaos, you are not born in a war zone. Isn't that the best way to avoid accidents? You should know that whether you escape to a high mountain or run to the deep sea, it is not a perfect plan. Therefore, the ancients taught that:

If you want peace in the world,
You must stop eating the flesh of all living beings.

Retribution of killing, encountering hardships

During the reign of King Huy Tong,1 foreign invaders from the north often attacked the Central Plains,2 wherever they went they burned and killed civilians. However, only An Duong town was killed and destroyed most miserably.

NOTE 1

Song Huy Tong reigned from 1100 to 1125.

NOTE 2

Here refers to the army of the Jurchen people. After destroying the Liao Dynasty and establishing the Jin Dynasty, they began to bring troops to fight the Song Dynasty. in 1125.

Later there was a monk who practiced profound concentration and could clearly contemplate and know the cause of events. Many people asked, and he immediately entered contemplation and said: "The people of that area previously committed very heavy karma of killing, so now, in response to the karma, they had to be tragically killed in that same place. But the karma has not ended yet, I'm afraid the entire people of that area are still not at peace."

After that, for many consecutive years of war and fire, the people of that area were massacred many times, and in the end, no one survived.

FOCUS

People in the world see a fisherman catching a big fish and applaud, not knowing that they are creating another grudge. When you see an animal being captured, you feel pity and immediately try to rescue it. I'm afraid it's still too late, let alone appreciating and liking it? To praise that is to praise killing; To enjoy it is to rejoice in killing. If you use your intelligence to

contemplate, these are all seeds that will cause trouble in the future.

Rescue Dragon

Tin the Co Sao area,1 one day the river water suddenly rose very high, not long after it quickly receded down, at the river port there was a very large fish stranded, so heavy that it ten thousand pounds, lay there for three days and died. The people of the whole district came together to cut the meat to eat, only there was only one old woman who did not eat.

NOTE 1

Belongs to Anhui province.

Afterwards, the old woman suddenly met an old man who came and said: "That dead fish is my child. Unfortunately, you met with an accident here. If you only have the compassion to not eat its meat, I will repay you. Pay attention to the stone turtle at the eastern gate of the city. If you see that its eyes are red, you must quickly leave the city. The whole city will be submerged."

The old woman listened and every day she went to the east gate to watch for the stone turtle. A child found it strange and asked, so she told him the truth. The mischievous boy immediately took red lipstick and secretly applied it to the stone turtle's eyes. As soon as the old woman saw that, she hurried out of the city and met a child wearing a blue shirt who greeted her and said, "I am the Dragon King's child." Then took her up a mountain. Sure enough, the whole city sank into a large lake.

COMMENT

During the Buddha's time, there were five great ministers.2

NOTE 2

The scriptures say 大臣五人 - five-member great minister, but An Si Toan Thu engraved with 有一 大臣 - one great minister. However, the next paragraph of the Complete Book of An Si mentions the remaining 4 people.

One ​​night, a person came to invite Buddha to receive food the next day. Buddha did not accept, he left. Later, the king also came to invite Buddha to receive food. Buddha said: "That great minister will die tonight, tomorrow he will no longer be able to create blessings?"1

NOTE 1

We translate according to the scriptures. In the Complete Book of An Si, these details are later reversed.

The mandarin often said to the generals: "I will surely die because of weapons." Therefore, he always kept the soldiers carefully guarded, even when he himself slept with a sword. That night,2 when he was too sleepy, he gave the sword to his wife to keep watch. Not long after, she fell asleep and dropped the sword, cutting off her husband's head. She was startled and shouted in panic: "My husband is dead." When the king heard what happened, he immediately summoned all four remaining ministers and asked: "You all came along to protect us, mainly to prevent criminals from causing trouble. How could his wife commit such a crime? Why didn't you have anyone by your side at that time?" Immediately ordered to punish the crime by cutting off the right arms of all four people.3

NOTE 2

Here, An Si Complete Book has added details: 是夕，有四臣亦在其家防 守 - Passed away, there were four divine herons defending the Ky family. (That night, four great ministers also went to that house to defend.) The scriptures do not mention this, and when the king blames it, it is because these four were not present when the incident happened.

NOTE 3

This section of An Si Complete Book writes differently: “國王聞之，疑四臣與婦有 私 - The king's office, suspecting that the four ministers were cruel to their wives." (The king heard the story and suspected that the four ministers and his wife were plotting.) This difference is not reasonable, because according to the scriptures, the king only punished the criminals for negligence, so he cut off their hands, but the wife was not punished. If they were charged with plotting to kill the minister, the wife could not be innocent, and these four people would not only have their hands cut off.
