A-nan, upon seeing this, immediately asked the reason. Buddha taught: "The husband in his previous life was a child herding goats, and his wife at that time was a white-haired mother goat. Those four ministers were four robbers in the past. When they met the goat-herding child, all four of them raised their right arms to point at the white-haired mother goat and shouted at him to kill the meat for him to eat. The child cried and followed suit, killing the goat for all of them to eat. After many lives and deaths, only now have they met each other again to repay their debt. old.”1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from Miscellaneous Examples Sutra (雜譬喻經), upper volume. (Author's note) We have compared it with the original text of the Sutra in the Mahazheng Pitaka, Volume 4, Sutra No. 206 (total of 2 volumes). This story is in volume 1, on page 516, sheet a, starting from line 25. Considering that there are many details that do not follow the scriptures, when Vietnamese translated it, we edited it.

The fact that the child mischievously smeared red paint on the stone turtle's eyes was also due to karmic conditions, [so the fake story became real]. When the conditions are right, everything will happen naturally, [otherwise] it cannot be forced.

tieu_de: Advise people who eat buffalo and dog meat
noi_dung:
Advice to those who eat buffalo and dog meat2

NOTE 2

Below is advice not to kill animals to nourish themselves.

Advise people not to Eating buffalo and dog meat is better than advising people not to kill buffalo and dogs. Advising

slaughterhouses not to slaughter buffaloes and kill dogs is as good as advising local officials to issue a ban on killing buffaloes and dogs.

Why is that? Advise people not to eat buffalo or dog meat, although in front of us they listen, but when the delicious food is displayed in front of them, how many people can control themselves? So know that advising people not to eat is not the same as advising people not to kill.

Like the slaughtermen, it is very difficult to listen to advice and change, not necessarily one in ten people. If you don't arrest them at the official's door and use strict laws to punish them, then even going to the slaughterhouse every day to advise them will be useless. So why not issue a clear and strict ban, forcing the violent people to immediately put down their hidden knives? What's more, when it comes to banning slaughter, even a poor student can still get it done with the support of military officials. Once the ban sign is hung up, then strictly monitored and controlled, following the rules and regulations, even though we do not advise people not to eat buffalo and dog meat, naturally there will be no more buffalo and dog meat to eat.

Alas, it's a pity that when officials encounter something that brings fame and profit to themselves, they try to do it right away, trying endlessly, but when it comes to banning this slaughter, they keep their mouths shut.

source-heading">The moment of death still repays karma1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Nhan Thi Gia Huan (顏氏家訓). (Author's note) This book was written by Nhan Chan Khanh. He was born in 709, died in 785, was from Linyi, Shandong province, and was once given the title Duke of Lu, so he was also called Yan Lu Cong.

There was a noble in the State of Qi who was given the title of symbolic official.1 had a liberal and extravagant personality, liked to eat buffalo and dog meat, and killed himself every time he ate.

NOTE 1

The original work used 奉朝請 (to serve in court) to refer to a symbolic official who, although periodically participating in court meetings, did not actually hold any powers. This position is often given to people who are distantly related to the king, only for symbolic purposes.

When he was over thirty years old, one day he suddenly saw a large buffalo rushing towards him, immediately his whole body was in pain like a knife, then screamed, went crazy and died.

DECLARATION

Having contributed the most to humans, there is truly no animal more important than buffaloes and dogs. Losing the most yin virtue is no better than eating buffalo or dog meat. Yet people still want to eat buffalo meat and dog meat, I really don't understand why?

Abstain from eating buffalo meat and poinsettia beans2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Quang Tu Hoi Essentials (廣慈會要). (Author's note)

In the Kim Lang region3, there was a man named Chu Chi Phien. When he had not yet passed the exam, one day he dreamed that a god came to tell him: "This year's poinsettia should have been Tu Hy Manh, a person from Tran Giang, but he was due to work

NOTE 3

At that time, it was in Nanjing.

having an affair with a girl was not according to proper etiquette, so you should have been deposed. The next person should have been you, but Tu Hy Manh's whole family has not eaten buffalo meat for three generations, and your father and children have not been able to give up buffalo meat. If you know how to repent, there is still time."

When she woke up from her dream, Chi Phien told her father about it, but his father did not believe it. But then that night, he himself had the exact same dream. At that time, he was scared and immediately swore from then on not to eat buffalo meat again.

That year, Chu Chi Phien indeed passed the poinsettia, while Tu Hy Manh only passed the doctorate, third class.

COMMENT

Some people say, buffalo is an animal for sacrifice, only lucky people can eat it. If we consider this matter, there can be no further excuses.

Demons manifest karma1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Guan Kin Luc (觀感錄). (Author's note)

During the Qing Dynasty, in Wuxi County, Jiangsu Province, there was a clerk named Wang. In the year of the Rooster under the Thuan Tri era,2 because of errors in recording salaries, he was imprisoned and died in Bac Do prison.

NOTE 2

That is the year 1657.

In April of the second year of Kangxi's reign,3 Kim Thai's son, Han Quang, from Suzhou, sailed back to his hometown from the capital. The boat had just passed Truong Gia wharf and suddenly heard someone calling:

NOTE 3

That is the year 1663.

“I am a member of the Wang family from Wuxi, please let me go on the boat.” Han Quang agreed and sent the boat in, but saw no one. The boat left and heard the same call as before. When Han Quang asked, he heard Vuong's voice answer truthfully: "I am a ghost who died unjustly. Your boat is parked too far from shore so I can't get on." The people on the boat were frightened when they heard this. The ghost named Vuong immediately said: "It's okay, let me sit on the side of the boat."

Han Quang pulled the boat close to the shore, and immediately heard someone jumping on the boat. Not long after the boat sailed, I suddenly heard a ghost scream. Han Quang asked what was going on, and the ghost replied: "I left my small bag on the riverbank. In it there is a book recording my salary and expenses. When I get home, someone will question me. I need to take that as evidence. Please let me go back to get it." Han Quang immediately complied.

After that, the boat continued for three days, when it was about to get dark, suddenly I heard a ghost say: "Please stop the boat, there is a group of boys on the shore, I want to attend."

Han Quang did not understand and asked: "What is Pho Trai?" The ghost replied: "People in everyday life call it almsgiving, which means giving away food." Han Quang immediately stopped by the boat to let the ghost go. As soon as he left, he immediately came back and said: "Bodhisattva Avalokiteśvara is the leader of the altar. There is no food for me, because in the past I liked to eat buffalo meat. Whenever the Bodhisattva leads the altar, all those who love buffalo meat are not allowed to eat."

Han Quang was frightened when he heard this and said: "Is there really such a thing? I usually eat buffalo meat, from now on I would like to give up."

A moment later, I heard the sound of a demon crying loudly. Han Quang asked what the matter was, the ghost replied: "Because you have made up your mind to keep the precepts of not eating buffalo meat, the god of precepts from heaven is about to come, I can no longer be here." Han Quang immediately asked: "So how did you get home?" The devil replied: "I have to wait for another boat." Han Quang stopped the boat, the ghost quietly left.

FOR DECLARATION

The Buddha's Yoga Dharma of giving food has the ability to save the two realms of heaven and human: above are the eight classes of heavens and dragons, 1 below are the beings in the three realms of hell, hungry ghosts, animals, all are within the wide scope of this dharma of giving food. Is it possible that there is a Bodhisattva who is the leader of the herd but a person who loves to eat buffalo meat is not allowed to give food? That ghost named Vuong is not allowed to eat, that is due to his own karma causing him to become a private person.

NOTE 1

The eight classes of heaven and dragon (thien dragon eight classes): refer to the 8 realms of living beings including: gods, dragons, asuras, ca-lau-la, hyena-la, ma-ha-la-old, humans and non-human species.

For example, hungry ghosts, going through For many lifetimes, they have not heard the name "water". Even if they walk on water and look at it, they can only see that it is all blood and pus. Isn't it because of their karma that it became like that?

Once upon a time, Venerable Maudgalyayana used his heavenly eyes to look around the world, saw his deceased mother in the realm of hungry ghosts, and immediately brought her a bowl of rice. When his mother received it, she immediately used her left hand to cover the bowl [for fear of other ghosts seeing it], and with her right hand she picked up the rice. As soon as she put the rice in her mouth, the rice immediately turned into charcoal. Maudgalyayana cried in pain and sought help from the Buddha. Buddha taught: "Your mother's sin is serious, no one person's strength can save her. Although your filial piety touches heaven and earth, even heaven and earth demons cannot help in this matter. You should rely on the mighty power of the monks in the ten directions, only then can your mother be liberated."

The Venerable Maudgalyayana immediately organized a great Buddhist work, making offerings to all the monks in the ten directions. His mother was immediately freed from the suffering of hungry ghosts that day.1

NOTE 1

This story is told in the Vu Lan Bon Sutra. (Author's note)

Accordingly, the fact that the ghost named Vuong cannot eat is not due to his own karma?

Someone asked: "If that's the case, then giving food in the real world won't be of any use?" Answer: "The relationship between sentient beings and the Buddha Dharma is divided into two categories: one is predestined, the other is undesired. Those beings who have predestined conditions will certainly be imbued with grace. If they cannot receive it, it is undesired. [Like

so, there are people without predestined conditions, there are also people with predestined conditions,] we cannot insist on a single reason to discuss things."1

NOTE 1

As long as you have faith in Buddhism, you will become a predestined person. Not having faith in Buddhism is ungrateful. How can we not develop faith in Buddha Dharma early? (Author's note)

Making fun of Buddhism soon leads to disaster2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Phenomenon of Sui Luc (現果隨錄). (Author's note)

In Ma Thanh3 there are two people who have passed the bachelor's degree, one believes wholeheartedly in Buddha, the other criticizes blasphemy. One day, the two of them were reading books together in the temple of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva, when suddenly someone brought dog meat to offer. The person who believed in Buddha immediately waved his hand and told him to go somewhere else, not allowing him to enter the temple, but panicked and ran out the door.

NOTE 3

Belongs to Hubei province.

The person who blasphemed the Buddha saw this and immediately said: "I follow Confucian learning, I don't know anything about Buddhism or Taoism." Then he climbed up to the high throne, mockingly picked up the meat and fed it into the Bodhisattva's mouth. But as soon as he lifted his chopsticks, he felt a force pushing him in mid-air, causing him to fall to the ground and die immediately.

A moment later, the bachelor who had avoided the door also fell dead. Right at that moment, he saw the person who blasphemed Buddha suffering hundreds of punishments, wearing a fiery red shackle around his neck, his entire body being burned by fierce fire.

King of Hell told the person who believed in Buddha: "You have faith, you should not have come to this place. I will take you

coming here is to want you to see that person suffer a miserable punishment, so that you can tell the story to the world.” Having spoken and ordered him to return to the earthly world, he immediately came back to life.

COMMENT

Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva in this Saha world made a great vow: "If there is a sentient being who has not yet been liberated, I consider myself as having pushed them into the pit."

The World-Honored One when preaching in heaven. Dao-li praised Bodhisattva Ksitigarbha saying: "For example, if the Buddhas of the ten directions all praised your merits, even after thousands of eons, they would not be exhausted." The Buddha taught again: "For example, if there are heavenly beings who have enjoyed all the blessings and show the five signs of deterioration, 1 are about to fall into evil realms such as hell, hungry ghosts, and animals. If they see the image of Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and wholeheartedly admire and worship, they will not fall into evil realms and receive increased blessings in the heavens."

NOTE 1

When the heavenly beings run out of blessings and are about to die and be reborn in another realm, they show five signs of decline. These are: 1. Clothes are often dirty; 2. Hair is messy, flowers on head are withered; 3. The body is smelly and dirty; 4. Under the armpits often sweat; 5. Not liking one's throne or seat.

The Buddha also taught that: "If there are any sentient beings who dedicate themselves to making offerings to Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva and do not turn back throughout their lives, then in their future lives they will often be born in the heavenly realms and enjoy bliss. When the blessings of the heavenly realms are exhausted and are born in the human realm

then they will become emperors for hundreds of thousands of eons. king.1

NOTE 1

The above are all recorded in the Ksitigarbha Bodhisattva Sutra (地藏菩薩本願經). (Author's Commentary) This sutra consists of 2 volumes, classified in the Mahaskaya Pitaka, in Volume 13, sutra number 412, page 412. 777, sheet c.

Alas, the Great Being has such inconceivable divine power, his reputation shakes throughout countless worlds, his majestic power conquers millions of gods, all sentient beings who hear his name and see his image will be rewarded with great blessings, yet the stupid, filthy, and shallow-minded ordinary person dares to slander, like using the light of a firefly to compare with the brilliance of the sun, using the wings of a fly. covering the whole sky, you really don't know how to measure yourself!

tieu_de: Advise people not to eat crab
noi_dung:
Advising people not to eat crabs

People who hear about the sufferings in hell think it's a vague thing, not knowing that when people boil crabs to eat, it is the scene of the great Phi Thang hell [described in the scriptures], just because people have become accustomed to doing it so they consider it a normal thing. recognizable.

When the firewood first caught fire, the temperature in the pot gradually heated up, the crabs in the pot began to be frightened, and their whole bodies felt increasingly uncomfortable. Then the water in the pot became hotter and hotter, the whole herd of crabs crawled around in disorder, each one wanting to find a way out. A moment later, the water became even hotter, and that was it

The flock back and forth became entangled, the consciousness fell into a coma. At that time, rising to the surface of the water was unbearably hot and painful, sinking to the bottom of the pot was also unbearably hot and painful, lying still and layered on top of each other was also unbearably hot and painful. Not long after, the water in the pot boiled, and there was boiling water all around his body. Boiling water entered the eyes, like a hot iron nail piercing the eyeball; Boiling water on the back, like molten iron heating the whole body. Enduring such suffering and pain is beyond words, only to hold on to resentment and die, the whole body turning red.

Alas, people just for the sake of a moment's delicious food create such a heavy and deep karma that has no bounds. For example, if the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas use their heavenly eyes to observe this matter, they will clearly see that humans and crabs, from countless lifetimes up to now, have all been each other's parents, brothers, relatives, and relatives, but because of the constant reincarnation and transformation, they cannot know each other. That's why we go back and forth in samsara, taking turns creating karma, killing each other, until we avenge each other endlessly.

Dare to give broad advice to all, if you want to develop a compassionate mind, you must first strongly practice tolerance, do not do to others what you do not want.1 Put yourself in the situation of all people

NOTE 1

The original work uses “先行強恕 – first action strong stuff”. The word th (恕) here is based on Confucian ideas and comes from the teachings of Confucius. The book Analects, chapter Ve Linh Cong, section 23 tells the story of Tu Cong asking Confucius: "Is there a word that can be followed for the rest of your life?" (有一 言而可以終身行之者乎？) Confucius replied: “There is a second word: Do not do to others what you do not wish for yourself.” (其恕乎！己所不欲，勿施於人。) Therefore, the word "second" is understood according to Confucianism as "seeing others as oneself", or "putting oneself in the situation of others". From this fundamental perspective, the virtue of tolerance is formed, being able to tolerate and forgive others because of understanding their situation.

If we contemplate the species, greed will be transformed into loving kindness.

Suffer retribution in the mountain of crabs1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Nam Duong Quang Ky (南陽廣記). (Author's note)

In Hu Chau2 there was a physician named Sa Tuoc Giao. His mother loved eating crabs and killed countless crabs. In the 11th year of Shaoxing's reign,3 she became seriously ill and passed away. After that, a young grandchild saw her standing outside the door, her body covered in blood, and said to him: "You killed too many crabs when you were alive, and now you have to suffer retribution in the crab mountain. Tell your father to quickly do good deeds and dedicate them to me." As soon as he finished speaking, he was nowhere to be seen.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Zhejiang province.

NOTE 3

That is the year 1147.

DECLARATION

People make salted crab, catch the crab while it's still alive, remove the bib and then season it with salt and pepper. The pain and suffering that that crab had to endure was unimaginable! The retribution in the mountain of crabs is brought about by karma.

Observing a crab crawling across the ground, you can know

that in your previous life you must have been accustomed to following the path of wrong views, not following the right path of Bodhi. Looking at the strap on your back, you can know that in your previous life you must have let yourself be bound by desires, not freed from emotional attachments and afflictions. That is: "If you want to know the causes of previous lives, look at the results of this life."

tieu_de: Advise people not to eat frogs
noi_dung:
Advising people not to eat frogs

Those who catch frogs are mostly ignorant fishermen. Advise them to keep the precept of not killing, but they themselves will not listen. But the world has so many strange delicacies, but the number of frogs left is very small, [how can you kill them to eat?]

If the number of people who eat frog meat can be reduced, then the number of people who catch them will also naturally decrease. Therefore, people should be advised not to eat frog meat, please consider carefully.

Frogs cry unjustly1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Hien Qua Luc (現果錄). (Author's note)

The Vuong family held the position of official Dong Tri,2 was originally from Suzhou. One day while staying in Cu Dung,3 suddenly saw a group of frogs jumping right in front of him. Vuong Dong Tri immediately told them: "If there is indeed something unjust, please tell me where it is."

NOTE 2

Dong Tri: an assistant official to chiefs and deputies.

NOTE 3

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

The frogs then immediately gathered in one place. Vuong Dong Tri ordered his subordinates to dig down there and immediately discovered a corpse still intact, with a whip in his mouth, with a person's name engraved on the handle of the whip.

Vuong Dong Tri sent a translator to Dan Duong, used that surname to investigate once, and immediately found and arrested the murderer, a driver. Upon questioning, the situation became clear. Originally, there was a businessman who bought frogs to release, and because he revealed the money he was carrying, this money-grubbing driver killed him. Vuong Dong Tri immediately sentenced the driver to pay his life. Jiangsu people often call him King Frog in this incident.

COMMENT

When a frog is killed by someone, it must endure the suffering of eight small hells. When humans kill frogs, they create the cause of the eight small hells:

- When the frog is slaughtered by humans, it is first cut down

top. That is the first small hell: the hell of beheading.

- After cutting, immediately skin the frog. That's the second small hell

: hell of skin peeling.

- Next, cut off all four legs. That is the third small hell

: the hell of cutting off the feet.

- Then the intestines are ripped out. That is the fourth

small hell: the hell of gutting.

- Once done, put it in the pot and cook over hot heat. That is the fifth small hell

hell: boiling oil hell.

- Season the pot to taste. That is the sixth small hell

six: salted hell.

- Put it in your mouth and chew it greedily. That is the seventh small

hell: the crushed stone hell. - Swallow into the intestines, mixed with unclean things. That is

the eighth lesser hell: the filth hell.

According to the above consideration, the person who catches frogs to sell is self-creating the cause of the first four hells, that is self-action. As for the last four hells, although you don't do it yourself, you make others do it, that is teaching others.

For people who buy frogs to eat, the first four hells are making others do it, [because if you don't buy it then no one else will catch the frog,] that is teaching othering. The last four hells are self-created causes, that is self-action.

If a person himself catches frogs to eat, that is self-creation of the causes of all eight types of hell, all of which are self-action.

If one does not catch frogs nor eat frog meat, but when it comes to catching frogs to eat other people's meat, one does not object but follows along, causing allowing others to do it conveniently, that is also the cause of the eight hells but by teaching others.

If you can contemplate clearly like that, you will know that the eyes see, the ears hear, the mouth speaks, the hands do, every movement in life [if not aware] constitutes a sin

karma. Therefore, this Saha world has all five impurities,1 it is not easy to live!

NOTE 1

Five impurities (five evil world impurities): including impurities in life, impurities in views, impurities in afflictions, impurities in living beings and impurities in life.

tieu_de: Advice to those wishing to increase longevity
noi_dung:
Advice to those who wish to increase longevity2

NOTE 2

Below is advice not to kill living things to pray for healing.

Human beings inherently cherish life. living and terrified of death, it is logical to understand that the tendency to "avoid danger and seek safety" is the same in all species. We and animals both receive the atmosphere of heaven and earth. If we know how to love all things created by heaven and earth, then heaven and earth will also love our life. If we wish for animals to live, then animals will also wish for us to live.

People today from childhood to adulthood, from adulthood to old age, there is no stage in which they do not kill animals.

As soon as the baby comes out of the mother's womb, the whole family immediately thinks it is a fun thing to kill animals to celebrate. Not long after he was a month old, he killed an animal because he was celebrating. When it's time to give up, they kill animals to celebrate. When I grow up, I invite my teacher to teach me and also kill animals to treat me. When discussing marriage, from the house visit to the wedding ceremony, in all ceremonies, there is always the killing of offerings. What's more, when I give birth to a grandchild, the grandchild will be full month old, give birth, invite a teacher to teach, and take care of marriage... so on, there is never a time without a reason to kill the living thing.

A person who gives birth to a daughter cannot help but kill her life when she gets married. Those who believe in heretical teachings and make offerings to ghosts and gods must kill their lives. People who are hospitable and entertaining must kill animals. People with many diseases [need to be nourished] as well as greedy people who kill their lives for the sake of delicious food. There are also times when walking on the road where you can't help but accidentally step on insects, or while doing your job to make a living, there are times when you can't avoid harming the lives of all living things, or when you see others killing and are happy to follow, or praise and encourage...

In one lifetime, the lives we kill must number hundreds, thousands, tens of thousands... Based on these things, if we pray for longevity, is it possible?

I would like to advise all people, if you want to increase your lifespan, you must first keep the precept of not killing. If you keep the precepts, your life will naturally increase.

Save ants to increase longevity1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Sutra of Different Forms (經律異相). (Author's note)

Once upon a time, there was a monk who had attained six miraculous powers and lived with a novice monk. He entered contemplation and saw that the novice monk would die in just seven days. He immediately told him to return to his hometown to visit his parents. On the eighth day, he would return to the temple, wishing that the novice monk could die in his hometown.

Unexpectedly, on the eighth day, the novice monk returned to the temple alive.

The Bhikkhu immediately entered concentration and contemplated the cause. Only then did he realize that the novice monk was on his way home when he suddenly encountered an ant nest that was about to be flooded by rising water. He immediately took off his robe and covered it around to save him, thanks to which the entire colony of ants was saved. Thanks to this, the novice monk not only did not die prematurely, but later lived to be 80 years old, achieving Arahantship.

COMMENT

In the sutras it is taught: "Those who do not kill will receive the retribution of a long life." Seeing the story of this novice monk makes you believe in his words even more deeply.

Save the fish and escape from sin1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Phap Uyen Chau Lam (法苑珠林). (Author's note)

During the Tang Dynasty, in Weizhou district, there was a man named Ma Jia Yun. In the spring of Trinh Quan's sixth year,2 Ma Gia Van suddenly saw two people riding horses coming to pick him up, and immediately fell down and died. At that time, Gia Van found himself being taken to meet their master, that is, Dong Hai Cong. This person intended to invite him to hold the position of Ky Nha official.3 Ma Gia

NOTE 2

That is in the year 632.

NOTE 3

Ky Ky: ancient official in charge of matters related to documents, books, and documents lawsuit.

Van refused, citing his poor education. Dong Hai Cong insisted, he immediately recommended a writer, Tran Tu Luong, to replace him. Ma Gia Van was then brought back to life, while Tran Tu Luong suddenly fell down and died.

One ​​day, Ma Gia Van was walking with a friend and suddenly looked up into the sky with a frightened expression. When his friend saw this, he asked, "I saw a messenger from Dong Hai Cong coming to Ich Chau to arrest people. The messenger told me that Tran Tu Luong had finished denouncing you, so it seemed like you almost couldn't escape the crime. But before, when you were in Thuc land,1 you once saw fish in the lake about to be captured and killed, so you spent ten sheets of silk to save them. Thanks to that, you were not arrested just now."

NOTE 1

Means Sichuan region.

Later, Ma Gia Yun worked as a teacher at Quoc Tu Giam school until the end of his life.

COMMENT

When Emperor Taizong resided at the Jiu Cheng palace2 When he heard about this, he immediately sent the mandarin Sam Van Ban to ask, thanks to which he knew clearly.

NOTE 2

Jiu Cheng Palace: a large palace in the Tang Dynasty, located in the west of Lan Du district in Shaanxi province, formerly the Ren Tho palace of the Sui dynasty. In the fifth year of Trinh Quan's reign, Emperor Thai Tong restored it and renamed it Cuu Thanh palace.

Life expectancy increases when dying3

NOTE 3

Excerpted from the book Truc double tam pen (竹窗三筆). (Author's note)

In Hoa Dinh1 there was a man named Trieu To. One day, when he went to Thanh Pho to visit relatives, he suddenly saw his dead servant standing on a boat. He was scared, went to ask, the person said: "I am currently the agent of the underworld, today I am here to arrest 3 people. One is in Ho Quang, the other is the relative you went to visit." Asked more about the third person, he remained silent and did not answer. Trieu To suspected that the third person was himself.

NOTE 1

This is Tung Giang, Shanghai.

Next, as soon as I arrived at my relative's house, I heard the sound of wailing from afar. The Trieu family was frightened and immediately returned. On the way, he met the old servant again and said: "Don't be afraid, if I don't come tonight, you will be saved." Trieu To asked the reason, the person replied: "Because on the way I met a person who argued for you, saying that your whole family kept the precept not to kill."

At night, sure enough, there was still no sign of that person coming, Trieu To was safe and sound.

COMMENT

That was [thanks to keeping the precept not to kill which] are protected by the gods.

Moderation in diet increases longevity2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the Theory of Heavenly Induction (感應篇圖說). (Editor's note)

There was a successor official3 named Tieu Chan, who was a child

NOTE 3

The position of assistant officer to the district command.

dreamed one day that someone came and said, "You will only live until you are eighteen."

When his father was appointed governor of Shu,1 he followed to take office. The local mandarin held a banquet to celebrate the marshal's inauguration. He also followed his father to attend. He happened to pass by the kitchen and saw a dairy cow tied there, so he asked. The chef replied: "According to the custom in this region, after entertaining for three weeks, a dish of 'jade chopsticks' will be offered. The way to make this dish is to use iron chopsticks to burn red hot and then pierce the breast of a dairy cow. The cow's milk flows out and condenses on the chopsticks, creating a very delicious tasting dish."

NOTE 1

This means Sichuan region.

He was frightened when he heard it, so he quickly went to report it to his father. His father asked the kitchen to bring the menu up to preview, and seeing that it was true, he immediately abolished it and ordered a permanent ban on this cruel dish.

That year, Tieu Chan was just seventeen years old, and he dreamed that a god came and said: "You have great virtue, not only can you avoid premature death, but you can also live a long life." Later, Tieu Chan indeed lived to be over ninety years old.

COMMENT

From a food that can [initiate compassion] increase life expectancy, from the same food [if there is no compassion] life expectancy must be reduced!

tieu_de: Advice to physicians
noi_dung:
Advice to those who work as physicians

The reason why the profession of medicine is valuable is because it can save people. However, medicine can only cure diseases but cannot create life. If you use the method of killing living things to help nourish a sick person, not only will the illness become more cruel, but the retribution of suffering in your own future cannot be avoided. Why is that? Whether people or animals are greedy for life and afraid of death, there is no difference. If we kill one life to save another, a virtuous person would not be willing to do it, let alone kill just one life? What's more, it's still not certain that people can be saved?

If the illness has reached the point where it's incurable and you can't sit back and watch, you should use the Pure Land method to advise and help people permanently escape life and death. Isn't it great to be able to help like that?

Normally, people who are sick will easily accept good advice. Normally, we can aggressively refute and not believe in Buddhism, but when the ice melts and our lives are in danger, we can take that opportunity to wholeheartedly advise and guide people to transform. That is the most magical remedy.

Editing the book of atonement1

NOTE LIKE 1

Excerpted from the Book of Liang (梁書). (Author's note)

Dao Hoanh1 Canh, self-name is Thong Minh. His mother, whose last name was Hoac, dreamed that an angel brought an incense burner to her house, and then gave birth to him. At the end of Liu Song's reign,2 he was invited to become a Thi Doc, a teacher of royal families and princes. In the Qi dynasty, around the reign of Yongming,3 he took off his royal clothes and hung them at Than Vu Mon, left his officials and went to hide in Hoa Duong cave in Cu Khuc mountain.

NOTE 1

An Si Complete Book uses the word Hoang (宏), there are also books that record this person's name using the character Hoang (弘).

NOTE 2

The Liu Song Dynasty died in 466.

NOTE 3

The Yongming era of the Qi Dynasty lasted from about 483 to 493.

He and King Liang Emperor Wu4 once had an affair, and the king always came to ask him about important matters of state. Contemporaries called him "the prime minister in the mountains".

NOTE 4

Emperor Wu's real name was Tieu Dien, born in 464, died in 549. He founded the Liang dynasty and ruled from 502 until his death.

Dao Henh Canh had a student named Hoan Khai, who attained enlightenment and attained enlightenment, escaped the world.5 One day, Dao Hoanh Canh suddenly saw Hoan Khai appear and tell him: "The medicine book edited by the teacher used some insects as medicine. Although it was beneficial for humans, it killed animals, so God blamed him."

NOTE 5

Legend has it that this man practiced the Tao.

Dao Hoanh Canh felt sorry when he heard that and immediately rewrote the book, using plant medicinal herbs instead. He specially composed three more books to atone for his old mistakes. He also went to the stupa worshiping Buddha's relics

in Mau district and observed the Five Precepts. That tower was previously built by King Ashoka.

He once dreamed that he received a prediction from the Buddha, whose name was Bodhisattva Thang Long. When he was about to die, he used a cassock to cover his body and passed away peacefully, at the age of 85, taking the title of Trinh Bach.

COMMENT

Killing animals to save people, people in the world see it as not morally wrong, but because of that, they are blamed by heaven, how scary!

tieu_de: Advise people not to fight snakes
noi_dung:
Advising people not to hit snakes1

NOTE 1

Below is advice for small things and not killing living creatures.

People all believe that snakes are harmful creatures. Some people are afraid that they won't be able to kill them all. They even think that fighting a snake without killing it will cause disaster later on. But we don't consider carefully that if we don't fight to death, we're afraid the snake will retaliate, so wouldn't the hatred be even deeper if we beat them to death? It's just that people's understanding of life is very small and shallow, they only know about this life, not about the next life, so the notion of annihilation arises, thinking that everything only happens in this one life and then ends.

Moreover, if a snake harms us, there must be a cause from a previous life. If there is no cause in a previous life, the snake will certainly not harm us. Why should we worry about the snake causing harm to us before killing it? For example, if a snake wants

If you harm me, don't kill it. Why is that? That snake must have been harmed by me in the previous life, so I came to take revenge in this life. If I kill it, the previous life's hatred will be considered unrequited, and it will add to this life's hatred. Isn't that creating a cause to suffer disaster in two more lives? Why don't people think carefully?

Burning the snake's den is the retribution for destroying the clan1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Hieu Sinh Luc (好生錄). (Author's note)

Phuong Hieu Nho was from the Ming dynasty.2 When his father was preparing the ground to rebury his ancestors' graves, he dreamed of an old man wearing a red shirt coming to bow and bow with his hands together and say: "The burial place you have chosen is our place. I hope you will postpone it for 3 days, wait for all my descendants to be able to move to another place and then move on." I will repay you wholeheartedly in the future.” After speaking, he bowed his head and bowed three times.

NOTE 2

Phuong Hieu Nho was born in 1357, died in 1402, his real name was Hy Truc, Hy Co, nickname Ton Chi, was a famous master, respected by people as Mr. Cau Thanh. This person's name appeared once in the lower volume of the Extensive Explanation of the essay Sound Quality, section "If the road has been bumpy for many years, contribute to repairing and leveling it" and was engraved with the character Nho (儒), but in this part it is engraved with the character Nhu (孺). We still read it as Phuong Hieu Nho like the previous part to create consistency for readers to follow, because this is just one person.

Phuong Hieu Nho's father woke up and did not believe it, thought it was just a dream, and immediately continued to have people dig the grave. When digging up the ground, there were hundreds of red snakes, so they burned them all to death. That night, I dreamed that the old man appeared, crying and saying: "I sincerely prayed to you, why did you make all 800 of my descendants die in a fierce fire? You destroyed my entire family, I will also destroy your entire family."

After he gave birth to Phuong Hieu Nho, the tip of his tongue had a flexible shape like a snake. Hieu Confucian became an official with the position of Han Lam Academician, offended Minh Thanh To, the king ordered the death of ten families.1 Counting all those killed was equal to the number of snakes who died before.

NOTE 1

Phuong Hieu Confucianism was illustrious and extremely learned, so when King Yen Chu Le won the emperor's throne from his nephew Chu Doan Van, ascending the throne and taking the title Minh Thanh To, immediately summoned Phuong Hieu Nho to the palace to write a decree to ascend the throne. Hieu Nho definitely did not write. The king threatened to kill all 9 families, Hieu Nho firmly replied: "Even if he killed all 10 families, he would not write." The king ordered someone to force the pen into his hand, and Hieu Nho immediately wrote four words: "The Yen invaders usurp the throne." The king was angry and ordered them to be executed in the middle of the market, killing all 9 families, and also looking for more disciples and disciples to kill, to make up 10 families.

DECLARATION

Buddha taught that: "A child is born with three predestined conditions: One is that the parents in the previous life once owed the child, two is that the child in the previous life once owed debt to the parents, three is that due to a grudge in the previous life, they were born as a child."2 People in the world only know that children who indulge in gambling and alcohol are unjust families, not knowing that there are children who achieve great power and then cause disaster to the entire family, that is also a crime. injustice family. People only know those who

NOTE 2

See in the Sutra of the Twelve Causes and Conditions. (Author's note) However, this exact excerpt is in the A-ham oral commentary on the Twelve Sutras of Dependent Origination (阿含口解十二因緣經), classified in the Mahazheng Pitaka, Volume 25, Sutra No. 1508, page 53, sheet a, lines 18 and 19.

Children who make their parents lose face and humiliate their families are unjust family members, but not knowing that there are children who honor their ancestors, brighten their clan, and enjoy thousands of generations of sacrifices, that is also unjust family. People fight to plunder property, everyone is calculating for their future descendants. But if we think carefully about the future outcomes, then what is the benefit of having many children and grandchildren now? A lifetime of hard work and pain in accumulating money will only make you suffer in vain. Trying to take the property of this or that person, so that in the next life those same people will be born as your children, causing you to lose your fortune and go bankrupt. As long as people continue to see things in a crazy way, they will still be bound and tied together. How terrifying it is to be forever immersed in delusion without waking up!

The dead snake is saved1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Truc song essay (竹窗隨筆). (Author's note)

Mr. Cao Lu Xuyen in Suzhou had a daughter who married into the Van family. One day, a snake chased a pigeon. The servants saw it and immediately beat it to death. A few days later, the snake possessed the soul of Cao Lu Xuyen's daughter, borrowed her body and said: "I was originally the governor of Kinh Chau. When Hau Canh rioted, 2 chased me to the riverbank, I fell into the river and died, not knowing my parents,

NOTE 2

The Hau Canh Rebellion took place from August 548 to January 4 year 552, against the Liang dynasty. The war in Jingzhou occurred around the year 551.

will my wife and children be safe at this time?

Cao Lu Xuyen was frightened when he heard this and said: "Hou Canh is a person of the Six Dynasties,1 now the Ming Dynasty, who has gone through the Tran, Sui, Tang, and Song dynasties. Nguyen.” At that time, the ghost realized that he had been dead for too long, and immediately said: "I had to be born as a snake, now I die without any resentment. I only hope that you will hold a repentance ceremony for me, recite a set of Luong Hoang Bao Sam, and I will leave."

NOTE 1

The Six Dynasties is a period of Chinese history consisting of 6 successive dynasties. They are: 1. Cao Wei (220-265), 2. Jin (265-420), 3. Liu Song (420-479), 4. Southern Qi (479-502), 5. Liang (502-557), 6. Chen (557- 589).

Cao Lu Xuyen held a repentance ceremony After that, the ghost asked to be offered a vegetarian meal, so Lo Xuyen immediately set up a food giving platform according to the Yoga of Diem Mouth method. The next day, the daughter was as normal as before.

COMMENT

Human life revolves around life and death like breathing in and out, momentarily entering the fetus, momentarily leaving the fetus, until momentarily going through countless times of entry and exit like that. Born without knowing where it came from, dying without knowing where it will go, being obscure for thousands of generations and still not knowing. One moment he was born in heaven, one moment he fell into hell; Suddenly becoming a hungry ghost, an animal, becoming a human, becoming a god... going up and then sinking, sinking down and going up again, after thousands of years and thousands of lives, we still don't know.

Once upon a time, Mr. Tu-dat was once in a retreat

with the Buddha, the Buddha pointed to an ant crawling on the ground and said to him: "This ant has been around since the birth of Buddha Vaibhava until now. After seven Buddhas were born, it is still falling as an ant."1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Sutra of Wise and Dependent Cause and Effect. (Author's note)

Normally, each Buddha was born over a very long period of time, let alone seven Buddhas? After Śākyamuni Buddha was born, it took more than 1,725,000 years for Bodhisattva Maitreya to be born from the Tushita heaven.2 I don't know whether the ant had escaped the view of the body by then?

NOTE 2

See the Sutra of Maitreya's birth. (Author's note)

Accordingly, considering that the snake in this story, from the Six Dynasties period until now3 has been able to escape from the snake body, it is not slow. Alas, if reincarnation is so terrifying, if one refuses to develop the mind to seek rebirth in the Pure Land to escape forever, is there no different from the ignorant animals drifting in the great ocean of birth and death?

NOTE 3

That is during the time of Mr. An Si, Qing Dynasty. According to the story, Cao Luchuan lived during the Ming Dynasty.

tieu_de: Advise people not to raise crickets or ornamental fish
noi_dung:
Advising people not to keep crickets or ornamental fish

The Sutra of the Dharma of Mindfulness teaches that:

Human life does not last long,

Like clapping hands loudly.

Wife, children and property,

Neither can be taken with you.

There are only good and evil karma,

Often following and not leaving.

Like birds flying in the sky. high,
The shadow does not leave the ground.1

NOTE 1

The Sutra on the Foundation of Mindfulness of the Dharma (正法念處經), a total of 70 volumes, is classified in the Mahaskaya Canon of Volume 17, Sutra No. 721. This verse belongs to volume 1, page 5, sheet c, starting from line 25, the content has some sentences omitted from the original.

So know that, although raising crickets or ornamental fish is pleasing to the eye for a moment, in the end it has no benefit, only creating evil karma of killing that will forever follow us. Why do we have to suffer so much to satisfy the eyes that watch and then end up holding eternal grudges and eternal enmity with those animals?

Red Worm Retribution2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Hieu Sinh Luc (好生錄). (Author's note)

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, in Wuxi County3 there was a person named Tiet Tu Lan who loved raising goldfish, often catching red worms to feed the fish. Just like that, countless worms were killed. Later, Tu Lan suffered from a strange illness. Her hands were clawing all over her body, as if she were constantly grabbing something and throwing it, saying, "Oh, there are thousands of red worms crawling on my body." He groaned in unbearable pain, scratched his whole body and died.

NOTE 3

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

COMMENT

Once upon a time, General Bach Khoi dug a hole to bury alive

Zhao army, killing 400,000 people in just one night. Xiang Yu buried the Qin army alive, killing 200,000 troops in one night. The rebel army of Truong Hien Trung in Sichuan cut off people's limbs and piled them into mountains. At times like these, let's look at the flesh and blood of living beings when they rot. What is the difference between humans and those red worms?

Alas, people who die from war and swords must have created causes in the past; People who raise animals and then kill them will surely suffer retribution in the future. Therefore, there is a saying: “Bodhisattvas fear the cause, sentient beings fear the effect.”1

NOTE 1

The Bodhisattva understands and believes in cause and effect, so he is only afraid that if he creates bad causes today, he will have to suffer the consequences in the future, but the present retribution is due to causes created in the past, so the Bodhisattva calmly accepts it without fear. On the contrary, sentient beings are confused and do not understand or believe in cause and effect, so when the cruel retribution comes, they are frightened, without knowing fear from the moment of creating the cause. Therefore, even though we have suffered, we still constantly create more bad karma.

Crickets repay revenge2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Cause and Effect, Eye and Effect (因果目擊編). (Author's note)

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, there was a man named Truong in Hangzhou who loved to play cricket. Whenever he lost a cricket, he cut off its head and threw it away.

Later, the Truong family had a large boil growing on their back. Inside the black, rotten flesh, there were hundreds of cricket heads that moved when touched. Truong's family suffered deep pain, and finally cried and died.

FOR DECLARATION

The karma created by people in this world is basically based on the six senses.1 When one sense is activated, the other five senses also arise. For example, a person who raises crickets initially wants to see with his eyes, [eye faculty creates karma], but when he goes to catch crickets, he must listen to the sound of the crickets to catch them, then his ear faculty creates karma. When kicking a cricket, use your hand to stimulate the cricket to kick, that is the body's base creating karma. Comparing wins and losses is the basis of the mind that creates karma. If you win the drinking contest, your nose sense (nose smells) and your tongue sense (tongue tastes) create karma. The Shurangama Sutra talks about "karma from the six senses"2 which is this idea.

NOTE 1

The six senses include: eyes (eye sense), ears (ear sense), nose (nose sense), tongue (tongue sense), body (body sense) and mind (mind sense).

NOTE 2

Originally used “六交報” (6 Giao Bao), extracted from the Shurangama Sutra, the full name is Great Buddha's Name Tathagata Tantra of the Humanity Cultivating the Realization of Bodhisattvas of Ten Thousand Virtues Holding the Shurangama Sutra (大佛頂如來密因修證了義諸菩薩萬行首楞嚴經), a total of 10 volumes, are classified in the Mahazheng Pitaka, Volume 19, sutra number 945. In volume 8, page 143, sheet c, lines 4 and 5, it is written: “阿難此等皆是彼諸眾生 自業所感。造十習因受六交報。” - Ananda! Trying to teach sentient beings their own karma, create ten causes, receive six retributions. (Hey Ananda! Such things are all caused by the karma of sentient beings. If they cause ten episodes, they will receive six consequences.) In a later sutra passage (page 144, sheet a, lines 28 and 29), the Buddha explains: “阿難。一切眾生六識造業,所招惡報從六根出。” - All sentient beings must create karma in the six consciousnesses, and the six roots of evil will result. (Hey Ananda! All sentient beings create karma through the six senses, and the bad and evil retributions come from the six senses.) Therefore, we translate "six consequences" as "karma from the six senses".

tieu_de: Advise people to cherish the lives of ants
noi_dung:
Advising people to cherish the lives of insects ant

A person who accumulates merit and virtue is like a child who skillfully builds and builds the family fortune. Although the development cannot be seen clearly, but by accumulating day by day, months and months building up, one will naturally achieve great karma like Dao Chu.1 A person who does unvirtuous work is like a child who destroys the family business. Although the destruction cannot be seen clearly, day by day it wears out, months and months are dissipated, and finally the time comes when the house is broken and the doors are broken, with no land to build a foundation. Therefore, there is a saying: "Don't see a small evil thing and do it, don't despise a small good thing and don't do it."

NOTE 1

Big karma like Dao Chu: only a successful businessman with a rich family. According to an ancient story, after helping King Viet destroy the Ngo kingdom, Pham Lai immediately resigned from his mandarin and returned to Dao, calling himself Duke of Chu, and following a career in trade, he became extremely wealthy. Therefore, later generations used the word Dao Chu to refer to successful traders and became rich.

The ant king returned his favor2

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Ancient History Talks - 古史談苑. (Author's note)

Phu Duong district, Ngo land, there was a man named Dong Chieu Chi. One day, while sailing across the Tien Duong River, he suddenly saw an ant crawling on a reed stem floating in the water. He wanted to pick up the reed stem onto the boat to save the ant, but the people on the boat wouldn't let him. He immediately used a rope tied to the reed to pull it along with the boat, and finally brought the ant to shore.

More than ten years later, Dong Chieu Chi was falsely accused of stealing by others and was imprisoned. Chieu Chi remembered what the ant king had said before in his dream. He wanted to announce the news but didn't know how. Someone who knew about it immediately said: "Why don't you catch a few ants, put them in the palm of your hand and talk about this with them?" Dong Chieu Chi did as he was told, and sure enough, that night he dreamed of a man dressed in black who came and said: "You should quickly run away, go hide in Du Hang mountain, you can escape this disaster."

Dong Chieu Chi woke up, immediately followed the instructions and fled, running to Du Hang mountain. Sure enough, he escaped, and not long after, there was a general amnesty from the court, thereby exonerating him from the crime.

COMMENT

Don't think that returning favors is a myth. Tiny insects all have inexplicable stories.

Once upon a time, King Phu Kien1 along with two people, Vuong Manh and Phu Dung, secretly discussed absolution [for prisoners] at Linh Dai. Just as they were about to draft the mat, suddenly a very large black fly flew towards the pen, making a very strong buzzing sound. Not long after, the whole country knew that the court was about to issue a general amnesty.

NOTE 1

Emperor Tuyen Chieu of the Early Qin Dynasty.

Fu Kien thought that no one other than the two people who discussed the matter with him could know enough to reveal this story, so he questioned the mandarins to see how they knew that news. The mandarins reported: "The other day, on the way, I saw a child wearing a black shirt, only about three meters tall, standing in the middle of the road shouting loudly for everyone to hear: 'The court is about to grant amnesty, the court is about to be pardoned!' As soon as the shout ended, it suddenly disappeared, never to be seen again." Only then did Phu Kien know that the child was the big black fly that flew to the pen nib the day before.2

NOTE 1

Three cubits old, about 1 meter.

NOTE 2

Excerpted from the book Northern History. (Author's note)

The world is vast, is there anything that cannot happen? The story of the ant king returning his favor is not considered strange.

tieu_de: Advice to hunters
noi_dung:
Advice to hunters3

NOTE 3

The following advice is not to kill animals when choosing a profession to make a living. (Author's note)

Buddha taught that: "In the heart, always thinking of compassion and kindness, practicing good dharma, that is the cause that one day will be born in the two realms of heaven and human, enjoying merit. In the heart, always thinking of killing animals to eat meat, that is the cause that will one day fall into the realms of hell, hungry ghosts, and animals."

Hunters shooting, from morning to night, when they see birds, they think about shooting birds, when they see animals, they think about catching animals.

cannot find a single concept in their minds that is not related to killing. Therefore, resentments and resentments continue to be endless, gradually falling into eternal hell, with no time to escape. Those who often kill and view the lives of all living things as trash, why don't they reflect on this?

A bird's love for its children touches people1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book The Later Han. (Author's note)

General Dang Chi2 brought troops to attack Phu Lang. One day, he saw a mother bird feeding her chicks. He raised his bow and shot but failed to hit. The mother bird was shot and missed, but because there were baby birds there, she could not bear to fly away and remained standing there. Dang Chi shot again, the bird was hit by the arrow, still carrying the arrow on its body and continued to feed its chicks, holding the bait next to it, chirping for the chicks to take the food themselves, and finally let out a sad cry and died. The baby birds also cried endlessly.

NOTE 2

Dang Chi was a famous general of the country of Shu during the Three Kingdoms period.

Dang Chi was extremely regretful, saying to himself: "If I did something against the nature of all living things, I would surely die!" Sure enough, not long after he was killed by Chung Hoi.3

NOTE 3

Here, I'm afraid there is a mistake in the original work, because Dang Chi led troops to suppress the rebellion in Phu Lang land in 248. In 251, he passed away at an unknown age, but he was much older than Chung Hoi, because from 223 he was sent by King Thuc to envoy to Dong Ngo, while Chung Hoi was not born until 225. When he died, Chung Hoi was only 26 years old and was holding the position of Minister, Lieutenant and Thi Lang, not yet holding military power. In 262, Chung Hoi was appointed General of Tran Tay, leading the army to prepare to attack Shu in 263.

DECLARATION

There is nothing more tragic in life than when a young mother is critically ill and is about to die, calling her young children to her bedside to hold hands and say goodbye, a word that makes her heart ache. The knot tightened a hundred times, the attachment did not let go, in a moment the tears flowed like rain, in my heart I was worried that someone would arbitrarily mistreat my children, and I was also afraid that my stepmother would torture me in the future. Foreseeing the orphaned state of my children, my soul was extremely painful and sad at that time. Hearing the children's cries, my heart felt like it was being torn apart.

Such extreme tragedy in human life is actually caused by evil karma from previous lives, so at that time we had to endure it without any way to escape.

Hunting animals and receiving retribution in a pot of boiling water boiling1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Induction of the Celestial Diagram (感應篇圖說). (Author's note)

Luu Ma Nhi in Fen Chau, the whole family is a hunter. One day, he and his son Luu Su Bao suddenly fell dead one after another. To the north of his house, there was a neighbor, Ky Lung Uy, who fell ill and died and then naturally came back to life. On that occasion, he told everyone that while in the underworld, he saw Luu Ma and his son being cooked in a pan of boiling water, their skin and flesh gradually disintegrating until everything was gone, only the bones remained. After a long time, the body returns to its original state. Lung Uy asked the reason, someone immediately replied: "In the past, I liked to set fires [to chase away] and catch animals, so now I have to suffer the same crime."

COMMENT

Buddhist scriptures teach that: "In the realm of hell, every day and night there are ten thousand deaths and rebirths. Every time [the punishment reaches the point of] death, a wind blows to revive them, and they continue to endure that miserable punishment. If karma has not ended, even if it lasts until the land, rivers and mountains are ruined, that punishment will never stop for a moment."

Therefore, the Ksitigarbha Sutra has says: "When this world is destroyed, [the person who receives karma] is reincarnated into another world; when that world is damaged, he is reincarnated into a world in another direction; when the worlds in that direction are damaged, he is reincarnated in other directions one after another, waiting until after this world is formed, he is reborn here [to continue receiving karma]."1

NOTE 1

According to Buddhist scriptures, each world sequentially goes through four stages: formation (formation), existence (existence), destruction (destruction) and emptiness (becoming empty with nothing left). Those four stages are cyclically connected, so after the zero stage, the world is formed again.

Alas, if you don't think about it, it's just too scary!

Humans and deer die together1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Theory of Induction of Heavenly Chart (感應篇圖說). (Author's note)

In Lu Lang, there was a man named Ngo Duong, very good at hunting. When hunting, he often took his young son with him. One day, seeing a mother deer carrying a baby deer, Ngo Duong shot one shot, hitting the baby deer and falling down dead. The mother deer cried out sadly and ran away. Ngo Duong immediately hid in the thick grass, saw the mother deer turn around and stick out her tongue to lick the baby's body. He immediately drew his bow and shot the mother deer dead.

Suddenly he saw another deer, so he immediately shot, and it turned out the arrow hit his son. Ngo Duong hugged his child and cried, suddenly heard a voice in the air: "Ngo Duong! That deer also loves his child, no different than you?"

Ngo Duong was terrified when he suddenly saw a tiger pounce on the child, biting off one of his arms, causing him to die immediately.

COMMENT

Someone asked: "Punishing a person's sins should not involve his children. Of course Ngo Duong is cruel, but what crime does his young son have? If he hates his father and kills his son, is the net of the netherworld too harsh?"

It is not knowing that a person who does good will certainly be born into a house to do good. To enjoy happiness together, the person who did

evil must be born into the house of evildoer to suffer the same sin. Ngo Duong's son must have done many evil deeds in his previous life and suffered the retribution of being mauled by a tiger and died, so he was born into Ngo Duong's family to suffer that disaster. This is to let people know and be afraid, so that the father knows the punishment is like that. The causes and conditions that converge to create such things are all brought about by inconceivable karma.

Buddha said: "When a lifetime is about to end, the average lifespan of a human being is only 10 years old. When sentient beings meet each other, they all have evil thoughts and kill each other, without any compassion. Just like a hunter in the mountains and forests, when he sees all kinds of animals, he only has an evil mind wanting to kill, without any mercy. Therefore, when this life is about to end, within the last seven days, all the grass, trees, and rocks are all alive. transformed into a sword and staff, [those sentient beings] harmed each other, so after death they all fell into evil paths.”1

NOTE 1

See in the Origin of the Human Sutra. (Author's note)

I advise all people, when seeing fellow human beings, to generate a mind of compassion for salvation. When seeing all living beings, they should also generate a mind of compassion for salvation. No matter where you are born, you will aspire to Bodhi. If done like that, even the sinful obstacles [created previously] will immediately disappear like ice and snow under the sun.

tieu_de: Advice to bird catchers
noi_dung:
Advice to bird catchers

Birds are small creatures, but when the male bird goes away, the female bird also makes sad sounds. When the mother bird does not return, the baby birds also know how to chirp and cry, waiting for food. [Those feelings] are no different from real people. For example, if you fall into a situation where a couple is separated, mother and child are separated, you will surely cry out in sadness, stop eating and not sleeping, and be sad and helpless. That's why there is a saying: "If you separate male and female among animals, you will have to suffer the retribution of separation between husband and wife; if you kill the children of animals, you will have to suffer the retribution of your descendants dying prematurely." Cause and effect is clearly not false.

Three grateful swallows1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Evidence Luc (證慈錄). (Author's note)

During the Song Dynasty, in Nghiem Chau2 there was a woman named Vuong A Tam. One day, when she saw a cat mauling a mother swallow to death, she immediately brought rice to feed three baby swallows in the nest. Until the big bird flew away.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Zhejiang province.

In the winter of that year, Wang Atam passed away. Next spring, three swallows flew back and circled the house. Vuong Á Tam's mother immediately said: "Is the swallow looking for Á Tam? Á Tam is dead, buried in the back garden." Three swallows immediately flew into the garden, cried out in pain, and then lay dead on Vuong A Tam's grave.

COMMENT

Is there anyone who knows how to remember old gratitude and deep love like these three swallows? Looking at this story, I feel so sad and ashamed.

The guest bird chooses the burial site1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Guan Kin Luc (觀感錄). (Author's note)

Vu Tan district2 has Cu Cong, a kind-hearted person with deep virtue. One day, he saw a bird carrying an arrow on its body, making a sad and painful cry. He felt pity and immediately said: "If you want me to help you pull out the arrow, then quickly come down here." The guest bird indeed flew and landed in front of him. Cong Cong pulled out the arrow, nursed the bird for a few days [to recover] and then let it fly away.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

Later, when Cong Cong wanted to rebury his parents, he found a good place but did not know where to choose the grave. Then suddenly a flock of guest birds gathered. A guest bird flew to Cu Cong's shirt and then flew back to a place in the grave, three times in a row. Cu Cong immediately said: "If that place is really a good acupuncture point, you should scream three times." The guest bird immediately followed his instructions and called out three times. Cu Cong invited a geologist to come and examine it. As expected, the land was very suitable, so he immediately had a grave dug and buried there.

Later, his two children, Cu Si Dat and Cu Si Tuyen, both passed the Huong exam.3 their descendants became more and more prosperous.

NOTE 3

That is, they passed the bachelor's degree.

DECLARATION

Good and bad burials all come from your mind. A violent ancestor who does not know how to accumulate virtue in his own mind and only looks outside to carry his coffin to find a good burial ground, that is just a foolish person.

A net to catch birds infected with a strange disease1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Chuyet am Diary (拙庵日記). (Author's note)

In Ba Duong2 there is a dyer named Dong who likes to make nets to catch birds. After catching it, use a bamboo stick to skewer the bird's head, place it on a straw fire to cook it, then clean the feathers and sell it. The number of birds he killed was too many to count.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Jiangxi province.

Later, the Dong family suddenly suffered from a strange disease, the skin of the whole body became rough like tree bark, the itching was strange and unbearable, and had to be burned with dry straw to heat the whole body. After that, he had a headache and had to have someone hit him on the head with a bamboo stick to be able to endure it. The Dong family was tortured in such pain for three years before they died.

COMMENT

Using a bamboo stick to hit the head, using a straw fire to dry the whole body, are all painful and miserable things, why would the Dong family want to endure such things?

It is because human nature is inherently kind. Using nets to catch birds to kill them is doing things that humans should not do, so we have to suffer retribution by hitting them on the head with bamboo sticks, burning straw to heat our whole bodies, all of which are wanting things that other people don't want.

The whole flock of birds pecked and tore the body1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the book Hieu Sinh Luc (好生錄). (Author's note)

At the end of the Ming Dynasty, in Wujin2 there was a man named Co Muu who used to catch countless birds. Later, he fell ill and was bedridden, telling his family: "Today a bird came to peck at my arm." Then he said again: "A bird came to peck at my leg." Every day, I changed the place where the birds pecked me, until I felt like my whole body was being pecked by the birds. At that time, he had been sick for forty-nine days and said to his family: "Today a bird came to peck out my eyes." After speaking, he died. Family members came to look, and sure enough, there were no pupils left in the eyes.

NOTE 2

Belongs to Jiangsu province.

COMMENT

People who keep birds in cages, even though they do not take their lives, cannot avoid being imprisoned in prison. They should abstain from fear and do not commit crimes. come in.

Iron bullet penetrates the stomach3

NOTE 3

Excerpted from the book Cause and Effect, Eye and Effect (因果目擊編). (Author's note)

Con Son district has a man named Cung Phuc who is very good at shooting birds with a gun. In the summer of the Year of the Tiger

of the year of Thuan Tri,1 one day he held a fire stick to the gunpowder, the embers flew out and fell into the gunpowder, burning fiercely, his beard and hair were all burned off, and an iron bullet pierced his chest and into his abdomen, dying in a very miserable way.

NOTE 1

That is the year 1662.

COMMENT

This type of person will definitely fall into iron hell.2 [After leaving hell,] if one is born as a human, one must suffer one of three types of retribution. One is death from fire, two is death from gunfire and three is death from fear and madness.

NOTE 2

Iron Ring Hell (鐵丸地獄): where criminals are punished by being forced to swallow hot iron balls. The circumference of this hell is 80 yojanas wide, in which there are 88 iron citadels, in each iron citadel there are 5 mountains of knives covering the top, below there are 18 very poisonous iron snakes, its tongue spits out iron swords, the tip of the sword burns bright red, the sinner dies and is born in the iron citadel, the iron snake wraps its body, on top of the fire burns, and rains down large hot iron pellets; from the top of the head in, from the bottom of the feet out.

Buddha Shakyamuni, countless lives ago, was once the Heavenly King of the Dao-loi heaven,3 fighting with the asuras. When he was about to lead his army back, he suddenly saw a golden bird nesting in a giant tree, and immediately thought: "If our army passes by there, the golden bird's eggs will definitely be destroyed." Immediately ordered the driver to turn back and not return. The asura army saw that De Thich suddenly turned around and retreated in fear. Thanks to a benevolent thought, that time Indra was victorious.4

NOTE 3

That is, Thich De Thich or De Thich, also called Thich-de-perfect-human.

NOTE 4

This story is recorded in the Sutra of the Origin of Humanity (起世 因本經). (Author's note)

Even the king of heaven Indra could not bear to harm even a single bird's egg, not to mention how can ordinary people with poor blessings and weak virtues look down on the lives of living beings like trash?

tieu_de: Advice to those who work as butchers
noi_dung:
Advice to butchers

Even though goats and pigs are animals, their psychology of greed for life and fear of death is no different from ours. Consider a house that raises pigs, and as soon as they accept the price to sell to the butcher, the pig immediately tears up and stops eating. Although my mouth couldn't say a word, in my heart I knew my life didn't last long. So when someone used a rope to tie him, he screamed in shock, and when he was dragged out the door, he trembled in terror. The butcher took a step that was a terrifying step for that pig. Every person I meet on the road, I wholeheartedly hope that that person will save my life. Until he entered the slaughterhouse and saw the butcher rolling up his sleeves and swinging his knife towards him, he screamed loudly. But crying to the sky cannot reach the sky, crying to the earth cannot enter the earth. Look right and left, there is no one who doesn't want to kill you. Looking back and forth, there are all tools to kill me. In just a moment of being thrown upside down on the floor, the sharp knife cut deeply into his stomach. At that time, it was like boiling oil poured on the top of my head. At that time, it was like thousands of spears penetrating my heart and liver. The screams were miserable and extremely painful, then gradually faded away, and the eyes quickly closed.

because blood was pouring out. Such pain and suffering are truly indescribable. I can't say it all, do I still have the heart to say it anymore? Alas, that pig was a human in his previous life, so why didn't he have a mother and father to cherish and treat as limbs? Why does the chef now despise his flesh and bones like mud and sand? Is it possible that without a wife and children to love and consider as confidants, why does the butcher now view his life as trash?

The evil karma of previous lives is scary, only now do we know; Where are the heroes of the past, where are they now? If we do not develop the desire to be liberated, it will be difficult for everyone to avoid this kind of suffering. Once you rotate in samsara, no matter where you are born, you will easily fall.

Therefore, the method of seeking birth in the Western Pure Land can be practiced by both men and women; The precept of killing and liberating captive animals (life release), both wise and foolish should try to do it themselves. I hope everyone will immediately return to the right path and not regret what they did in the next life.
