- Officials with the virtue of love for life, before moving

to another place, on the last day should bring the methods of protecting life that they have applied, urgently transfer and advise the successor.

tieu_de: Things that should be applied in the family
noi_dung:
Things to apply in the family

In the end of the world, there are few good and virtuous houses, in heaven the blessings increase. I often hear that a good deed can neutralize evil omens, what more can it bestow grace to save many lives? If our parents and grandparents first persevered in keeping the precepts of not killing, then our children and grandchildren will be able to follow the rules. Don't

overlook the small lives of all animals, please try to listen to this rustic person.

- People who have the virtue of loving life, right in their family

should be educated with benevolent morality, making everyone, up and down, young and old, never think of killing living things, that is the most precious thing.

- On days when death anniversaries and birthdays are taboo,

should be established as a custom, often buying life-saving objects to release animals.

- Families accumulate merit for many generations, if they want to feel

to transform the members of their clan, nothing more than discussing and putting together a convention in their clan's genealogy for everyone to follow. It clearly stipulates that even though people in their clan are poor and have to find work to make a living, they are definitely not allowed to work as butchers, meat and wine traders, cooks, fish netters, hunters, animal trappers... all jobs related to killing animals are not allowed. You are also not allowed to work in the profession of making tools to kill birds, fish, or animals such as nets, traps, spears, bows, arrows, guns, animal cages... If anyone in your clan violates this convention, the clan leader will gather everyone from their clan and severely punish the violator for the crime of unfilial piety.

- For domestic servants, if

anyone pursues the profession of killing. life, you must advise them to quickly change, if they do not listen, they will be expelled from the house.

- The reason why ordinary people dare to set up signs and ignore arrest

fishing in the middle of the river [violating the ban], often relying on rich and powerful people. Powerful people are greedy for profit from sacrifices, so they let them break the law and create karma of killing. People with the virtue of love for life must be careful to guard themselves and not be greedy for that gain.

- Some coastal areas have a rule, when landowners collect

taxes from tenants, each acre of land comes with a number of chickens and ducks. Households with fields should be advised to change that practice and switch to using other substitutes.

- Chickens, dogs, falcons, cats, goldfish, rock crickets... and

animals that harm other animals should not be kept in the house.

- Rice that has not been milled into rice will not change even if left for years

the taste, in summer and autumn, when needed, grind it at that time. The taste is no different from new rice, and there are no worms born. Therefore, instead of storing rice, you should store rice.

- Worms are born in rice, most of them die

While cleaning, wash the rice and cook it into rice. Therefore, you should calculate in advance the amount of rice you will use each day, take it out a few days in advance, spread it thinly on the surface of the container, so that the insects have a chance to crawl away before using it. If there are still any insects left, you should use a discarded container to put them in there.

- In rice there is also a very small type of worm, just like

a layer of chalk surrounding the grain of rice, the quantity is extremely

extremely large. This type of worm is usually caused by rice placed near wet wood. Therefore, the wooden lid on the rice tray must be kept dry. The same goes for the tools used to dry rice before cooking.

- The wooden lid covering the rice tray should be kept in a separate place, and reused next year, [don't use it as firewood]. This not only prevents insects born in the wood from being burned, but also helps keep the rice clean and white.

- Do not pile firewood near the place where the rice tray is placed, because

rice contains many small insects. If placed near the wood, they will crawl into the wood [then have to be burned].

- Stored barley can easily breed moths, so

hang it out in the hot sun for a few days to let them go away before storing it in the barn. After storing in the barn, the wind must be prevented from entering [causing humidity]. If the quantity is too small to fit into the barn and must be stored in a jar, a little ash should be spread on the surface to absorb moisture. In case the barley produces too many moths, you should put it in a separate container to wait for them to go away.

- When storing firewood in the kitchen, you should choose a very dry place.

The firewood at the bottom is often damp and moldy, so it should be exposed to the sun once a day before using it for cooking. Whenever you need to put out a fire, do not use water with insects in it, and do not throw burning wood into the ground where insects live.

- In the summer, when worshiping magic apples, or at the graves of ancestors

fairies, often burn gold and silver paper, which can harm the lives of small insects on the burned ground. Therefore, you should choose a place with solid ground, sweep it clean a few times and then quickly burn there, so that insects do not have time to find it and be harmed.

- When making soy sauce, if you use rainwater collected into the blood of

Vu Thuy, it will taste sweet but have few insects.1 If you discover that there are insects in the sauce, you should store it in a separate jar, try to separate all the insects before putting it back in. If there are parasites in the vinegar, do the same.

NOTE 1

Rainwater collected in the rainwater period is called "water apricot blossom". In addition, if autumn contains some snow that falls in late spring and early summer, and then uses that water to make soy sauce or vinegar, it will not breed bacteria. (Attachment from Mr. Tuong Tan Ngu.)

- During the summer, all kinds of flour, rice flour, cake flour

and other delicious foods should be stored, and should occasionally be exposed to the sun [to avoid parasites].

- In the summer, stored medicinal herbs are also very susceptible to

parasites, the preparer You must be very careful with medicine.

- Every time you cut hair, you should not throw it into the river,

because hair gets stuck inside the shells of oysters, snails, and mussels, they will be stabbed by the hair and die.

- Servants often hate ants crawling up

the kitchen. Once they see them, they kill them all. If the pot is filled with water every afternoon, the ants will not be able to enter the pot and crawl through the kitchen.

- In the summer, housekeepers

often light fires in the rooms to repel mosquitoes,

this can easily cause a fire, so this should be severely punished.

- Shampoo or bath water is hot, not hot.

can be arbitrarily spilled on the ground, because in the summer months, small insects live everywhere on the ground.

- When washing salted things as well as salt containers,

must use clear water to dilute it before pouring it on the ground.

tieu_de: Things to apply on festive occasions
noi_dung:
Things to apply on occasions of celebration

When humans encounter joyous occasions, many sentient beings have to shed tears and face tragic tragedy. Once the owner decides to offer his small body to entertain guests, he will have to tremble a thousand times every night he is alive. Who knows that in the event of karma, we will meet again and find each other with resentment? At that time, I'm afraid that I already have feathers and horns, have a mouth that can't speak, and then have to bow my head and be dragged to death, [is it different from today's animals]?

- People with the virtue of love for life, when they are enjoying

glory and wealth, and encounter occasions of celebration by royal officials, if they can use other offerings to celebrate instead of wine and meat, they should do so.

- Officials coming from far away to visit should use

paintings, calligraphy, precious antiques and charity books to give as gifts. If you absolutely have to

host a party and entertain, do not kill living things.

- When the government visits, you should be respectful and respectful, but

you must not use live animals as offerings.

- Parents' birthday celebration, if relatives contribute money

to celebrate their longevity, they should use that money to do good deeds, the full names of those contributing money must be listed.

- Today's longevity ceremonies are often related to the arrogance of people in the end times. People in the past who were over sixty years old had not yet wished a long life, let alone those who were only thirty or forty years old? If you don't want to go against the world, you should at least wait until you're over sixty years old, and then celebrate your life once every ten years.

- Friends and relatives, if someone is about to leave

to take part in an exam, or take an office, or go on a long-distance business trip, cannot do without a farewell, so they should use money and gifts instead of a grand banquet, so both parties will be blessed [because they avoid killing]. harm] .

- When good things happen to loved ones, when they reach success

Okay, no need to rush to congratulate. Because if good things truly belong to you, you should not flaunt them to the outside.

- Students preparing to take the Huong and Hoi exams, most

are friends and relatives who pool money together and then organize offerings to pray to the island of Van Xuong De Quan, Quan

Holy De Quan. People who understand reason must do their best to refuse and prevent this.

- Good things happen in the house, and they are reluctant to

hold a celebration party, so the number of banquet tables should be pre-determined. If it's on the full moon or first lunar day, you should use clean vegetables and fruits [instead of meat and fish].

- Giang Bac region has a custom that when hosting a banquet

, guests always prepare several trays of vegetarian rice. This not only accumulates merit, but is also convenient for friends to fast. That way of doing things is very good, people with the virtue of love for life should imitate and maintain it as a good custom.

- Friends far away have something to celebrate, reluctant to be close

come to congratulate, don't bring too many people.

- If your friends especially want to hold a party for you

for yourself, then a few days in advance you should find a way to make it clear to that person, or refuse because you are fasting, or deny that you only eat at the right time, or refuse because you do not eat an animal killed specifically to treat yourself, thus it can help reduce a lot. lots of killing.

- Going to a party at someone else's house, if you see them killing a lot of living things for you

, people with the virtue of love for life should put down their chopsticks, stand up, bow and go home.

- If there are friends or relatives who are sick, people with

the virtue of love for life should not talk about collecting money to make offerings to pray to dispel evil spirits. If there is someone

others discuss that matter and call for their contribution, so they should clearly present Buddha's teachings to them, clearly show cause and effect, tell them that ghosts and gods do not enjoy gifts, clearly state that life and death are decided by the karma created, making that person think again and give up that thing, it is best to do so.

- Rich people have times when they invite concubines, people come

congratulations often include those who are shameless and want to have a party with drinks. That bad habit must be carefully avoided and not nurtured.

tieu_de: Things to apply in weddings
noi_dung:
Things to apply in weddings

Men and women, due to random fate, come together in marriage, vowing to live together until the end of their lives. The day of the marriage was a good one, good air covered the whole house in the front yard, but unfortunately the cooking and killing of living things became even more excessive. I feel sorry for the animal couples. They are also passionately married, but only because of the lack of compassion in previous lives, today we have to pay for our lives together.

- If your children have not finished worrying about the wedding,

should not easily hang out with the bride's family, [because it makes them worry about the favors and kill the living things].

- Rich people have authority, every time there is a marriage

they often host lavish parties with alcohol, because of which boys and girls joke and joke elegantly. Mixed and not serious, causing no small harm. Just because people don't think

about the fact that marriage is a beautiful ceremony that from the very beginning has started a whole joke, what could be more bad than that, how much it is worth preventing!

- Every time people get married, people often have the custom of using live

things to make offerings to the Five Saints.1 After making offerings to pray for blessings, they will have the wedding ceremony and arrange a banquet for guests. The reason for carving wooden statues to worship these evil gods is because there is a legend of "five saints harvesting rice", and people rely on that to make offerings. If you are a good, knowledgeable person, how can you do this? We should completely stop that custom.

NOTE 1

These deities according to folk superstition, popular in the Jiangnan region, also have many other names such as the Ngu Hien Linh Cong, the Ngu Lang Than. During the reign of Kangxi in the Qing Dynasty, government officials once actively rejected and destroyed idols and destroyed temples.

- Every time a marriage was held, a banquet for guests was also held

is a custom that cannot be abandoned, but the way it is done becomes more and more luxurious every day, and the number of guests becomes more and more crowded. If you want to maintain good customs, you should take frugality as a rule.

- In marriage, ancient customs stipulate many ceremonies

such as the welcoming ceremony, the three-trieu ceremony, the moon-ending ceremony, the storage ceremony...2 can all be held more simply, without necessarily having to host a party for guests.

NOTE 2

Most of these rituals no longer exist today or have been simplified. Like welcoming , the ceremony where the husband's family goes to the bride's house to pick up the bride (bridal procession), although still kept, it is much simpler; The tam trieu ceremony is also known as the villain ceremony, which stipulates that 3 days after the wedding, the bride returns home to visit her parents, the moon-ending ceremony is after one month, the gui hoa ceremony is also a ceremony for the bride to return to visit her biological parents...

- In organizing the wedding, except for old, unfortunate relatives

Of course, you can't help but invite, and you shouldn't abuse this opportunity to invite too many guests.

- Matchmakers and cooks, when

go to the groom's house, often talk a lot about the bride's family organizing a sumptuous feast, and when they come to the bride's house, they also talk about the groom's family the same way. Going back and forth between the two houses, they all wanted to instigate a grand celebration of the meal. Be careful not to be deceived by their charms.

- For those who help with rituals, music,

cooking... in the marriage, eating and drinking should be simple, not too lavish, but reward them with adequate money for their efforts.

tieu_de: Things to apply in funerals
noi_dung:
Things to apply in funerals

Once a loved one passes away, just thinking about that person's voice and laughter will never be heard again from now on, sadness covers you like autumn dew, like spring. At the same time, they kill and sacrifice animals in order to hope that the soul of the dead will return to enjoy them, not knowing that this will only increase the injustice for the deceased. Why respectfully obey the Buddha's teachings, persistently keep the Five Precepts, and take refuge in the Three Jewels. The deceased seems to have not yet passed on, and the children's hearts are still not at peace. The duty of being a child must be engraved in the heart like that.

- Once the parents pass away, one must abstain from doing

bedroom matters, completely cut off alcohol and meat, all family members must fast for at least 49 days, sincerely recite Buddhist scriptures, and only use fruits and vegetables for offerings.

- Rich and powerful people, once they encounter a funeral, they will surely die

there are many guests who come to pay their respects, worship the dead, and kill countless animals. Therefore, first of all, you should write four big words “no offering salty food” and stick it right in front of the door. If someone still brings offerings such as roasted pork, boiled chicken, etc., they must absolutely refuse.

- Ancient people mourned their parents' funerals, and after the new year's week of the week, they began to eat normal fruits and vegetables. During a year of mourning, you don't even want to eat rice and vegetables, let alone being able to delight yourself with delicious delicacies? Therefore, if a child really thinks about the merits of his parents, he should mourn his parents and vow to be a vegetarian for three years.

- On holidays and death anniversaries of the year, he should devote himself to doing good deeds and accumulating blessings, or reciting sutras, giving alms of food, or creating holy statues, or buying animals to release animals, so he should do whatever he can, but he must not kill animals to make offerings.

- Even though parents have passed away, memorial days are taboo

on the death anniversary, you should do many good deeds and dedicate blessings to your parents.

- When building or repairing your parents' graves,

construction workers should wait until the job is finished and then reward them with appropriate money, absolutely do not kill them for the sake of entertaining them.

- In the ritual of worshiping their ancestors' graves, offering

For worship, you should only use silk and paper, do not listen to other people's stories of sacrificing life objects. The worship of ancestors is limited to no more than seven generations, in addition, the previous generations all move to worship with the ancestral temple. For commoners to sacrifice to distant ancestors from previous generations and talk about killing the sacrificial animal, that is an abuse of sacrificial rituals. What's more, the custom of offering sacrifices at graves according to ancient rituals really didn't exist. Now, even if you want to follow the people of today and make offerings, it's not necessary to kill the living thing. A filial child who knows how to love his parents must make the main effort to improve his own virtue and cannot believe in such wrong things.

tieu_de: Things to do in construction
noi_dung:
Things to do in construction

In construction, large is like citadels, palaces, mansions, small is like thatched roofs and bamboo hedges, just the transportation of tiles, bricks and materials can cause great harm to countless insects, ants, crickets... Please do not kill to reward the workers. causing animals to fall apart. The ignorant person who hears these words must have doubts, the wise person is concerned with repairing and cultivating good virtue.

- The repair of palaces, temples, houses, and even all the construction works in the people, should be done in winter, when hundreds of types of insects are destroyed.

- All bridges, roads, monasteries, etc. If it is not related

to the Three Jewels and benefits to people's lives, then construction or remodeling should not be started.

- Whenever starting construction, there is often a custom of offering

wine to the earth gods, it is best to only use vegetables and fruits.

- To open or dredge and repair river canals,

as a rule, water must be drained at the construction site. The person in charge should have previously prepared and posted clear ban signs to avoid the situation where residents around the area take advantage of the shallow water to catch fish and shrimp.

- In the mud layer of the river, there are many living creatures

like snails, mussels, oysters, mussels... If that layer of mud is taken out of the river water, they will all die. Therefore, if you have to repair or build dikes along the river, you should choose a special place to get soil [instead of dredging mud from the river to build it]. If you can't do that, you should pay attention to any animals during construction and try to save them.

- Repairing and building the grave, in front should bury

a large square rock as a place to burn silk and paper. If the surrounding area is filled with dry grass, you can burn the paper in the middle of the rock, being careful not to cause the fire to spread. If you live near people's houses, you must be extremely cautious when burning paper in front of a temporary coffin.

- Types of wooden and bamboo boats that can be used for a long time

Underwater, there will definitely be snails clinging to the bottom. Therefore, before having to put them on land, you need to pay attention to remove them and release them into the river.

- When demolishing old fences, or cutting down large trees, if

see snakes, centipedes, scorpions... crawling out, you should be careful to tell the workers to let them go.

- Dismantle the old house, inside the rafters, columns, and beams.

hands, etc., often have rotten wood, many types of insects, termites, beetles... living in it, should not be used immediately as firewood. The same is true for bamboo hedges and bamboo fences.

- When slaked by adding quicklime to water, you should

choose clean soil, free of insects. You should use water taken from the stream, do not use water from stagnant ponds and puddles, because stagnant water often has many types of aquatic insects living in it.

- When using mud to build walls, there is often

in the mud.

many small insects live. Instead, you should choose clean soil, dig [remove the top layer of soil, dig deep] down to about 6 inches so there are no insects, and you can use that soil to knead it into mud for use. Do not choose places near ditches or wells that are in use.

- Around large yards, many

drainage ditches should be built so that there is no stagnant water and no breeding of aquatic insects.

- Bricks, tiles, wood, and stones used in construction, if stored in damp places, will have many small insects. crawl into life. When using it, you need to have clever means to protect them.

- When building a cooking stove, you should use three parts of mineral lime,

seven parts of mud and sand, mix well and then build a foundation underneath, place the stove on top, so in the future ants will not crawl onto the stove.

- Old stoves that have been used for a long time often have ants hiding inside

in. When renovating or building a new stove, you should smash the old stove a day before, let the ants crawl away, then start building the new stove.

- Bamboo poles under the thatched roof, in places

that bend down during the rainy season, water often stagnates, which can easily breed aquatic insects. You should use straight pieces of bamboo split into towers in those places to limit it.

- Places near river banks should not be used as toilets

for fear that if small insects in the river follow the water, they will die in filth.

- For the food and drink of workers during construction,

of course it is difficult to reduce alcohol and meat, but you should use fish and meat bought in bulk at the market to salt for later use, [to avoid direct killing].

tieu_de: Things to keep in mind when using containers
noi_dung:
Things to keep in mind when using containers

Carefully observe the types of containers, [if they contain water] in the summer months there are many very small insects living in them. Once the north wind blew, everyone perished, unable to live through the cold winter. However, while they are still alive, they also know how to be greedy for life and fear death just like humans, so don't think that protecting the lives of those small creatures has no merit. You should know that although the size of the body is different, the perception and feeling of all living beings are the same.

- All types of jars, jars, and jars kept in the yard, if

are not used, should be kept face down so that they do not accumulate water inside, giving rise to water insects.

- There are often many ants in the kitchen because of the bad smell

The fishy smell of food invites them to come. Kitchen workers should be advised to always keep the kitchen clean, that is the way to avoid killing ants.

- All kinds of dishes, trays, pots, pans... that have ever contained

grease or fishy food, should not be kept in low places.

- When storing wine, workers often use boiling water

to rinse wash the wine jar. If you see water in the jar, there are definitely water insects, so you should pour that water into the river or lake before adding boiling water to wash the jar. If there are small spiders living in the jar, you should catch them and release them outside.

- Mosquitoes love the smell of alcohol, and often die

drowning in places containing alcohol. Therefore, jars, jars, and wine bottles should all be tightly covered.

- Hot or boiling water should not be poured haphazardly on

ground areas where insects live or dense green grass.

- Before making tea, you should bring copper basins,

wooden pot... used in making tea, wash in lake water, then add boiling water to make tea.

- In the summer, there are often many

small worms living on the charcoal surface, so let it dry in the sun [to avoid them] before putting it in the furnace.

- Scoop water into a jar to store wine, it is best to

use a clean white ceramic bowl.

- First time Store rainwater in jars, jars... you should put

in a little clean burning charcoal, this way it won't breed bacteria. If you already have parasites, you should use a thin silk towel to wrap around the outside of the bamboo basket and then gently place the basket in water. Take the water inside the basket and use it. There will be no parasites, saving the insects from being used to boil water to make tea.

- Water in jars, jars... if it has a bad smell, it cannot be used

used to make tea, encountered in places where rivers and streams are far away and inconvenient to travel, so use a bamboo basket wrapped in thin silk cloth around to filter the water to reduce the number of insects in the water, so you don't have to go to the river right away. If that still doesn't work, you should put that water in a separate jar and let the insects live there.

- The jars and jars contain water that has a lot of parasites in it, so you should cover it carefully to prevent rainwater from the roof

from flowing in, for fear that when it rains heavily, the water will overflow and the insects will be swept out and die.

- Tin boxes, ceramic vases... if used before to contain

food, the flavor cannot be completely lost. In the hot season, small insects will appear, so when using, do not pour boiling water into it immediately, [should be washed first with cold water].

- Vase of flowers, cup of water... placed on the table, just leave for a few days

In the hot season, the parasites are already in the water, so do not dump them on the ground.

- There are often a lot of firelights lit in the summer

Moths and moths fly to death, so make a small wooden shelf with a frame around the lamp, cover it with extremely thin silk. If not, you can use a thin copper shade with covered air vents above the lamp.

- When making objects and containers from bamboo,

wood, you should use all kinds of pepper and sulfur, put them in water and boil them, to avoid being eaten by termites.

- Cover the pen handle with green cloth to prevent termites from eating it.

- Types Clothes and hats made of sheep's wool or mink fur, as long as

hang them in a well-ventilated place, not near willow pollen, not near rice storage areas, they will not be eaten by moths.

- Clothes that are rubbed against generator1 will not be eaten by moths.

NOTE 1

Sinh example (生芋): we have not found out whether this noun phrase refers to a special type of plant. If understood in the common sense, this is taro for living.

- Types of bamboo, bamboo, and wood, if you want to soak them in

river water to clean, you must first observe and clean the small animals that are clinging to them. When soaking in the river, you should not leave it overnight.

- After soaking, the objects and containers must not be filled with river water inside.

tieu_de: Things to keep in mind when planting trees
noi_dung:
Things to keep in mind when planting trees

Bright flowers everywhere, beautiful grass filling the green yard, quiet contemplation, can all be the cause of killing animals, especially in the cool autumn when it happens more and more. Once you see fragrant flowers and strange grass, you immediately think of setting up a wine party for guests. The gluttons were happy when they saw this, but the animals died because of it!

- Up to half of the landowners used river mud to fertilize their fields, thus killing many animals. If it is possible to replace it with another type of fertilizer, it is highly recommended.

- In coastal areas, fiddler crabs live a lot, farmers often catch them and pound them to fertilize the fields to make good rice. If it is possible to ban this practice, it should be banned.

- Bamboo growers often use river mud as fertilizer

for good plants, not knowing that real river mud is not as good as moist ash. Furthermore, ash can make the soil porous, while river mud often gives birth to termites.

- Bamboo has just sprouted, and when you want to uproot it, you must pay close attention, because in spring, there are insects everywhere in the ground. When you want to uproot flowers and grass to other places, you must pay the same attention.

- Woody plants such as peach blossoms, apricot blossoms, elm trees,

willows... often produce a small type of woolly worm. If on the day of the Qingming Festival, at midnight, use a stalk of ghost rice1 to tie around the stem of the tree, there will be very few worms.

NOTE 1

Ghost rice: a type of bush grass identical to rice, also blooms like rice but cannot be eaten.

- On the trunk of a cinnamon tree, if you tie a sesame branch

to it, it will prevent weevils from forming in the trunk.

- Want to cut down and prune the overgrown branches on the tree,

should only be done in spring and winter, not summer or fall. Because in summer and autumn, small worms often grow on the back of leaves that live on the leaves. If there are many leaves, there will be many insects. If you prune dead branches, the leaves will die.

- There are birds flying to nest in trees in the garden. If they are in

low branches, they will be easily harmed by people, so chase them away and don't let them form nests. If you have accidentally formed a nest, you should pay close attention to protecting it.

- When you use a large clay pot to put mud in to plant

lotus flowers, there are many small insects living in that mud. Therefore, do not let the water dry out, nor do you pour the mud indiscriminately [because it will kill the insects].

- After flowering, the hibiscus tree usually has a lot of

NOTE 1

That is, the hibiscus tree is often grown as a fence.

small worms The green color clings to the leaves, so do not cut them and plant them.

- Chrysanthemum flowers often produce poisonous insects,

when you touch it, a blood-red fluid flows out, so this hobby is completely stopped. If you detect this type of worm on vegetables and fruits, you should leave it behind and do not harvest it.

- Mud deposited at the bottom of pipes and grooves, if used as fertilizer

to fertilize flowers and grass, or applied to the roots of beans, melons, peppers... of all kinds, in the fall will produce many poisonous insects.

- Watering plants, do not use water containing

many aquatic insects live in it.

- The vegetable garden is near the lake. If you use lake water for irrigation,

before taking the water, you should stir the surface of the lake for a while [so that the aquatic insects can escape].

- Florists often soak chicken feathers,

rotten beans and then use that water regularly to fertilize them. for plants, not knowing that there are many insects in that water. Once watered on the plant roots, those insects attract ants, not only harming many living things, but also causing the flower plants to not grow well. Therefore,

should be used

a bamboo basket wrapped in thin silk cloth, dropped into water and then scooped water from the basket and irrigated to avoid insects. After each use, you must take the basket out of the water and hang it up immediately. Do not soak in water.

- Collected rainwater often produces a lot of insects and larvae in it. If you use it to water plants, you should also filter the water with a bamboo basket. If you want to use water to make tea, you have to filter it like that.

- Beautiful fragrant flowers are often grown for the purpose of

to be enjoyed by others, so they should be planted in the garden, not placed inside the house.

tieu_de: Things to keep in mind during nursing
noi_dung:
Things to keep in mind in nutrition

Foods from cereals and legumes are still enough to nourish the body and spirit. You should not eat a lot of meat dishes. Many diseases are born from food entering the mouth, but this argument cannot be understood by gluttons. They only care about satisfying the delicious taste in three inches of their tongue, without thinking about protecting their body's health. People like that are pitiful, but [they make themselves miserable, so even if they die] there is no pity, it's just a pity for the wife and children who have to suffer because of them.

- According to health care, you should not eat buffalo meat,

because it can easily cause relapse of old diseases. People who have just recovered from malaria may not be able to sit up after eating.

Moreover, when eating buffalo meat, you should not drink white wine or eat it with chives or chestnuts, because the properties of these things are opposite.

- Dog meat can poison people and cause cancer

boil. Pregnant women who eat dog meat can give birth to children who cannot speak. In addition, dog meat should not be eaten with goat intestines or leeks or garlic.

- Pregnant women who eat goat liver are more likely to have children

sick, and cannot eat this dish with pork or pepper. Goat intestines should also not be eaten with sour apricots and red beans. Goat meat should not be eaten with fish cakes or curd.

- Eating pork after recovering from malaria can recur.

if eaten with buffalo meat, coriander can cause intestinal burns. If eaten with buckwheat or wheat, it can cause eyebrows and beards to fall out.

- People who like to eat deer meat, most of their bodies

are thin and thin, their gall bladder is small so they are easily scared. Deer fat should not be eaten with apricots and plums. Deer meat should not be eaten with sea bass1 or shrimp.

NOTE 1

Sea fish: a type of fish similar to sea fish but larger, scientific name is Leiocassis longirostris.

- Eating rabbit meat can cause physiological weakness. Pregnant women who eat rabbit meat may give birth to children with cleft lips. Eating it with chicken can cause dysentery, eating it with ginger root can cause diarrhea, eating it with broccoli will cause a relapse of the old disease.

- Eating goose meat and goose eggs can make

the disease difficult to cure. Do not eat with other types of meat such as domestic duck meat, mallard duck, turtle meat, pecans, black fungus,1 soybean sauce.

NOTE 1

White ear fungus: or white wood ear, an edible mushroom similar to black fungus (black wood ear) but white.

- Chickens with leprosy Do not eat it with

dishes such as leeks, mustard greens, and peaches.2

NOTE 2

Berries: fruit of the apple variety.

- Eating pheasant meat can easily cause ulcers and hemorrhoids,

people with blood diseases that take a long time to cure must be very careful not to eat. Do not eat it with dishes such as tilapia, anchovy, straw mushrooms, pecans.

- If pregnant women eat chicken with sticky rice, the child born

is susceptible to intestinal worms. Eating chicken eggs with carp will give birth to children who are susceptible to ulcers. Eating chicken meat with fresh fish can cause children to be deaf and dumb. When children often eat duck eggs, their lower leg bones gradually lose their hardness. If they eat a lot of shrimp, their lower leg bones gradually become bent, making it difficult to walk.

- Pregnant women who eat sparrow brains give birth to children who often suffer from night blindness. If mixed with alcohol to eat, the child will later develop lasciviousness. If eaten with soy sauce, the child will easily have many freckles on the skin. In addition, do not eat it with plums.

- Turtle meat is very poisonous, it is said that in this species there are

many of them transformed by red snakes. Pregnant women who eat it will give birth to babies with short necks and retracted heads. In addition, it cannot be eaten with chicken, eggs, or amaranth.

- Pregnant women eat a lot of crabs. When they give birth, the fetus

usually comes out horizontally. If you eat a lot of eels, fish, and eels, most cases will have a difficult birth. If you eat duck eggs along with berries, you will often have a breech fetus.

- Puffer fish is an extremely poisonous dish, you should never eat it.

- Eating a lot of burnt fish can easily get infected with pestilence, eating a lot of fish

can easily cause phlegm heat, causing scabies, eating a lot of shrimp can cause ulcers, epilepsy, eating a lot of catfish can easily cause hot flashes. restless. These are all aquatic dishes that are not beneficial for humans.

- Carp should not be eaten with dog meat or eggs

carp should not be eaten with pork liver, herring should not be eaten with anemones and leeks. Anchovy fish should not be eaten with buckwheat or wheat. Cattle fish should not be eaten with curd. Gecko fish should not be eaten with pork liver, chicken, pheasant meat, broccoli, or granulated sugar. These taboos are all because these dishes have contrasting properties.

tieu_de: Things to keep in mind when behaving
noi_dung:
Things to keep in mind in behavior

All good things in this world require skillful means to help those who do it first. Nowadays, if we make mistakes and wait until next year to fix them, it's a pity that time passes so quickly that we can't wait. Therefore, all words and actions during the day should be considered to always bring long-term benefits to the next person and further promote the good wisdom of the predecessor. [For example] the means to protect life are inherently unlimited, it is only up to each person to make their own efforts depending on their fate.

- On a long journey using horse power, in the countryside

village with oxen pulling buffaloes and plowing, you should pay attention to their labor and keep it moderate, as well as pay attention to their heat or cold, hunger and thirst.

- Fish and shrimp jump out of the water, the ignorant person sees it immediately

immediately think of spreading a net to catch it. People with the virtue of love for life must think of a way to return them to the water, and consider it as if they have just saved their loved ones from danger. They must hide it carefully so that others will not know, [for fear that they will try to catch them again.] If you meet someone who wants a net to catch birds, you must also find a way to save them.

- In the fall, the fields dry up, there are only places

deep puddles where a little water, fish and shrimp remain. There were countless people gathered there, all waiting to die when the water dried up. Seeing their miserable situation, trying to save them or spending money to hire someone to save them, [bringing them to places with water,] is the practice of accumulating merit. Every time you leave the house, it's best to plan to bring a small dipper [so that when you encounter it, you can pick up fish and shrimp from a small puddle].

- Along the riverbank, if you see snails that can

easily reach down and catch, you should pick them up and throw them into the middle of the stream [to prevent them from being caught by others].

- In the hot season, after every rain if see

If there is standing water in the yard, you must immediately dry it [to avoid germs in it].1

NOTE 1

Because stagnant water will breed bacteria, then they will definitely die when the water dries.

- During the summer months, mud accumulates under the fountain

grooves have countless small insects gathering in them. Once exposed to the hot sun, they will all die miserably with no way to avoid them, so you should find a way to cover them.

- In the summer, when drying dishes with insects

weevils, you should start drying them early in the morning, so that when the sun gradually heats up, the insects can find a way out.2

NOTE 2

If you wait until the sun is high to dry, the direct heat will make the insects burrow deep inside to hide. Then, when the sun gets hotter and hotter, they will die without being able to escape.

- When throwing away rotten objects, they should be thrown away

no sunlight shining in.

- In the summer, when eating and drinking at night, there are many

many moths and moths that will fly into the lamp and die. Therefore, if you hold a party, you should start after noon and end before dark.

- After each party, the food that falls on the

ground will often attract ants. Therefore, when organizing a party, you should prepare a container for leftover food to put everything in. Otherwise, as soon as the guests leave, you must immediately sweep the ground clean, absolutely do not leave it overnight.

- During the summer, when using fruits, things

that have sweet skins and seeds should not be thrown indiscriminately on the ground.

- In the hot season, when marinating fish and meat, you must have enough

salt. When preparing dried meat marinated in wine, you should use wine with high alcohol content.

- When collecting scrap paper to burn, first check

carefully whether there are ants in it and clean it before burning.

- When walking, I saw ants gathering on the road, so

showed others [to avoid trampling]. If you want to leave food for them, you should choose a secluded place that does not obstruct passersby.

- In your yard, you discover a spider spreading a web, if you don't

you should use your hands to destroy it.

- A person who truly has the virtue of filial piety, when he sees a mosquito in another person's mosquito net that has bitten it to its full blood, then quietly go and chase it away. other.1

NOTE 1

We have omitted two things in the original work that follow this, because the content is no longer consistent with current scientific knowledge.

- People with the virtue of loving life, do not harm themselves, but do not harm

harming things, but one day when you pass away, you can't be sure whether your future descendants will follow your example or not. Therefore, when people practice good deeds, when they are old and weak, they should prepare a will to leave, instructing future children and grandchildren to keep the precepts of not killing, practice loving kindness, and never be allowed to sacrifice fish and meat dishes.

tieu_de: Things to keep in mind when speaking
noi_dung:
Things to note in speech

When animals of all species are killed and mutilated, how pitiful their screams are. Sparkling knives, boiling pots of hot water, these humiliating tortures were displayed before our eyes without the opportunity to express even a single word of excuse. One can imagine that those animals must have had mouths in their previous lives but had never said anything kind or good [so they now have to suffer such retribution]. Now that I have seen such injustice of all species, when I open my mouth, I must be very attentive and say words of help and salvation for all species.

- A person with the virtue of love for life, whenever helping

next to the owner, should not mention things like eating this food is good [for health] or that food is not good, causing the owner to kill animals because he cares about eating and drinking. network].

- Those who keep the precepts of not killing must pay attention

does not discuss digging rivers or canals, repairing temples worshiping evil gods or devils, or advising people to make sacrifices to demons, encouraging interactions with mandarins, or repairing fields and gardens, because these are all things that lead to the killing of many animals.

- People who understand the principle of cause and effect absolutely do not

say things like this person has the virtue of love for life, should live a long life but dies prematurely, that person often kills, should have died prematurely but has a long life, this person eats salty food so his body is strong, that person is a vegetarian so he imagines emaciation and thinness...

- Parents or relatives If you are sick, you should invite a good doctor to treat you, and at the same time advise the patient to concentrate on reciting Buddha's name and not to invent things like fortune-telling or praying for ghosts and gods.

- When meeting someone who is sick, you should use sound reasoning

to advise and console, do not say things like that family lives by praying for a reversal, and another family dies because they do not pray for a reversal...

- Cures that require killing animals

to prepare should not be spread to others. Even the methods of cultivating flowers and planting trees that harm living things must not be passed down.

- People whose job is to kill living things,

even if they see that they are prosperous and wealthy, they should choose to advise them to change their profession, never praise that doing that job is good.

- Seeing others work to release animals, you must do your best

praise and praise, create conditions to help them complete that good deed, do not say words that hinder, make them discouraged and lose their good heart.

- In front of relatives, do not say that you

like to eat this or that animal. When meeting the chef who is slaughtering, do not say instructions such as this animal must be slaughtered like this, that animal must be slaughtered like that...

- Seeing and hearing about

's sumptuous eating and drinking

rich people are not allowed to say words of pleasure or joy.

- On the way to meet animals that are about to be killed, whether

are species on land or in the water, they should all have the same heart of compassion and help, do not distinguish between heavy and light, good or bad, high or low price.

- People with the virtue of love for life when talking to others

never say words like: there are many fish in the river, there are many birds in the forest, or there is that animal for sale...

- Places with high houses and deserted temples where sparrows are found to come to nest and lay eggs, must pay special attention to protection. Also, do not tell children that on that tree or in that place there are cicadas, butterflies, dragonflies...

- If you encounter animals such as snakes, centipedes, lizards, bees,

poisonous pests, do not tell others where you met them. If you encounter poisonous ants gathering, do not show that place to others.

- Poisonous remedies to kill fish and mice, right

be careful not to show it to others. If seen anywhere, find a way to destroy it immediately. The same goes for books that refute and slander Buddhism.

- People with the virtue of love for life do not encourage

others to raise animals such as chickens, ducks, goats, pigs, falcons, cats, hunting dogs... as well as all animals that harm other species.

tieu_de: Discuss encouragement and advice
noi_dung:
Discussing encouragement and advice

The Cu family1 was ashamed because he was the only gentleman,2 King Shun vowed to join everyone in the world in doing good deeds. People who are determined to save humanity are valued for their generous and generous heart, no matter where they are, they will touch many others. If we only rely on our own strength, then even if our mouth is tired, it will only be in vain and make others deaf, and it will have no effect. If you can get many people to believe and accept it and then continue to advise others, then the advice and guidance will be effective, without having to try too hard.

NOTE 1

Family name: Cu Ba Ngoc, real name Cu Vien (蘧瑗), title Ba Ngoc (伯玉), was a mandarin in the country of Wei during the Spring. Thu, through three dynasties: Ve Hien Cong, Ve Tuong Cong and Ve Linh Cong. Cu Ba Ngoc was famous for his virtue, and after his death, he was given the posthumous name Thanh Tu (成子).

NOTE 2

This sentence is probably inspired by the story of Cu Ba Ngoc passing by the gate of Ve Linh Cong palace late at night and still stopping to get out of the car according to ritual. Ve Linh Cong's wife only heard the sound of a car stopping at night and guessed it was him. Ve Linh Cong asked someone to ask, and sure enough, it was true, so he pretended to say to his wife: "You guessed wrong." Lady Ve Linh Cong immediately said: "Congratulations, Lord. I always thought that in Ve country, there was only Cu Ba Ngoc who was a gentle person. I didn't expect that there was a second person who was as virtuous as him." Duke Ve Linh immediately laughed and told the truth.

- A person with the virtue of love for life, if he holds a position close to

kings, should often use benevolence to advise and encourage people to stop fighting and fight, expand their careers, reduce taxes and labor, and promulgate edicts all over the world, each prefecture, each district, to set up ponds and lakes as places to release animals, and engrave stone stele to save them

so that all generations will know without change.

- Close friends set out to take over the management position in

localities should be advised to have a plan to apply immediately upon arrival, which is to issue a ban on slaughtering dogs and buffaloes; If that locality has a long river and a wide lagoon, it should immediately set up ponds to release animals, and encourage people to carve stone stele and place it there for permanent preservation.

- For shrines worshiping all kinds of demons and gods who enjoy sacrifices

with flesh and blood, in places where people who seek sacrifices often gather in large numbers, a stone stele should be engraved and erected, the content clearly stating the causes of the demons and gods' fall, the reasons Life and death have a destiny, the killing of the last living thing must be eternal, or quote Buddha's teachings, or tell stories of cause and effect and retribution, so that everyone can see.

- At city gates, pagodas, shrines,

and places where many people pass by, cause and effect retribution should be written, advising people not to kill, and posted so that everyone can see.

- On the occasions of celebrating the birthdays of close friends,

Therefore, we encourage them to buy animals to release animals, making it a permanent practice.

- Those who seek to have children, seek success in their career

career, regarding their most earnest wishes, should advise them of not killing.

- When going on a long trip or going to a friend's house, they should give advice. Bring

with you to give them a text encouraging goodness and advising not to kill.

- People in times of extreme hardship often turn

back to the source of their original mind, that is natural. Therefore, for those who are sick, we should strongly advise them to keep the precept not to kill.

- When coming to the home of fortune-tellers, we should

advise them not to tell others to make offerings to pray for islands.

- When meeting people who make weapons and tools to kill life objects, they should choose to advise them to change their lives. profession.

tieu_de: Discussing mantra recitation
noi_dung:
Discussing the recitation of mantra

Mantra is the secret language of the Buddhas, transmitted to the East, [is the essence of the scriptures, so] it is very worthy to be considered as precious as curdled milk, like glue; It is the magical medicine Agada that cures all diseases, and the nectar that soothes the forest of afflictions. If you believe, receive, and recite just one verse or half of a verse, you will have the ability to end suffering and help all of the three evil paths. You don't have to spend a lot of money to help countless living beings, so you have to be careful and recite it often, don't waste time.

- Early in the morning, as soon as you wake up, recite the verse 7 times

and pay attention not to harm insects, then put your feet down on the bed and walk, with awareness you will not trample on insects, ants, cockroaches... The verse and mantra are as follows:

Tung trieu gradually dan direct even tomb,
All sentient beings recover themselves.
If you fall in love,1

NOTE 1

We recorded this verse according to the original Chinese text of the Complete Book of An Si. According to the novice monk's rule on the essential monk's note (沙彌律儀要略增註), in volume 60 of the Sutta Pitaka, sutra number 1118 (a total of two volumes), starting from the 10th line, page 258, sheet a, volume 2, this verse is: 若 於足下喪身形 - Cons U tuc lowers the body. (If under my feet my form is shattered.) Many other texts also say the same as this sentence, or according to the essential daily use of Bhikkhuni (毗尼日用切要 - volume 1), it is: 若於足下喪其形 - Nhuoc uc summer disperses the strange form.

Prayer immediately give birth to the Pure Land.

Translation:

From morning to evening,
May all living beings,
All protect themselves.
All sentient beings are heartless,
Be trampled and lose their lives,
Please pray for all All of them,
Are all born in the Pure Land.

This mantra is also recorded according to An Si Complete Book: 唵地利日(音支) 利娑婆訶 - but according to the Essential Daily Use of Bhikkhuni (毗尼日用切 要), in volume 60 of the Sutta Pitaka, number 1115, there is one volume, this mantra is: 唵逸帝律尼莎訶 - An yi di luat ni sa ha.

- People who have the virtue of loving life should often recite the name

Bao Thang Tathagata, write a midwifery spell and drop it into rivers and wells, which can help the insects there to be reborn in a good realm after death. The mantra is as follows:

“Phat puc ta ba la ma ni sa ha.”

- When planting cereals, you should take out a

th1 seed, bless it with 21 mantras,

NOTE 1

Thang: a unit of measurement, equal to one-tenth of a cup, equivalent to about 1 liter today.

and then mixed with the seeds to sow, there will be no

ants eating the seeds, nor will the seeds be eaten by

pest damage. The mantra is as follows: “Da chach tha, sa la bat de, na sa ba de.”

- If you are a person with the virtue of love for life, and in your heart really want to

be vegetarian but due to difficult circumstances cannot do it, then before eating meat and fish dishes you should silently recite this mantra three times:

“Dada tha, a complaint Ma a Nai Ma, A Thi Ba Da, A Thi Ba Da,

na xa na xa, da ha da ha, she phut ba phu, kha adventure da Nhi, sa ha.”

- Seeing other people netting fish, catching birds, slaughtering animals

things, you should generate great compassion, silently recite the name in your heart Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, or reciting the Great Compassion Mantra, the Rebirth Mantra, the Standard Deity Mantra... will benefit immensely. There are many mantras, it is impossible to list them all here.

tieu_de: Discuss sympathy for animals
noi_dung:
Discussing sympathy for animals

If we humans just dip a finger into boiling water, it will be as painful as if our whole body was cut with a knife, [let alone killing living beings by stabbing, cutting, and cooking in all kinds of ways.] The retribution of such killing is very difficult. avoid it, even if you go through

eons, you still have to repay it in full. Therefore, as soon as a thought of killing arises, we must immediately and strongly stop it. Efforts to do good deeds must be like people who are hungry and thirsty [need to eat and drink], only then can they gradually become compatible with the virtue of benevolence.

- People who have the virtue of love for life and want to completely eliminate the karma of killing

should first calm down and think about the fact that all animals, when mother and child are together, are attached to each other and love each other for a minute without leaving, compared to the fraught and difficult to end maternal love in humans. difference. After thinking like that, compassion will surely arise, [it is impossible to kill a living thing].

- You should calmly observe all animals.

eat and drink are often not enough, you work hard and run everywhere just to be satisfied, there are many miserable things. Think again, if we encounter years of poor harvests and famine, we are just as miserable as them. After thinking like that, compassion will surely arise, knowing how to pity animals.

- Again calmly observe animals, at times when being chased by

people, or run away in fear, or scream in pain, even try to climb walls, overcome fences, crawl into deep caves, escape to open fields, find ways to escape. If compared to us humans, when we are chased by kings and officials, we are frightened and frightened, we are really no different from them. After thinking like that, compassion will surely arise, knowing how to pity animals.

- Again calmly observe animals, at times of suffering

the person being brought to slaughter, either the intestines or liver have been cut open but the eyes are still open with hatred and do not want to close, or the throat has been severed but the limbs are still twitching in pain. If compared to us humans when we are seriously ill and about to die, the last signs of struggle before dying are no different from them. After thinking like that, compassion will surely arise, knowing how to pity animals.

- Again calmly observe animals after being slaughtered by humans

. If you kill a goat, the whole herd of goats will be scared. If you shoot a bird, the whole flock of birds will be scared and fly away. If compared to us humans, when bandits invade and massacre an entire area, see our parents scattered with blood and flesh, or see our wives and children being taken away one by one, the pain and fear in our hearts is no different from theirs. After thinking like that, compassion will surely arise, knowing how to pity animals.

tieu_de: Discussing repentance for mistakes
noi_dung:
Discussing repentance for mistakes

How scary [to be born in] the impure Saha world. In this world, ordinary people are crazy, confused, and delusional, and the bad and evil conditions are becoming stronger and stronger, while the good conditions are becoming more and more few and small. Grief and sadness are often so overwhelming that it seems unbearable.

People in this life are always stagnant and procrastinated, accustomed to following old habits without repenting of their mistakes, waiting until

in the next life they want to repent lest they have no chance. Resentment and hatred created before and after must be gradually repaid without running away. In the past, no one has been able to escape?

- People with the virtue of love for life, when faced with war and fire

through the area, there were robbers and robbers, and seeing dead bodies lying everywhere, I thought it was due to the crime of killing. Thinking that we here, in this life as well as in previous lives, have created the karma of killing living beings like that, so in the future we will also have to suffer the retribution of such a miserable death. Thinking like that, I immediately repented.

- When encountering times of famine, seeing people

competing and devouring each other, one should think that it is because of the destruction of nature that all things are now suffering the retribution of such misery and hunger. I thought that I had also committed such bad karma, and in the future it would be inevitable that I would also have to suffer such famine and starvation. Think like that and immediately repent.

- Seeing others in danger of fire, or being burned

drowning, relatives and flesh have to be separated, so think that this is the retribution for actions such as filling animal holes, destroying bird nests, boiling living beings in hot water and oil. I have done such things myself, so in the future I will definitely have to endure such situations. Thinking like that, he immediately repented.

- Seeing the scene of young mothers giving birth to difficult

difficult children, in the end both mother and child had premature lives, so he thought that this was the retribution for the previous acts of destroying animal eggs. Thinking that I could have done the same thing before and would have suffered the same retribution. Thinking like that, he immediately repented.

- Seeing the scene of sick people, their bodies

having to endure thousands of sufferings, blood and pus all over their bodies, they thought that this was the retribution for previously beating and torturing living beings. Thinking that if I ever did that, once karma came, I would not be able to avoid having to suffer like that. Thinking like that, I immediately repented.

- Seeing prisoners suffering serious crimes, physically

being imprisoned in prison, having to endure shackles for many years, one should think that this is the retribution for previously imprisoning and torturing sentient beings. Thinking that, in previous lives, it is very likely that I have also committed similar crimes, and will surely suffer the same retribution. Thinking like that, I immediately repented.

- Seeing people being mauled by tigers, bitten by snakes, or

hanging themselves, drinking poison and committing suicide, one should think that this is the retribution for having previously used knives, sticks, and poison to persecute sentient beings. Thinking about it again, I'm not sure that I won't be able to encounter such retributions in the future. Thinking like that, I immediately tried my best to repent.

tieu_de: Discussing the development of Bodhi mind
noi_dung:
Discussing the development of Bodhi mind

Immense and countless lands in the ten directions, all are included in the self-nature. Therefore, it is my fault that sentient beings have not yet been saved. If you want to make a great vow to save all sentient beings in the Three Realms, it is necessary to direct your mind to the two worlds of gods and humans, through many lifetimes of complete salvation. The two words "develop the mind" have an extremely vast meaning, all Buddhas appear clearly in it.

- People who develop the Bodhi mind and see animals while in the mother's womb must suffer extremely. Once the mother animal is killed, the baby animal must also die. Seeing this, you should imagine and visualize that it was your relative in your previous life, and immediately make a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood, and will cause all sentient beings in the ten directions to be reincarnated from the lotus flower, and not have to endure countless sufferings in the womb.

- A person who develops the Bodhi mind sees animals carrying them

feathered with horns, turned his back to face the blue sky, and immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood, and will make all living beings in the ten directions have thirty-two good signs, eighty beauty, majestic virtue, and a halo of light illuminating the endless realms.

- The person who develops the mind of Bodhi, sees animals being imprisoned

locked in a cage, unable to be free, immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood, and will make all sentient beings in the ten directions have great power, walk, fly and jump freely as they please, transform and wander around the ten directions without fear.

- People who develop the mind of Bodhi, see animals sitting and lying down

In the filth, but willing to endure without complaint, eating and drinking nothing but the dregs of bran, immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood, will make all sentient beings in the ten directions take the joy of meditation as food, have all the delicious dishes of heaven, have enough at their disposal, and be naturally born in the palace with the seven treasures, have all the countless and solemn blessings that cannot be achieved. says it all.

- The person who develops the mind of Bodhi, sees the animals that are raised to eat and then killed, often filled with fear and panic, immediately makes a great and profound vow: May I soon attain Buddhahood, and will make all sentient beings in the ten directions live peacefully and happily together, love and respect each other, even in their dreams. resentful thoughts arise.

- People who develop Bodhi mind and see animals must

carry heavy loads to repay karma

having borrowed from someone else from a previous life, I immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood and will cause all sentient beings in the ten directions to be eliminated from all serious sins for many lifetimes, and even those with heavy debts and hatred will treat each other like relatives and friends.

- A person who develops the mind of Bodhi, sees an animal that, despite making

makes sounds that cannot be put into meaningful words, until being brought to death, can only cry out in sorrow but cannot file any complaints, immediately makes a great and far-reaching vow: May I soon attain Buddhahood, and will make all sentient beings in the ten directions have wisdom and eloquence, and be able to speak skillfully. can distinguish the worldly path from the worldly path.

- People who develop Bodhi mind, see animals when leaving

my life under the tip of a sharp knife, this place howling in sorrow, that place blood spurting loudly, immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon become a Buddha. For all sentient beings in the ten directions, those who are suffering from the suffering of soldiers and knives, I will save them all, making them all have an endless life, and never even have to hear the two words of life and death in their ears.

- A person who develops the mind of Bodhi, sees animals with mothers

children divided, couples separated, immediately makes a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon attain Buddhahood, will make all sentient beings in the ten directions

all be reunited by mother and child, husband and wife will live together until the end of their lives, and understand clearly that love between couples is like a shackle. forced.

- A person who develops Bodhi mind sees animals being fried

to stir-fry and cook to serve food to people's mouths, he immediately made a great and profound vow: I pray that I will soon achieve Buddhahood, will make all sentient beings in the ten directions be properly harmonized by the four elements in the body, free from all suffering and pain, forever no longer fond of dishes made from the flesh and blood of sentient beings, and finally attain Buddhahood.

tieu_de: AFTERWORD
noi_dung:
AFFORD

This book Van Thien Tien Tu is the work of Layman Hoai Tay,1 my great-grandfather. When I was young, when I reviewed the table of contents before describing his books promoting charity, among them I found the books Van Thien Tien Tu and Duc Hai Hoi Crazy, the originals have been lost for a long time, and the printed copies are no longer found. I tried to find it but couldn't find it.

NOTE 1

Layman Hoai Tay is the name of Mr. Chu An Si.

More than 30 years later, in the winter of the year Giap Dan,2 I found a printed copy of the book Duc Hai crazy, so happy like receiving a precious jade. I immediately brought the book and presented it to Mr. Nam Thon. He was delighted and immediately ordered the engraving to be reprinted for widespread distribution. But at that time, I had not yet found the book Van Thien Tien Tu , so I was still worried and worried.

NOTE 2

That is in 1794. Mr. Hue Dien is Mr. An Si's nephew, who calls Mr. An Si by his great-grandfather, referring to his great-grandfather's table of contents from more than 30 years ago, that is, before 1764 and was at an age where he could read books. From that, it can be inferred that this person was born about 15 - 20 years before 1764, around the 1740s. Mr. An Si died in 1739, and this grandson may have never known his great-grandfather.

In the spring of the year At Suu,3 Mr. Ha Mac, a brother of Lam Giam Duong, brought a copy of this book to give as a gift. for me, as happy as myself

NOTE 3

That is the year 1805.

to see the Buddha. I think about the works of my ancestors, which have now been completely rediscovered, and I am so happy that I cannot express it enough.

When it comes to keeping the precept of not killing, although it is the Buddha's teaching, compared to the Confucian meaning of "not having the heart"1, we still have the same mental origin. This book "Van Thien Tien Tu" encourages and admonishes each thing clearly and clearly, explains doubts, and every point is carefully detailed, indeed extremely thorough and complete. If anyone can follow it, they will attain great virtue, the same as heaven and earth. If everyone follows it, they will be able to have the same use [with great compassion] to save all birds, animals, fish, turtles... from ancient times to the present.

NOTE 1

Unwillingness: Inspired by the teachings of Confucianism: "If one sees birth, one cannot bear the other, one cannot endure death; one cannot endure the purity of speech." (If you see a living animal, you can't bear to see it die. When you hear its cry, you can't bear to eat it.)

If that is not the case, you should sincerely read this book every morning and night to alert yourself and consider whether in your compassionate heart, is there not a little bit of guilt and anxiety [when killing and eating all living things]? Just [having a little bit of guilt and anxiety] like that is already a useful thing for us on the path to goodness.

However, my heart always hopes that the reader of this book, once he calms down and returns to contemplation, knowing compassion for all living beings who are greedy for life and afraid of death, will immediately compare

with the human psychological tendency to seek a safe place, avoid dangerous places, and then be able to sympathize and understand. Since I do not have the heart to harm the lives of animals, how can I have the heart to cause harm to my fellow human beings so that they cannot achieve what they desire? The great vow to help and benefit sentient beings does not lie in the difference between poverty and misery or glory and wealth, but only in whether or not there is a skillful understanding and acceptance of the content of this book.

In the fall of this year, there were like-minded friends who saw this book and were all happy to contribute money to use it to engrave and print it. After three months, the printing was completed. Seeing the desire to do good deeds of the sages and gentlemen, surely my great-grandfather would also smile in the Western Pure Land.

Year of the Dragon, Gia Khanh era

13th year,1 December 16,

NOTE 1

That is the year 1808.

his great-grandson Hue Dien

bowed a hundred times, respectfully added the afterword

tieu_de: Preface: Precepts to kill and release living beings
noi_dung:
APPENDIX

Foreword Preface to Killing and Releasing Living Things

Master Lien Tri mastered the six arts in his youth,1 his literature was famous far and wide. He diligently studied deeply the teachings of the Three Vehicles,2 grasped the principle, achieved enlightenment, and transcended ordinary things. He courageously wears the armor of diligence, wisely holds the pearl of wisdom, and has great compassion for those who are still ignorant, so he pays special attention to the precepts of not killing.

NOTE 1

There are 2 ways of understanding the six arts. One is only six subjects of knowledge that were considered common in ancient times, including: rituals (rituals), music (music), archery (archery), languages ​​(chariot driving), letters (literature) and numbers (mathematics). However, because of the meaning of the next sentence, we lean towards the second interpretation, also called the Six Classics, which refers to six sets of classic Confucian textbooks, including: Classic of Poetry, Classic of Books, Classic of Rites, Classic of Music, Classic of Changes and Spring and Autumn Classic.

NOTE 2

The Three Vehicles: include the Hinayana (or Sravaka Vehicle), the Middle Vehicle (or Pratyekabuddha Vehicle) and the Mahayana (or Bodhisattva Vehicle).

All creatures with blood and spirit have sentience and feeling, all creatures that move and fly share the same nature with us. To fill your stomach, should you kill all things? Heaven has the virtue of love for life, and accordingly, we should guide those who are still lost.

Oh, everyone has a heart of compassion, but the tragedy of cutting and cooking happens clearly in

everywhere. Imprisoning and slaughtering all species, people have always considered it a normal thing, killing animals all the time, does it seem like we are any different from animals? Even the sting of a mosquito and a bee causes frustration. How can you cut and chop an animal without pity? Dissecting the flesh of all living things and then putting them in your mouth to fill your stomach, try to calm down and consider where your virtue lies? Think about the future retribution, how can you refuse to run away when faced with resentment? Once you have drifted into the spiral of strength winning and weakness, revolving around eating and devouring each other, you will have to continue on the path of borrowing and repaying, and forever immersing yourself in the cycle of birth and death.

Therefore, the Tathagata has lit a bright torch of wisdom in the midst of darkness, saving suffering sentient beings from the eight misfortunes, teaching people to put an end to the causes of killing, so they will no longer be bound by evil karma. Nowadays, the Dharma is increasingly declining, people have long forgotten the miraculous teachings of the Tathagata. Great Master Lien Tri single-handedly swept away the mud and mud of the five desires,1 clearly explained the precepts in the Three Realms, in the sea of ​​sounds chanting [this text as] a boat of wisdom and vows, helping those who are immersed in the ocean of suffering, bringing all to the most true place.

NOTE 1

Five desires (five desires): that is, the satisfaction of satisfying the five senses, including the eyes liking beautiful shapes (lust), the ears liking soothing sounds (lust), the nose liking fragrance (smell desire), the tongue liking delicious tastes (taste desire) and the body liking soft touch (tactile desire). The five desires are the most basic reason that pushes people deeper into sin, just because they want to enjoy them. Therefore, Buddhism views the five desires as mud that needs to be avoided instead of being indulgent and indulgent.

Oh, what a good intention! The Dharma is inherently undivided, and once it is attained, it will reach the realm of non-duality; Religion is not divided into saints or mortals, the most important thing is deep faith. We just need to be able to keep and follow the precepts of not killing as given by our teacher, and then examine carefully to see where the cause of the thought of killing in our hearts comes from.

Is it from this wonderful spiritual awareness? Or from this body of bones, skin, flesh and blood? But the root of the mind is compassion, so where does the cruel thought of killing arise? The body, bones, and flesh do not have clear consciousness, so how can it contain enough greed and anger? [Considering that when] the mind is empty, praise and criticism will not be known, so the desire for that taste does not come from the physical body. But when the body is quiet, love or hate cannot arise on its own, so the desire to kill is not really due to the mind.

Neither body nor mind is the place of origin, so where does [the idea of ​​killing] come from? So know that both body and mind are inherently pure, only because they have long accumulated illusions and delusions that they become bound. Reaching the magical place of pure nature, keeping this precept [not killing] will no longer depend on the external environment; If you can remove the bondage of illusion and delusion, great compassion will no longer be hindered in your mind. Entering great concentration and achieving Buddhahood all come from this place.

When I was a child, I heard the teachings of Mencius

that "A gentleman stays away from the kitchen",1 that is due to his great love for animals, [not wanting to see killing]. Now I can read this text on Precepts by Great Master Lien Tri. It is truly a concept that benefits even insects and protects the life of all living things. [After reading this text] I immediately teach my children to learn and follow, and hope to be able to preserve it widely and spread it everywhere.

NOTE 1

This sentence is taken from the book Mencius, chapter King Liang Hui, section 7. The original text of this paragraph is: 君子之於禽獸也，見其生，不忍見其死；聞其聲，不忍食其肉。是以君子遠庖廚也。- A gentleman is a beast, a man can't bear to see a son, a man can't bear to be so humiliated. This is the place where a gentleman wears a long-sleeved dress. (When a gentleman deals with an animal, when he sees it alive, he cannot bear to see it die. When he hears its cry [when being killed], he cannot bear to eat it. Therefore, the gentleman stays away from the kitchen.)

Four doctors came from,2 Dai Phuc Quang Loc,

NOTE 2

According to the examination regulations applied in the Ming Dynasty, those who passed doctoral degrees were divided from high to low including: 1. The Nhat Giap (3 people) including Poinsettia (first), Bang Nhan (second), Tham Hoa (third) are collectively called The Four First Doctors; 2. Row Nhi Giap (17 people) are called Four Doctors of Origin; 3. The Tam Giap row (80 people, later increased to 130 people) is called Dong Doctors from Origin. Thus, this person passed his doctorate in the Second Armor class.

Crown Prince Thai Bao,3 Again, Ministry of Ministers,

NOTE 3

Thai Bao is the official in charge of teaching in the palace. Crown Prince Thai Bao is in charge of teaching the Crown Prince's studies.

Vu Anh Dien is a scholar, Tried the national history report and the general treasurer, the person in Hai Ngu town4 was Nghiem Not who composed5

NOTE 4

Hai Ngu (海虞): belongs to Chang Shu county, Jiangsu province.

NOTE 5

Nghiem No, given name is Man Khanh, born in 1511, died in 1584, from Chang Shu county, Jiangsu province, after death the king gave him the posthumous name Wen Jing. He passed his doctorate in 1541, during the reign of King Minh The Tong, and was promoted to the positions of Rites of the Left Thi Lang, Rites of the Right Thi Lang, and the Ministry of Ministers.

tieu_de: 1. Literature precepts
noi_dung:
THE TEXT OF THE RELEASE OF SURVIVAL

Ming Dynasty, Van The Pagoda, Co Hang land, the monk Chu Hoanh composed the text and annotated it1

NOTE 1
