The monk Chu Hoanh is the Great Master Lien Tri. The annotations of the original work are extensive explanations, and the footnotes are ours (Vietnamese translation).

1. Literature precepts

Introduction:

People in this world take meat and fish as a matter of course, so they indulge in killing, creating deep and widespread resentment. It goes on like this for a long time, life after life, it becomes a habit, to the point that we no longer recognize that it is wrong. It is true as the ancients once said: "It is truly worth the pain and tears and endless mourning!"

The points of ignorance and stubbornness in not understanding correctly of people can be summarized into seven things presented below, but in addition, we can also extrapolate from there to know.

Broad explanation:

All sentient beings have the same nature,

but humans It's extremely strange for people to eat meat from all kinds of animals. The reason why I don't see it as strange is because the family has been accustomed to following that habit for many generations, and neighbors have also imitated each other's habits over time, becoming a custom. When you've been used to doing something like that for a long time, you no longer know it's wrong, but instead think it's right and reasonable. How can you still see it as a strange thing? If today there were someone who killed someone and cut them up to eat, everyone would be horrified and would immediately be arrested and sentenced to death. Why? That's because I'm not used to doing that.

If killing was not strictly prohibited and everyone followed it for many years, surely all over the world we would see human meat being put into the kitchen to cook!

That's why it's said: "All people in this world follow each other without knowing it's wrong. It's truly worthy of our tears, pain, and endless mourning!"

The first mistake: Celebrate birthdays and don't kill them

The parents who gave birth to us worked hard and worked hard. how much! The day we start to have this body is also the day our parents have to start facing difficulties and come closer to death. Therefore, this is the day we should fast, keep the precepts not to kill, do good deeds, pray for our parents, if they have passed away soon, to be liberated, and if they are still present, their blessings will increase. How can we quickly forget the dangerous suffering of our mother [on the day of our birth] and kill living beings? On top, causing

evil karma that implicates our parents, and on the bottom, causing ourselves to suffer many disadvantages?

Extensive explanation:

Dang Thai Tong in the past was a noble king, wealthy like no one,1 but on his birthday he was not even happy. The landowner arrogantly2 only had a bountiful harvest of ten bouts of grain, but the guests filled the house with joy, feasting continuously for many days. I really don't know what can be done like that?

NOTE 1

The original work used “萬乘之主 - owner of ten thousand vehicles” (owner of ten thousand carriages), intended to describe wealth. yes.

NOTE 2

The original work uses “田舍翁 - Dien Xa Ong” to refer to the farmer who owns the land, but it also implies rusticity and lack of knowledge. Bach Ju Di in the poem Buying Flowers (買花) has the line: “有一田舍翁，偶來買花處。” (The land of the estate is always the same, the land of flowers is forever. – There was a landowner who [did not know anything but] randomly went to the place to buy flowers.)

Nowadays there are also people on their birthday. Organizing offerings to monks, reciting sutras, doing good deeds, what a precious and beautiful thing!

Second mistake: Do not kill when you celebrate the birth of a child

People who do not have children are sad, but when they have children, they are happy. However, we refuse to think that all living beings know how to love their children just as much as we do.

To be happy on the day our child is born, but causes the children of animals to die, can we have peace in our hearts?

When a child has just been born, he doesn't know that because he is accumulating merit and virtue, on the contrary, he kills lives and creates bad karma, it's truly too fascinating. Sister.

This mistake that all people in life follow without knowing it is wrong, is the second thing that is truly worthy of tears, pain, and endless regret!

Explain widely:

Once upon a time, there was a hunter who got too drunk one night, looked at his small child and thought it was a deer.1 immediately sharpened his knife to kill him. The wife cried to stop him, but he did not listen, just cut open the stomach and slaughtered it, then left it there to sleep.

NOTE 1

The muntjac (chap): a wild animal similar to a deer but much smaller.

The next morning, he woke up and called his son to go to the market to sell muntjac meat. The wife cried and said, "Last night you killed me." Hearing that, the hunter fell to the ground, his insides as if someone had torn them apart! Alas, although people and animals are different, love for children is no different. Can we be cruel in killing?

Third mistake: On death anniversary, you should not kill

On days when worshiping ancestors is taboo, as well as on death anniversaries of deceased relatives, or on spring and autumn ceremonies in the two seasons of the year,1 are not allowed to kill life objects. Wanting to bless people in the underworld, but killing animals to make offerings, only increases bad karma. Oh, [killing animals to make] so many dishes are spread out on the table, but how can you wake up the bones of the dead from nine streams to eat? It's useless and causes so much harm, so wise people decide that no one would do that.

NOTE 1

Ancient Chinese custom had two major sacrifices a year in spring and autumn. Vietnam does not have this custom, but there are a number of other rituals that people often worship their ancestors, such as the custom of worshiping and receiving grandparents before New Year's Eve, or worshiping on the fifth day of the fifth month, the full moon day of the seventh month, etc.

This mistake that all people follow without knowing it is wrong, is the third thing that is truly worthy of tears of pain and endless regret!

Extensive explanation:

Some people say that Emperor Wu of Liang used flour to make sacrificial animals instead of living animals. People criticized that this meant that his ancestors could not enjoy wine and meat. Alas, fish meat is not necessarily delicious, vegetables are not necessarily inferior. As a child, the most precious thing for your parents is to be careful to correct yourself. Even if there are some shortcomings in worshiping your ancestors, it is still good. Why is it necessary to use the flesh and blood of living beings every time you worship? The I Ching teaches that: “Simple but sincere worship is better than someone who

kills a buffalo.” The saints have taught that raising animals for sacrifice is unfilial. Is it necessary that every time an offering be made, one must use the flesh and blood of sentient beings?

Fourth mistake: Wedding should not kill

People in the world organize marriage ceremonies, from the proposal, the ceremony... to the official marriage, it's really unknown how many life objects they have killed. Oh, marriage is the starting point of having children later, but the beginning of procreation is doing something that kills life, how wrong it is!

Furthermore, marriage is a good thing, but on a good day, doing something bad, killing animals, isn't that pitiful?

This mistake that all people follow each other without knowing it is wrong, is the true fourth thing. worthy of our tears of pain and inconsolable grief!

Broadly speaking:

When people encounter marriage, they wish the couple to live together until their teeth turn gray. We wish to live together until old age, so do the birds and animals wish to separate and die early? When a family has a daughter getting married, they can't sleep for three nights because they think about the impending separation.1 I feel the separation

NOTE 1

This sentence is inspired by the words of Confucius: 嫁女之 家，三夜不息燭，思相 離也 - If the daughter of the family is married, if the three hearts are suddenly wished, the thoughts will be far apart. (A family has a daughter who gets married, and doesn't turn off the torch [to go to sleep] for three nights in a row, thinking about the impending separation.)

is suffering, how can birds and animals be happy if they are separated? Therefore, it can be believed that, in marriage, one should indeed not kill living things.

Fifth mistake: Hosting guests should not kill

The weather is beautiful and the scenery is beautiful, the host is kind and welcomes kind guests, even if the food and vegetables are meager, it will not hinder elegant joy, there is no need to kill living things. Praying for delicious, sweet and nutritious food, full of singing and singing around the banquet table, causing all the slaughtered animals to scream in anger at the knife and chopping board. Alas, if we are truly human, how can we not be merciful?

Extensive explanation:

If you know that the dishes displayed on that table are obtained from the cries of resentment at the knife and chopping board, you must see that you have used the extreme pain and suffering of all living beings to make your own joy and pleasure, then even if you force yourself to put it in your mouth, you will not be able to swallow it! Is it possible to not be sad?

The sixth mistake: Don't kill when praying for peace

When people get sick, they immediately kill life animals and sacrifice to gods to bless themselves, but don't

think about making sacrifices to gods because they want to avoid death. to live, but then kill other lives in the hope of prolonging your own life, there is truly nothing that could be more contrary to the will of heaven, more contrary to reason.

Oh, only righteous people [after death] can become gods, so do gods have personal bias? Life cannot really be prolonged [that way], but the karma of killing created is enough to not be lost, [it must be repaid. Not only praying for healing from illness and living a long life,] all the sacrifices to pray for evil spirits and demons to pray for other things are the same.

This mistake that all people follow without knowing it is wrong, is the sixth thing that is truly worthy of tears, pain, and endless lament!

Teaching extensive:

The Medicine Master Sutra teaches that: "Killing all living beings to make offerings to the gods, calling out to demons and demons, praying for blessings to help you, wanting to increase your lifespan, is ultimately impossible."1

NOTE 1

Excerpted from the Medicine Master Sutra Lapis La Light Tathagata The Original Vow of Merit (藥師琉璃光如來本願功德經), is classified in the Mahazheng Pitaka of Volume 14 of Sutra No. 450 (1 volume). This excerpt is on page 408, sheet a, starting on line 7.

So it is said that life cannot last, but the karma of killing will last forever. All of the prayers to avert evil spirits, such as killing and worshiping animals

, praying for a child, praying for money and wealth, praying for officials' benefits, such as having children, fortune, or being an official, are all due to that person's own karma, not due to demons. There are times when one's wish is suddenly fulfilled, and one thinks it is sacred, so the false belief becomes even stronger, and one is even more devoted to such sacrifices. Those who fall into such serious wrong views are truly irredeemable, pitiful!

The seventh mistake: To make a living, one should not kill

People in this world choose to take up jobs such as hunting, fishing, or slaughtering buffalos, goats, pigs, dogs, just for the sake of food and clothing... But according to my observations, if you don't do those jobs, you can still earn food and clothing, not necessarily to the point of having to starve and die. Choosing the profession of killing to make a living, one cannot avoid being punished by the gods. It's like following the profession of killing and becoming rich, a hundred people have never seen one! If we consider the deep consequences of going to hell and suffering bad karma in many future lives, there is truly nothing more harmful than doing these jobs. Why do we have to work hard to pursue it and not find another good profession to make a living?

This mistake that all people in the world follow without knowing it is wrong, is the seventh thing that is truly worthy of tears of pain and inconsolable regret!

Broadly explained:

I myself once saw a person who worked as a goat slaughterer, when he was about to die, suddenly bleated like a goat, a person who worked as an eel seller, when he was about to die, suddenly felt as if his head was being bitten by an eel. Both of these things happened in my neighborhood, not based on legend at all. I advise everyone, if you encounter a time when you don't know what to do for a living, it's better to beg for food. If you have to create the karma of killing to save your life, it is better to starve and die. Alas, is it possible to stop killing?

What is presented above are seven extremely absurd things, but people often do them. If a knowledgeable person looks through it, they will see that they are all valid arguments. If everything could be prevented, there would be nothing better. If that's not the case, you can gradually reduce it according to your strength, or eliminate four or five things, or prevent a few things...

Getting rid of one thing will eliminate a portion of bad karma, killing one less time will eliminate one grudge. If you can't completely abstain from meat and fish as a vegetarian, you should first switch to buying and using commercially available items to avoid killing yourself, which will also reduce some of your sins. Knowing how to nurture loving-kindness will gradually reach a good place.

I hope that those who are fortunate enough to encounter this text will pass it around and spread it widely, taking turns encouraging and advising people.

Advising one person to stop killing means saving hundreds of thousands of lives. Advise ten people, hundreds of people, even thousands of people, then the virtue is extremely great, the good results are endless. As long as you have firm faith and follow it, these things are definitely not false.

Practice keeping the precepts1

NOTE 1

We added the title of this section based on the content, for readers to easily follow.

Each year, you should write the names of all twelve months and stick them on the wall of your house. In a month that allows absolutely no killing, below the name of that month write the words "no killing". If you can keep for a whole month without killing, that is a good deed to the lower level. If you can keep for a whole year without killing, that means you will be able to do good deeds at the middle level. To maintain a whole life without killing is to do good and reach the upper level. The teaching has been passed down through many generations of descendants to keep the precept of not killing, and that is even more of a good person who stands out among good people.

May everyone keep the precept of not killing, all families will give up meat and fish and eat vegetarian food. Surely all the Buddhas will be happy, all the gods will bless, war will forever end, heavy punishments will no longer be needed, hell will be empty. As for sinners, thanks to that, they can forever be far away from the sea of suffering.

Prayer after keeping the precepts

If you can keep absolutely no killing for a month , then on the last night of that month, or morning of the first day of the next month, you can go to the altar of Buddha, wholeheartedly worship the Buddha image and pray as as follows:

“The disciple's name is... (pray to family name, dharma name) ..., with all my heart, please take refuge in Amitābha Buddha in the Western world of Ultimate Bliss. Today's disciple obeys the Buddha's previous teachings, practicing keeping the precepts of not killing, for just one month. Thanks to this merit, I pray for the disciple to be able to eliminate his sins and karma, eliminate all injustice and resentment, and the good roots of practice will increase day by day. At the moment of his death, his body and mind were at peace and his thoughts were clear. Thanks to the Buddha's grace, he was reborn in the Land of Ultimate Bliss. He was reborn from the lotus flower in the seven-jeweled pond. When the flower bloomed, he immediately met the Buddha. He attained the Dharma of forbearance and attained Buddha's wisdom. Using his great divine power, he was able to cause the sentient beings who had been killed by his disciples in many previous lives, along with all sentient beings killed in all ten directions, to be saved and liberated, and now speak the Supreme Way May the Buddha mercifully and mercifully accept this vow.”

After making the vow as above, then recite the Buddha's name a hundred times, or a thousand times or ten thousand times, more or less as you like.

b. Explaining each part

Often heard that the most important thing in the world is life, the most tragic thing in life is being killed.1

NOTE 1

The main text is italicized before the lecture

Broad explanation:

To say that most importantly, that has two meanings. First, people consider gold, silver, jewels, officials, titles, families, wives and children, even themselves, all important. But when you can't have it all, you have to choose which one is more important. Therefore, if you need to save your life, you will not regret any gold, silver or jewels. To save his life, he did not spare officials and titles. Even when I need to save my life, my wife and children don't care anymore. Therefore, it should be said that life is the most important.

The second meaning is that, according to Buddha's teachings, all sentient beings have the ability to become Buddhas. Thus, life is the seed, the condition to become a Buddha. Therefore, it should be said that life is the most important.

Again, it is said that the most tragic thing is like beating and torturing in all kinds of ways, although it makes people suffer

all their suffering, but it is still not to the point of ending their life. Therefore, only killing is the most tragic, [because it ends the lives of all species].

Therefore, when caught, one must find a way to escape. Lice also know how to avoid death, ants and crickets also know how to crave life, so when it rains, they immediately hurry to get away.

Extensive explanation:

Because life is the most important, all species try to keep their lives. Because being killed is the most tragic thing, all species run away from death. Therefore, even lice, ants, and crickets all know how to be greedy for life and afraid of death. Considering how small lives still exist, larger species can clearly understand it.

How can humans spread nets in the mountains and forests, fish in deep pools, find all kinds of ways to catch them, if they are hidden, they cast the line, if they are straight, , they shoot arrows, and a hundred thousand schemes to find the net catch?

Extensive explanation:

Knowing that all sentient beings are greedy for life and afraid of death, how can they obscure their conscience and do cruel things? Putting nets for birds and animals in the mountains and forests, catching shrimp and fish in rivers and lakes, bowing down to the water to catch fish, looking up to the sky and raising a bow to shoot birds,

even secretly and secretly digging holes, setting traps, looking for countless countless ways [to kill all species], it's absolutely infuriating!

Making all creatures terrified and rash lost, mother and child separated.

Extensive explanation:

As mentioned above, people use all kinds of nets spread on land and in the water, then hooked with hooks, shot with arrows... just looking at them makes them terrified. If they get entangled, they will lose their lives, and mother and child will surely separate. If you compare [the situation of those animals] with the situation of people in times of chaos and fire, is there really any difference?

Or locked in a cage in a cage, it would be like a person in a prison; or use a knife to stab a mortar and pound it, it would be no different from a person who has suffered the crime of having his flesh cut to pieces.

Broad explanation:

If you are bound and imprisoned, you will be completely forbidden from moving around, completely losing your freedom, no different from someone being imprisoned in prison. When slaughtered and cut apart, it will be as painful and miserable as a person whose meat is cut to pieces. If you try to put yourself in those situations, you will be able to know what the situation is like for all animals that are killed.

That's because it hurt so much about the dead baby deer, it was so painful that its intestines broke into pieces. Hua Chan Quan was extremely regretful, repented of his sins, immediately broke his bow and arrow, went into the deep mountains to practice Buddhism, and after achieving enlightenment, the whole family flew to heaven.1 This story clarifies the meaning of "mother and child separated separation" just mentioned in the previous paragraph.

The story of catching flies is about a winemaker. Every time a fly falls into a jar of wine, he takes it out, drops it on dry ground, and sprinkles ash around the fly's body to drain all the water, so the fly can live. He did this for a long time and saved many flies. Later, he was falsely accused of theft but could not defend himself. When the verdict was completed, the criminal justice official was about to approve his death sentence, but suddenly flies flew from somewhere and covered the tip of the pen, making it impossible to write. After chasing them away, they immediately came back, so many times that they couldn't put pen to paper. On that occasion, the mandarin suddenly thought again, suspected that there was injustice in this case, and immediately interrogated him carefully to find out that he had been falsely accused. The mandarin ordered the people who had falsely accused him to come and shouted at him once. They immediately admitted their guilt and immediately released him. Oh, how strange this is!

About saving turtles, it is the story of a maid serving in the Trinh family. The homeowner and his wife both like to eat turtle meat. One day, they accidentally caught a very large turtle. When they had to go out, they told their maid to stay at home and cook turtle meat. At that time, the maid thought that she had killed countless turtles with her own hands. Now seeing that this big turtle really wanted to be released, even if the owner beat and scolded her, she was willing to accept it. After thinking about it, I took the turtle to the lake and released it.

The homeowner and his wife returned to ask for turtle meat, and the maid immediately said she accidentally let it run away. That's why being beaten is very painful.

Later, that maid contracted a plague. When she was about to die, the homeowner ordered someone to take her to a tent by the water, and lay there waiting to die. In the middle of the night, suddenly an animal crawled up from the lake, brought the wet mud from the lake and applied it to the maid's body. She immediately felt cool and her illness disappeared. When the homeowner saw that she had recovered and did not die, he was surprised and questioned her. She immediately told the truth, but the homeowner did not believe her. That night, I secretly peeped and saw the big tortoise that the maid had let go of the day before. The whole Trinh family was frightened, and from then on they never ate turtle meat again.

Buying a dying animal at the slaughterhouse, Truong De Hinh died and was born in heaven. Changing the lives of fish and shrimp on a fishing boat, Ly Canh Van was cured of Dan Sa poison.

Extensive preaching:

Buying animals that are about to die is a story. Truong De Hinh often goes to the slaughterhouse, spends money to buy animals that are about to be killed and released. When he was about to die, he told his family: "I have done the work of liberating life, accumulating deep virtue, now there is someone coming to welcome me to heaven, I am about to be born there." After saying that, he calmly passed away.

Exchanging lives of fish and shrimp on a fishing boat is the story of Ly Canh Van. He often went to the fishermen, bought

all the fish and shrimp they caught and then dropped them into the river. Ly Canh Van liked to use medicinal pills. He often ate medicinal herbs that were refined through fire. The heat accumulated in his body for a long time caused him to get sick, developing boils on his back that no medicine could cure. Canh Van, while unconscious and unaware of anything, suddenly felt as if a whole school of fish used their saliva to rub on the poisonous boils, his body immediately felt cool and refreshing, and when he woke up he was immediately cured. This story is similar to the story of a tortoise repaying his maid for saving his life.

Ton Luong Tu saved him from the danger of being imprisoned, and at the funeral, a flock of birds came to help. Phan district prohibits fishing in rivers and lakes. When moving, the shrimp and fish cry.

Extensive explanation:

Rescuing the danger of imprisonment is to talk about Ton Luong Tu, every time he saw birds being imprisoned by people, he spent money to buy them to let them fly away. After his death, his family was so poor that they did not know how to organize his burial. Suddenly, a flock of hundreds of birds came and together covered his grave with mud. Everyone who saw it thought it was strange. It is because of the compassion that moves animals that it becomes like that.

The ban on catching fish in rivers and lakes is a talk about the district magistrate of the Phan family. When in power, he issued an order prohibiting people from catching fish and shrimp in the rivers and lakes in the area he governed, and violators were punished. After he was transferred to another place, the fish and shrimp in the water all rose up and cried loudly, just like people

crying for their dead parents. Everyone heard it, everyone thought it was a strange story.

Great Master Tin broke the custom of killing sacrifices and gave a good omen of good rain. Patriarch Cao Khe opened the hunter's net, the word of compassion spread everywhere.

Extensive explanation:

Breaking the custom of sacrifice is talking about how Master Tin encountered a drought and saw that the villagers were confused by the old custom and wanted to kill sacrificial animals to pray for rain. The Master felt pity for that confusion so he immediately taught: "If you will release the sacrificial animals and not kill them, I will pray for rain for you." The people agreed to follow. The great master prayed sincerely, and it rained heavily. Because of that, people from near and far were inspired by him.

Opening the hunter's net is to talk about how the Sixth Patriarch, after receiving the initiation from the Fifth Patriarch in Hoang Mai, still became a secular person and came to live with a group of hunters. The hunter entrusted him to keep the net. He took advantage of their absence to see if there were gills, rabbits... all kinds of animals in the net. Any animal that could be released was immediately released. So it took 16 years. After that, he came to Cao Khe Dharma school, where he was generous to disciples of all backgrounds, and the teachings passed down were divided into five sects,1 benefiting all generations to come.

NOTE 1

The saved prince put on a jade necklace to show his gratitude, went down to the well to convey his gratitude.

Teaching wide:

The prince holds a jade necklace, which is a story about Duong Bao, when he was young, he once saw a royal bird being chased by a kestrel, seriously injured, falling to the ground, and then being bitten by ants. Duong Bao immediately brought the bird home to raise it, used medicine to treat the wound, waited until it was completely healed, then let it fly away. That night he dreamed that he saw a young boy wearing a yellow shirt come to pay his respects and give him four jade bracelets, saying: "I am the emissary of the Queen Mother. Thanks to you for saving my life, I pray that in the future, your descendants will all be honest and pure, and become mandarins with the title of Three Dukes, as durable and beautiful as these jade bracelets." Afterwards, indeed, Duong Bao's descendants throughout four generations were honored and honored.

The weasel down the well, that is the old story of a monk who disguised himself and had a dishonest personality. He heard that the medicine Hoang Tinh can help people live long, and wanted to test it to see if it was true. He immediately put the royal star in a shallow well, then tricked another person into going into the well, using a large stone mill tray to cover it.

to the mouth of the well. The other person was locked in a well, panicking and not knowing what to do. Suddenly he saw a weasel crawling into the well and said: "Don't be afraid, I will teach you this technique. We weasels have a supernatural technique. We often dig a hole in the middle of a person's grave and crawl down, then lie in the grave and look up at the mouth of the hole. After a long time, you will be able to fly out of the grave. In the book of Taoist Taoism, it is said that 'the spirit can fly', which is what it is talking about. Now you can learn to follow the technique. by looking intently at the empty hole in the middle of the mill tray. I was once caught by a hunter, thanks to you spending money to save my life, so today I came here to repay the favor."

The other person believed the weasel's words and followed it attentively. After about ten days, he was able to fly out of the well and escape danger. The dishonest monk was very happy, thinking that it was due to the effectiveness of the medicine Hoang Tinh. He immediately said goodbye to everyone and took some royal crystals down to the well, telling everyone to close the well and open it after a month to see. On the same day, people opened the well to see that he was dead. He did not know that the other person had previously escaped from the well thanks to the help of the weasel. How pitiful!

Even the dead body was saved, and then crawled on the wall to listen to the prayer. When encountering a difficult situation and hoping to live, the creature appears in the form of a person in yellow clothing and dreams.

Extensive explanation:

The thing crawling on the wall listening to the sutra, that's the story. Once

I1 stayed in a hermitage, saw someone catching a lot of centipedes, using a curved bamboo stick to stick their heads to their tails, I immediately bought them to release them, but most of the injured were already gone. Not about to die, only one still had enough strength to crawl away.

NOTE 1

That is the self-proclaimed Great Master Lien Tri.

Later, one time I was sitting with a friend at night, suddenly saw a centipede on the wall, so I used a wooden ruler to knock hard nearby to scare it away, but it refused to go away. I immediately said: "Could it be that you are the centipede I released before? Are you here to thank me? If so, I will preach the Dharma for you. Please listen and don't rush to leave."

At that time, I told him: "All sentient beings are created by the mind. A cruel mind turns into tigers, leopards, wolves. An evil mind turns into snakes, centipedes, and scorpions. If you can get rid of your cruel mind, you can definitely escape your current body."

I finished teaching and immediately told him to leave. It obeyed, no need to chase away, naturally slowly crawled out of the window bars and away. My friend at that time saw everything and was surprised, thinking it was a rare and strange thing. This happened in the fourth year of Long Khanh's reign.2

NOTE 2

That is in 1570, during the reign of King Minh Muc Tong. The Great Master was 38 years old that year, and the next year he arrived at Van The Mountain, Hangzhou.

About the yellow shirt man's dream, it was a story in the suburbs of Hangzhou. A neighbor's house was robbed. The [married] daughter heard the news and came to visit and bought her mother ten eels as a gift. The mother brought

eel and put it in a jar and forgot about it. One night, she dreamed that ten people wearing yellow shirts and pointed hats came to kneel before her and beg for their lives. Waking up in doubt, not knowing what was going on, she went to see a fortune teller. The fortune teller said: "There is a living thing begging you to let it go."

She went home and searched all over the house, only to find eels in the jar, counting exactly ten. She was frightened and immediately released them all. This happened in the 9th year of Van Li.1

NOTE 1

That is in 1581, during the reign of King Minh Than Tong.

All alms are blessed, everything is clear clear, not without evidence. just.

Extensive explanation:

Those who do the work of liberating lives, or receive additional blessings, or have their lifespan increased, or avoid accidents, or eliminate diseases, or be born in heaven, or attain enlightenment, receive blessings depending on the different alms given, all of which have clear evidence. However, doing good deeds will attract good things is just a matter of course. How can a person with a good mind expect blessings? Don't expect blessings, blessings will come by themselves. Cause and effect is like that, people who release animals need to know.

Either recorded in books, or clearly heard and seen with eyes and ears.

Broad explanation:

The events cited above, things that have happened

past are recorded in books, have evidentiary sources, What happened recently is clear to both ears and eyes, with many people seeing and hearing it. Examining the stories of the past and verifying the stories of the present life cannot be false or misleading.

May everyone, every time they see an object [a life about to be killed], develop a mind of compassion and let go of unstable property to practice convenient ways to help.

Extensive explanation:

This verse broadly advises all people in the world to develop a mind of compassion, give up worldly possessions to practice means to help all living beings.

Saying assets are not durable, is because worldly assets can be swept away by floods, can be destroyed by fires, and can be destroyed. It can be confiscated by kings and officials, it can be robbed by robbers, it is very fragile and impermanent, it is not a durable asset. Now giving up that type of unstable asset to do good deeds means exchanging unstable assets to gain durable assets.

If you don't have money, you just need to develop compassion for all living beings, and that will also create blessings. Or advising and encouraging others to release animals, or seeing others release animals, praising, praising, and rejoicing along with that action, causing their good thoughts to grow even more, that is also creating merit.

If you can protect many lives, you will accumulate great virtue, but even if you can only save the life of one small worm, that is still a job. good.

Extensive explanation:

If a person has the ability to save many lives, of course he will gain great virtue. To someone who is incapable, even saving the life of a small worm is still a good deed. Don't think that small good deeds don't bring benefits so don't do them. People do not understand this argument, so they often choose small animals so they can buy many to release. For large animals, even if they see them about to die in the middle of the road, they will look at them and pass them by. That's just desire for one's own blessings, not compassion for the suffering of sentient beings. With a mind like that, the blessings are very small, you have to be very careful, don't think in that way!

Add good deeds every day, the more you accumulate, the more widely you practice, the higher the blessings will be rewarded.

Broad explanation:

Good deeds, regardless of size, are most precious in that they can be persistently performed for a long time. As each day increases, month after month there is accumulation. The more good deeds, of course, the wider the scope of doing good deeds, the wider the practice, the higher the blessings.

Mercy spreads throughout the human world, good reputation reaches the heavenly world.

Broad preaching:

Starting a mind of doing good deeds over a long period of time, the merits accumulated are profound and widespread, so everyone in the world knows about them. If people's hearts admire and believe, surely God's hearts will love and value them. Some people think that since the sky is so high and vast, how can one sympathize with the work of the human world? That is, they do not know that the Heavenly Kings in the days of Six Boys1 all looked around the human world, all good deeds were known, all evil deeds were clearly seen. Furthermore, those who practice the ten good karmas will have the advantage of heaven, those who practice the ten evil karmas will have the advantage of the asuras, so the Heavenly Emperor always wants people to do good deeds.2 As long as there is one person doing good deeds, the gods immediately report to the Heavenly Emperor. These things are clearly recorded in the Sutras, not based on speculation.

NOTE 1

Six sons: are the days of the 8th, 14th, 15th, 23rd, 29th and 30th (missing months are the 28th and 29th). According to the Four Heavenly Kings Sutra, on those days, the Four Heavenly Kings consider good and bad deeds in the human world. Some people vow to fast 6 days a month on these days, so they call it Luc Trai.

NOTE 2

Because good people are born in heaven, there are many gods. If evildoers are born in the asura world, the asuras will be even more numerous. Asuras are still constantly at war with the gods, so God always wants more people to be born in the heavens but does not want anyone to be born in the asura world.

Cleanse your heart without resentment and hatred for karma obstacles, blessings will gather in this life; Cultivate water the good roots, happiness will last forever.

Explain widely:

Do not kill, only work to release animals, there is no resentment towards

all species. Not only will you be happy in the present life, but thanks to this good root, you will also be able to live a long life and enjoy lasting happiness in many future lives, until you will fully attain Buddhahood in the future, and all sentient beings will respect and rely on you, such will be happiness that will last forever in the next life.

If possible, [when releasing a life] you should recite the Buddha's force, recite the Sutras.

Extensive explanation:

When meeting a life [about to die] and being able to save it, although it is a virtuous merit, that only saves the physical body of a sentient being, and does not help the intellectual life inherent in each sentient being. Therefore, [while doing the work of releasing animals] it is very advisable to recite the name of Amitābha Buddha, who is endowed with countless good virtues, and reverently recite the Mahayana Sutras. However, rescuing released animals has to be done as quickly as putting out a fire, so reciting the Sutras is very inconvenient. Only using the Buddha's name [is feasible] to help the released animals. If you buy a living animal and leave it overnight, waiting for the morning to release it, or if you buy it early in the morning, then after noon you are still detained, waiting to set up a dojo and gather men and women. If you prolong the time like that, most of the living creatures will not be able to bear it and will die. Doing the work of releasing animals like that is just empty and not sincere.

For the sake of the released animals, I dedicate the merits, praying that after death they will be born in the Western Pure Land, forever free from the three evil paths.

Broadly preached:

Thanks to the merits chanting the Buddha's name, praying that once the animals are released from life, once their current life ends, they will be reborn in the Western world of Ultimate Bliss, reincarnated from the lotus flower, attain a state of no more regression, forever separate from evil paths, forever ending the cycle of suffering.

Three evil paths, that is to say, out of the six paths of reincarnation, three paths are evil: hell, hungry ghosts and animals. birth.1

NOTE 1

The remaining three realms are the heavenly realm, the human realm and the asura realm. Because they do not have as much suffering as the three evil paths, and have conditions for increased practice, they are considered good realms.

If we do so, our mind will become even greater. labor, the roots of virtue are even deeper.

Broad explanation:

Seeing the suffering of sentient beings [about to die] and taking action to release living beings, for those who already have a good heart, they will cultivate an even greater Bodhi mind, so it is said to be "even greater".

Releasing life will bring blessings. For those who have planted worldly blessings, they will now become worldly virtues, so it is said to be "even deeper".

Thanks to that, one can quickly achieve the path of karma, and be born in the nine-level lotus realm of the Buddha realm.

Teaching wide:

With such a great mind and deep and strong roots of virtue, how can we contemplate this matter to know? In general, working to benefit others is the Bodhisattva's virtue. Practicing this life-releasing dharma to further support the career of cultivating the Dharma, will surely be like a sailboat with favorable winds, quickly reaching the shore of Nirvana. Of the three blessings of pure karma, cultivating loving kindness and not killing is the noblest. Now I can keep the precepts of not killing, and also work to release animals; was able to do the work of liberating lives, and also used the Dharma to save sentient beings [after death] to be reborn in the Pure Land; Those who practice diligently like this, once they have completed this retribution, will definitely be born in the nine-level lotus in the Pure Land, there is no doubt about that anymore.

Now I would like to widely advise all people in the world, I hope don't doubt and not believe because of my fragile virtue, my small status. accept.1

NOTE 1

These are the humble words of Master Lien Tri.

noi_dung:
Ritual for releasing animals

This ritual is based on the old text of Dharma Master Le1 in Tu Minh, with a few additions and subtractions for simplicity and ease of practice. At the end, a section is added to replace the released animals and vow to be reborn, and the tenth chapter of dedication in the Avatamsaka Sutra is added to end, taking the meaning of first praying for rebirth in the Pure Land of Amitābha Buddha, then entering the mystical Flower Treasury of Buddha Vairocana.2

NOTE 1

That is the 17th generation Patriarch of the Thien Thai sect, often revered as Tu Minh Tri Le Great Master (四明知禮大師), Tu Minh Venerable (四明尊者) or Tu Minh Great Dharma Master (四明大法師). He was born in 960, passed away in 1028, and was born in Tu Minh, Ngan district, Zhejiang province.

NOTE 2

Transliterated from Sanskrit Mahā Vairocana Buddha, the name translated means Great Sun Tathagata.

In addition, in the hot season, as soon as the release ceremony begins, you can chant according to this ritual, and as soon as you finish, release the animals. When someone continues to release animals, you only need to recite the Great Compassion mantra once, the Rebirth mantra three times, and then recite Amitābha Buddha's name while releasing the object. There is no need to be very serious in following the formal ritual. If you prolong it, it will damage the animal's life. If someone continues to come, make the same simplification.

At the release place, place a solemn incense burner, with poplar branches and clean water. Those who participate in releasing animals all develop compassion, look at the released animals with compassionate eyes, contemplate their sinking into reincarnation, immediately feel deep compassion, and then contemplate the Three Jewels, which have extremely great power and can save them from suffering.

After contemplating like that, holding a cup of water in your hand, silently chanting:

“ With one heart, I request the Ten Directions from Father Quang Great inspiration of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, please come to the garland, bless this cup of water with all the great powers, when sprinkled on the bodies of all living beings, it will make they all be pure in body and mind, able to listen to The teachings of the Dharma color.”

After silently praying like that, immediately began chanting the Great Compassion mantra once, then used the clean water in that bowl to sprinkle the bodies of the released animals three times. Next, he raised the incense burner with both hands and respectfully said:

“Admiring the Three Jewels of the Ten Directions, Master Shakyamuni, Amitābha Buddha, Tathagata Bao Thang, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Elder Master Luu Thuy, Thien Thai, Vinh Minh and the Great Beings... I pray that you will compassionately acknowledge and protect me. Today there are sentient beings flying in the air, living on land, or diving in the rivers, suffering from suffering. Just because these sentient beings are deeply hindered in their sins, their consciousness is ignorant and dark, they should pray to the Three Jewels for their blessings and mercy."

Next said:

“Today the sentient beings present here would like to take refuge in the Buddha, take refuge in the Dharma, and take refuge in the Sangha.” (Repeat three times)

“Today the sentient beings present here have all taken refuge in the Buddha, taken refuge in the Dharma, and taken refuge in the Sangha.” (Repeat three times)

“From now on, sentient beings today who have taken refuge in the Three Jewels, become Buddhists, worship Buddha as their teacher, and will never take refuge in the evil spirits of pagans.” (Repeat three times)

“All Buddhists1 have taken refuge in the Three Jewels, now for your sake we will praise the ten names of Tathagata Bao Thang, thanks to that merit,

for you, after hearing it, you will be like ten thousand fish [previously saved by the rich man Luu Thuy, after death you will be] born in heaven, no difference."

Introduction In the Dhammapada Sutra, the Buddha taught that: “Dharma

gift trumps all giving.” Practicing Dharma giving means sharing and spreading Buddha's teachings to everyone. Every Buddhist can, depending on their ability, practice Dharma giving in the following ways:

1. Try to learn, understand and practice the Buddha's teachings. The deeper you learn and understand, the more effective sharing and giving Dharma will be. Remember that reading books is more important than buying books.

2. You must cherish the scriptures and books printed with Buddha's teachings. When you have the means, buy them and bring them home so that you and your family can learn and follow them. You should not keep it as your own, but be willing to share it, spread it widely, and encourage many others to read and learn. You should not let the scriptures lie still and collect dust on the bookshelf, because if the scriptures are not read by people, they cannot bring benefits.

3. Depending on your ability, contribute material and effort to support those who do the work of compiling, translating, printing, and circulating scriptures, so that more and more precious scriptures can be printed and circulated.

Normally, spending a small amount of money cannot bring great benefits, but if used to help circulate If you practice the scriptures, the benefits will be unimaginably great. That's because it has helped many people understand and follow Buddha's teachings. I hope that Buddhists everywhere will pay attention to contribute their efforts to the above works.
